The bowstring trembled as three skills erupted at once.
Countless arrows transformed into a rain of fire and lightning serpents, crashing down like an apocalyptic disaster.
Crimson critical-hit damage numbers exploded throughout the shadowkin army like flowers of death in full bloom.
Even legendary-grade shadowkin commanders were like paper in front of him.
As for epic-grade warriors, they did not even have time to scream before turning to ash.
With one volley, hundreds of thousands of shadowkin were annihilated!
Two volleys.
Three volleys...
In just a few short minutes, this shadowkin legion of several million was already on the verge of collapse.
The surviving shadowkin soldiers stared at that blackgold-colored figure in the sky, their eyes filled with terror.
"That’s a legendary-grade powerhouse?"
"Impossible... he doesn’t have a legendary-grade aura!"
"But this is absurd!
Why is he this strong?!"
"Find a way to kill him!"
Daniel gave them no chance.
The arrow rain did not stop.
The lightning did not cease.
Tens of thousands of lightning serpents roamed across the battlefield, leaving utter desolation in their wake.
Ten minutes later, the entire shadowkin legion had been wiped out!
[Ding!
Gold coins +250,000!
EXP +1.6 billion!]
Daniel spread his wings and flew toward the distorted region of space in the distance.
Godscar.
Five terrifying auras were colliding madly within this torn-apart region of space.
Every clash released power enough to flatten mountains.
The earth trembled, and the sky burned.
Carodion was locked in combat with the shadowkin leader.
Golden sword light and dark crimson demonic flames intertwined into a net of death, the surrounding air twisting from the heat.
On the other four battlefields, Tiana, Aliris, Cole, and Upton were fighting the remaining four legendary-grade shadowkin.
Both sides were evenly matched, and there was no clear winner for the moment.
Just then, Daniel’s figure appeared at the edge of the battlefield.
The shadowkin leader, Regroth, noticed the uninvited guest immediately.
While parrying Carodion’s assault, he glanced sidelong at the human archer and pulled his lips into a scornful smile.
"Has humanity run out of people?
They actually sent an ant here to die?"
Daniel remained expressionless and quietly cast a detection spell.
[Shadowkin Leader · Regroth (Legendary-Grade · High Stage)]
Level: 95
Defense: 8,800,000
Skills: Abyss Descends, Demonflame Slash, Whispering Curse, Shadow Guard, Abyssal Demonic Power...
Indestructible Substance: Regroth points
Description: The ruler of the Five-Star Abyss Rift, a high-stage legendary-grade shadowkin powerhouse, and one of the thirty-six Grand Lords serving under the Shadowkin Overlord!

chapters.title: Chapter 109 -109-The Forbidden-Grade Skill — Thunder Abyss
paragraphs: Daniel’s eyes narrowed slightly.
800 points of Indestructible Substance!
That meant he would have to kill Regroth eight hundred times before he could truly destroy him.
That was the terrifying part of a legendary-grade powerhouse.
He did not hesitate for even a moment. He activated God Speed at once!
In the next instant, he appeared less than ten meters behind Regroth.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
Invisible wind-force surged in from all directions, transforming into countless transparent chains that wrapped around Regroth’s limbs, neck, and waist.
Pale golden runes flowed across those chains, each one containing an ancient law of wind.
Regroth’s expression changed drastically. He discovered that his body had become completely immobile. Even the mana inside him was being firmly suppressed by an invisible power.
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
Storm clouds gathered in an instant, violet lightning roaring and rolling through them.
The next second, tens of thousands of thunder-serpents came crashing down, engulfing Regroth within them.
A sharp light flashed through Carodion’s eyes.
He raised the longsword in his hand high overhead, and a hundred-meter-long golden sword aura condensed along the blade.
It was an overwhelmingly powerful strike infused with Indestructible Substance!
"Sacred Judgment!"
Boom—!
The sword fell.
Golden light descended like divine punishment cleaving heaven and earth apart, slamming down viciously onto Regroth’s head.
Critical Hit!
Regroth let out a howl of agony. The Indestructible Substance within his body burned frantically, trying to withstand that fatal blow.
But Daniel’s lightning did not pause for even an instant. Every second, it tore through his defenses. Every second, it consumed the Indestructible Substance he relied on to stay alive.
Within only a few breaths, Regroth had already suffered severe wounds.
His eyes were filled with disbelief.
Just moments ago, he had mocked humanity for having no one left. And now he was being driven into this state by a human who was not even legendary-grade.
This was the greatest humiliation imaginable!
"RAAAARGH—!"
With a furious roar, Regroth erupted with Indestructible Substance like a volcano, forcibly breaking free from the wind chains.
[Ding! Your skill "Wind’s Embrace" has been forcibly broken!]
He glared at Daniel with hatred, his eyes brimming with killing intent.
"Die for me!"
Before his words had fully fallen, he had already abandoned Carodion and lunged straight at Daniel.
Daniel’s expression remained calm.
He had never expected a single skill to permanently bind a high-stage legendary-grade powerhouse.
Indestructible Substance had many special uses. Breaking restraints was only one of them.
But every time it was used in that way, it consumed a massive amount.
If Regroth kept burning through it like this, how much could he possibly have left?
Daniel’s figure flashed, God Speed activating once more as he instantly widened the distance between them.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
Pale golden chains surged forth from the void again, binding Regroth tightly in place.
"Get the hell off me!!"
Never in his life had Regroth hated a human this much.
He frantically drove his Indestructible Substance, trying to break free again.
But every time he shattered the restraints, new chains coiled around him.
And every burst of consumption meant he was one step closer to death.
Carodion’s attacks did not stop.
Every strike carried the amplification of Indestructible Substance. Every strike carved wounds so deep they exposed bone across Regroth’s body.
Regroth’s HP plummeted like a collapsing dam.
He tried once more to break free, only to discover in horror that the Indestructible Substance inside him was almost exhausted.
"I am a Grand Lord of the shadowkin... am I really going to die here in such a miserable way today?"
"No! I refuse... I refuse!"
No one answered him.
Only the tens of thousands of thunder-serpents continued tearing his body apart without pause.
Ten seconds.
Twenty seconds.
Thirty seconds...
When the last trace of Indestructible Substance was finally used up, Regroth’s body exploded under the lightning, bursting into fragments that filled the sky.
[Ding! You have slain the Shadowkin Grand Lord "Regroth (Legendary-Grade · High Stage)"! Gold coins +5,000,000! Contribution Points +400,000!]
[Obtained "High Divinity Fragment (Legendary-Grade)" ×1!]
[Obtained Forbidden-Grade Skill "Thunder Abyss"! ]
[Obtained "Heavenscar Ticket" ×1!]
Daniel’s breathing caught slightly.
A High Divinity Fragment!
After reaching level 200 and completing his class advancement, he would be able to fuse with a Divinity.
And among all Divinities, High Divinity was the finest of the finest.
That was what he truly wanted.
Lower and Intermediate Divinities were not even worth mentioning!
And besides the Divinity Fragment, there was also a forbidden-grade skill book!
He opened the skill book, which shimmered with violet lightning.
[Thunder Abyss (SSS-Rank, Forbidden)]
Learning Requirement: Archer / Level 150

Effect: Calls forth abyssal lightning to form a permanent thunder prison within a designated area (1000 × 1000 meters). All enemy targets within the domain are forcibly afflicted with [Paralysis], [Silence], and [Slow]. One million thunder arrows are automatically generated within the domain, continuously attacking all enemies inside. Each thunder arrow deals damage equal to 100% of the caster’s Attack Power.
Domain Duration: Unlimited (can be terminated at any time by the caster; consumes 1% MP per second)

Description: A forbidden divine art said to have been created by an ancient Arrow God who drew upon the lightning of the Abyss. Once a single arrow is loosed, ten thousand bolts descend. Whoever is trapped within can only be reduced to ashes amid the endless storm.
A burning light flashed through Daniel’s eyes.
Together with [Skyrend Impact], which he had obtained earlier, he now possessed two forbidden-grade skills.
Once he completed this mission and obtained the World Key, he would be able to forcibly kill the World Watcher and trigger the World War!
When that time came, after completing his class advancement and reaching level 150, these two forbidden spells would truly come into their own.
He then took out the ticket radiating faint golden light.
[Heavenscar Ticket (Early Grade)]
Restriction: Requires 100 tickets before use
Effect: Grants entry to Heavenscar and allows the holder to fight on behalf of their race.
Description: Do you long to bring an end to darkness and the endless invasions? Do you wish for your race to stand proudly above all others? Then step onto the battlefield!
Daniel had never heard of this item in any of his previous lives. It was presumably an exceptionally rare special item.
He stored the ticket away and turned his gaze toward the other battlefields.
The moment Regroth died, the remaining four shadowkin legendary-grade experts immediately panicked.
"Despicable humans! You actually ganged up on Lord Regroth!"
"Damn it! They have six powerhouses now, and we only have four..."
"We can’t win this! We need to find a way to retreat!"
Carodion and Tiana had already locked onto their next targets.
Daniel and Carodion joined forces and swiftly intervened in another battlefield.
God Speed!
In an instant, Daniel appeared behind a mid-stage shadowkin powerhouse.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
Carodion and Tiana attacked at the same time, striking from left and right as their longswords came down together.
Weak Point Hit!
Under the combined bombardment of the two of them, the Indestructible Substance inside that shadowkin expert was instantly drained away.
Carodion and Tiana withdrew in perfect coordination, their swords already pulled back.
The final blow had to be left for Daniel!
Daniel’s thunder prison continued raging on.
A few seconds later, the shadowkin expert’s HP was completely reduced to zero, and his body turned to ash beneath the lightning.
[Ding! You have slain the Shadowkin Commander "Hobart (Legendary-Grade · High Stage)"!]
[Obtained "High Divinity Fragment (Legendary-Grade)" ×1!]
[Obtained "Abyss Howl Demon Armor (Legendary-Grade)" ×1!]
[Obtained "Bloodthirst Warboots (Legendary-Grade)" ×1!]
[Contribution Points +350,000! Gold coins +280,000!]

chapters.title: Chapter 110 -110-Battle Shifts to the Six-Star Abyss Rift
paragraphs: "My lord!"
Very soon, Carodion’s voice rang out again from the distance.
Following the trail of Contribution Points, Daniel looked over and saw that Carodion, Tiana, and Aliris had already completely suppressed another shadowkin powerhouse.
The shadowkin expert was on his last breath. The Immortal Singularity within his body had been fully exhausted, and only the final blow remained!
Daniel teleported over and raised his hand, loosing an arrow without hesitation.
[Aetherlance]!
A golden arrow of light instantly pierced through the shadowkin’s skull.
[Ding! You have slain a shadowkin commander! Obtained "Intermediate Divinity Fragment (legendary-grade)" x1!
Obtained "Darkbreath Battle Armor (legendary-grade)" x1!
Obtained "Blackfiend Warblade (legendary-grade)" x1!
Contribution Points +200,000! Gold Coins +180,000!]
Daniel’s expression remained calm. The rewards were decent, but nothing extraordinary.
At this moment, only the last two shadowkin powerhouses remained on the battlefield.
They attempted to break through and escape, but Cole and Upton held them down without giving them any room to move.
Both shadowkin experts had already been beaten until their auras were incredibly weak. They were exhausted, like spent arrows at the end of their flight.
All the human powerhouses turned their eyes toward Daniel.
Those two shadowkin were looking at him as well, their eyes filled with hatred.
"Cough... cough... You insects won’t stay arrogant for much longer!" one of them spat through gritted teeth.
"Our Sovereign will definitely avenge us!"
"That’s right. Our Sovereign will surely trample the human race into the ground and wipe every last one of you out!" the other sneered coldly.
A faint smile also rose at the corner of Daniel’s lips.
Arrowstorm!
Arrows fell like meteors from the sky, piercing through both of their bodies.
[Ding! You have slain a shadowkin commander! Obtained "Lower Divinity Fragment (legendary-grade)" x1!
Obtained "Infernal Bracers (legendary-grade)" x1!
Obtained "Infernal War Armor (legendary-grade)" x1!
Contribution Points +90,000! Gold Coins +120,000!]
[Ding! You have slain a shadowkin commander! Obtained "Intermediate Divinity Fragment (legendary-grade)" x1!
Obtained "Infernal Helm (legendary-grade)" x1!
Obtained "Swiftforce Greaves (legendary-grade)" x1!
Contribution Points +130,000! Gold Coins +150,000!]
At the same time, a world announcement resounded throughout the entire Stellar world—
[Server-Wide Announcement!!!]
[Player "Faustus" of World Region No. 616 has successfully suppressed the disturbance in Luminara’s five-star Abyss Rift! Achievement completed: "Humanity’s Dawnstar (legendary-grade)"!]
The announcement rang out three times in succession, golden text flashing before the eyes of every player.
The World Channel instantly exploded.
"By the gods... we were still gathering outside the Abyss Rift entrance, and Great God Faustus was already done? And it was a five-star one?"
"Sigh. I don’t even know why anymore, but I feel like I’m starting to get used to Great God Faustus doing things no one can possibly predict!"
"Exactly! He’s already managed to massacre tens of thousands of monsters in one go. I genuinely feel like there’s nothing he can’t do!"
"Maybe... maybe the only area where I can go fifty-fifty with Great God Faustus is charisma."
"Wake up. You’re not even comparable to a single strand of his hair."
[Ding! Achievement obtained: "Humanity’s Dawnstar"!
Achievement Reward: Ascension Stone (legendary-grade) x1!]
Daniel glanced at the two rainbow-colored crystals gleaming in his hand, then decisively sold them.
[Ding! You have sold item: Ascension Stone (legendary-grade) to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The item sold belongs to the Special Materials category. Please choose: Quality Boost / Quantity Boost!]
"Quality Boost!"
[Ding! Congratulations! You have obtained 1 gold coin!
You have obtained "Ascendant Starstone (supreme-grade)" x1!]
Looking at the rainbow-colored crystal now resting inside his backpack, Daniel’s lips curled slightly upward.
It was the same kind of Ascendant Starstone he had previously used on Aliris. It could grant an NPC the potential to advance to supreme-grade, removing all obstacles during the promotion process!
Still, he had no immediate idea who to use it on, so he simply stored it away for the time being.
The battle in the five-star Abyss Rift had come to an end.
But Daniel was not satisfied.
Since they were already here, he might as well tear the heavens of this Abyss Rift apart completely.
He would destroy the shadowkin rifts and make it impossible for them to invade the continent of Aetheria for a long time to come.
"Continue deeper."
His voice was calm as still water. "Shatter the shadowkin’s sweet dreams."
"As you command!"
The six figures rose into the air once more and shot toward the deeper regions of the Abyss Rift.
In his previous lives, Daniel had ventured deep into the Abyss Rift countless times. He knew every inch of this place like the back of his hand.
The interior of the Abyss Rift was a world unto itself. The higher the star rating, the larger the territory it occupied.
Because the Watchers outside were suppressing it, the shadowkin were unable to break the seal and escape.
They could only slaughter one another endlessly within this lightless world.
It was precisely because of this that after the nine-star Abyss Rift riot began, the first thing the shadowkin did was launch an internal war of unification.
The shadowkin Sovereign, Baal, sought to consolidate all shadowkin strength before launching a full-scale invasion of the human empire!
Humanity had to take advantage of the shadowkin’s internal chaos and suppress them with all its might.
Otherwise, the day the shadowkin completed their unification would be the day catastrophe descended upon the empire!
Daniel already had a few ideas in mind.
Leading the group of human powerhouses, he flew toward the region where the six-star Abyss Rift was located.

Looking up, they saw a pitch-black giant city standing at the edge of sight. Its walls were covered in spikes and skulls. On either side of the city gate stood two demonic statues over a hundred meters tall, radiating a suffocating pressure.
The moment the human powerhouses appeared, six terrifying auras burst out from the city.
"So it’s humans! Have you come here to die? Hahaha!"
"If you’ve come intending to betray humanity, then perhaps we can consider taking you in!"
"Enough nonsense. All humans deserve to die! Kill them!"
The six shadowkin legendary-grade experts quickly reached a consensus and lunged at them at once.
The blood feud between the two races was too deep to measure. It was either your death or mine.
Carodion fought one against two at the same time, blocking both a high-rank and an early-rank shadowkin expert.
Tiana faced a mid-rank shadowkin.
Cole and Upton entangled two early-rank opponents.
Aliris was also locked in fierce combat with another legendary-grade early-rank shadowkin.
Daniel brought Marco with him and headed straight for the early-rank shadowkin who was being held back by Carodion.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
[Aetherlance]!
Within mere seconds, that early-rank shadowkin was killed.
[Ding! You have slain a shadowkin commander! Obtained "Lower Divinity Fragment (legendary-grade)" x1!
Obtained "Demon General Bracers (legendary-grade)" x1!
Obtained "Demon General War Armor (legendary-grade)" x1!
Contribution Points +30,000! Gold Coins +120,000!]
Daniel did not stop. Bringing Marco with him, he headed straight for Tiana’s battlefield.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
Marco and Tiana attacked at the same time. With Daniel supporting from the side, the mid-rank shadowkin was quickly slain as well.
[Ding! You have slain a shadowkin commander! Obtained "Higher Divinity Fragment (legendary-grade)" x1!
Obtained "Infernal War Armor (legendary-grade)" x1!
Obtained "Infernal War Boots (legendary-grade)" x1!
Contribution Points +180,000! Gold Coins +210,000!]

"Exactly!
He’s already managed to massacre tens of thousands of monsters in one go.
I genuinely feel like there’s nothing he can’t do!"
"Maybe... maybe the only area where I can go fifty-fifty with Great God Faustus is charisma."
"Wake up.
You’re not even comparable to a single strand of his hair."
[Ding!
Achievement obtained: "Humanity’s Dawnstar"!
Achievement Reward: Ascension Stone (legendary-grade) x1!]
Daniel glanced at the two rainbow-colored crystals gleaming in his hand, then decisively sold them.
[Ding!
You have sold item: Ascension Stone (legendary-grade) to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The item sold belongs to the Special Materials category.
Please choose: Quality Boost / Quantity Boost!]
"Quality Boost!"
[Ding!
Congratulations!
You have obtained 1 gold coin!
You have obtained "Ascendant Starstone (supreme-grade)" x1!]
Looking at the rainbow-colored crystal now resting inside his backpack, Daniel’s lips curled slightly upward.
It was the same kind of Ascendant Starstone he had previously used on Aliris.
It could grant an NPC the potential to advance to supreme-grade, removing all obstacles during the promotion process!
Still, he had no immediate idea who to use it on, so he simply stored it away for the time being.
The battle in the five-star Abyss Rift had come to an end.
But Daniel was not satisfied.
Since they were already here, he might as well tear the heavens of this Abyss Rift apart completely.
He would destroy the shadowkin rifts and make it impossible for them to invade the continent of Aetheria for a long time to come.
"Continue deeper."
His voice was calm as still water.
"Shatter the shadowkin’s sweet dreams."
"As you command!"
The six figures rose into the air once more and shot toward the deeper regions of the Abyss Rift.
In his previous lives, Daniel had ventured deep into the Abyss Rift countless times.
He knew every inch of this place like the back of his hand.
The interior of the Abyss Rift was a world unto itself.
The higher the star rating, the larger the territory it occupied.
Because the Watchers outside were suppressing it, the shadowkin were unable to break the seal and escape.
They could only slaughter one another endlessly within this lightless world.
It was precisely because of this that after the nine-star Abyss Rift riot began, the first thing the shadowkin did was launch an internal war of unification.
The shadowkin Sovereign, Baal, sought to consolidate all shadowkin strength before launching a full-scale invasion of the human empire!
Humanity had to take advantage of the shadowkin’s internal chaos and suppress them with all its might.
Otherwise, the day the shadowkin completed their unification would be the day catastrophe descended upon the empire!
Daniel already had a few ideas in mind.
Leading the group of human powerhouses, he flew toward the region where the six-star Abyss Rift was located.
Looking up, they saw a pitch-black giant city standing at the edge of sight.
Its walls were covered in spikes and skulls.
On either side of the city gate stood two demonic statues over a hundred meters tall, radiating a suffocating pressure.
The moment the human powerhouses appeared, six terrifying auras burst out from the city.
"So it’s humans!
Have you come here to die?
Hahaha!"
"If you’ve come intending to betray humanity, then perhaps we can consider taking you in!"
"Enough nonsense.
All humans deserve to die!
Kill them!"
The six shadowkin legendary-grade experts quickly reached a consensus and lunged at them at once.
The blood feud between the two races was too deep to measure.
It was either your death or mine.
Carodion fought one against two at the same time, blocking both a high-rank and an early-rank shadowkin expert.
Tiana faced a mid-rank shadowkin.
Cole and Upton entangled two early-rank opponents.
Aliris was also locked in fierce combat with another legendary-grade early-rank shadowkin.
Daniel brought Marco with him and headed straight for the early-rank shadowkin who was being held back by Carodion.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
[Aetherlance]!
Within mere seconds, that early-rank shadowkin was killed.
[Ding!
You have slain a shadowkin commander!
Obtained "Lower Divinity Fragment (legendary-grade)" x1!
Obtained "Demon General Bracers (legendary-grade)" x1!
Obtained "Demon General War Armor (legendary-grade)" x1!
Contribution Points +30,000!
Gold Coins +120,000!]
Daniel did not stop.
Bringing Marco with him, he headed straight for Tiana’s battlefield.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
Marco and Tiana attacked at the same time.
With Daniel supporting from the side, the mid-rank shadowkin was quickly slain as well.
[Ding!
You have slain a shadowkin commander!
Obtained "Higher Divinity Fragment (legendary-grade)" x1!
Obtained "Infernal War Armor (legendary-grade)" x1!
Obtained "Infernal War Boots (legendary-grade)" x1!
Contribution Points +180,000!
Gold Coins +210,000!]

chapters.title: Chapter 111 -111-As One Side Fell, the Other Was Reborn
paragraphs: "You two, go help Carodion."
Daniel spoke to Tiana and Marco.
The two of them nodded and immediately shot toward Carodion’s position.
Facing two opponents alone, Carodion was not at a disadvantage, but he was still under considerable pressure.
The moment the two fresh reinforcements joined the battle, the situation reversed instantly.
The human powerhouses began suppressing the two shadowkin on the other side, and the scales of victory rapidly tilted in their favor.
Daniel only took one glance before putting his mind at ease.
His figure flashed, and he appeared beside Aliris.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
With perfect coordination, Aliris followed up with a sword slash.
A few seconds later, that early-stage shadowkin powerhouse died.
However, before Daniel could even check the loot, a world announcement instantly shattered his train of thought—
[Urgent Global Announcement!!!]
[The vice Watcher of the nine-star Abyss Rift, legendary-grade powerhouse "Lucian," has fallen in battle!]
[The vice Watcher of the nine-star Abyss Rift, legendary-grade powerhouse "Evelyn," has fallen in battle!]
[The vice Watcher of the nine-star Abyss Rift, legendary-grade powerhouse "Theodore," has fallen in battle!]
The three announcements exploded one after another like three tolls of a funeral bell.
Daniel tightened his grip on Stellar Wrath, his knuckles turning white.
The danger of a nine-star Abyss Rift far exceeded imagination.
Just how many shadowkin powerhouses had gathered there, to actually cause three Human Watchers to fall at once?
He took a deep breath and forced himself to calm down.
But on second thought, this might also be a good thing.
The more legendary-grade powerhouses died, the stronger the forces under his command would become.
When he revived those human powerhouses one by one, then appeared on the battlefield with an army made entirely of legendary-grade experts—
The expression on that shadowkin overlord Baal’s face would surely be priceless.
A faint smile curled at Daniel’s lips, and a cold light flashed in his eyes.
Daniel pulled out the [Banner of Valor], embroidered with stars, from his backpack. The flag rippled violently in the dark winds of the abyss.
[Prompt: Spend 30,000 gold coins to condense the lingering souls of the three fallen legendary-grade human powerhouses?]
"Yes."

[Prompt: Soul condensation successful! The item is now temporarily storing the lingering souls of: "Lucian (legendary-grade, high-tier)," "Evelyn (legendary-grade, mid-tier)," and "Theodore (legendary-grade, low-tier)"!]
Daniel continued the process, his expression calm as still water.
[Prompt: Spend 30,000 gold coins to convert the lingering souls of the three powerhouses into relics?]
"Yes."
[Prompt: Soul conversion complete!]
He put the battle banner back into his backpack, then cast the forbidden spell [Seraphic Revival]!
[Prompt: Spend 30,000 gold coins to revive the three human powerhouses?]
"Yes."
[Ding! Successfully revived three human powerhouses!]
Three faint silhouettes gradually solidified within the light.
When the radiance faded, the three armored human powerhouses opened their eyes at the same time.
Lucian was the first to recover his senses.
He lowered his head to look at his own hands, then glanced at the surrounding scene. Bewilderment flashed through his eyes, but a moment later, he dropped to one knee.
"Lucian is willing to brave fire and water for you, my lord!"
Evelyn and Theodore followed suit, kneeling on one knee as well.
"We are willing to brave fire and water for you, my lord!"
Daniel nodded and pointed toward the distant battlefield, where the fighting was still raging.
"I’ll trouble you all to heavily injure those shadowkin powerhouses. Leave the finishing blow to me."
"As you wish!"
The three figures turned into streaks of light and shot straight into enemy lines.
At the edge of the battlefield, the surviving shadowkin warriors witnessed everything. Their eyes widened, their faces full of disbelief.
"What is going on? How did three more legendary-grade powerhouses appear in the blink of an eye?!"
"They... where did they come from? Could that human be some kind of spatial mage?"

"This isn’t right! If they had enough power to crush this shadowkin stronghold outright, there’d be no reason for them to hide these people until now. Something is wrong with those newly appeared powerhouses!"
"I don’t know the exact reason, but this information must be reported to the Overlord!"
No one paid any attention to their inward cries of alarm.
Lucian, Evelyn, and Theodore had already charged into the battlefield, standing shoulder to shoulder with Carodion and the others.
Eight against three!
This was a battle with no suspense whatsoever.
In just a few dozen breaths, the three shadowkin powerhouses who had been struggling desperately were beaten to the brink of death.
"My lord! Now is the time to strike!"
Carodion blasted one high-tier shadowkin powerhouse to the verge of death.
Daniel’s figure instantly appeared in front of that shadowkin powerhouse.
[Aetherlance]!
A golden bolt of light pierced straight through its skull.
[Ding! Shadowkin Commander slain! Obtained "Intermediate Divinity Fragment (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Wrath Demon Armor (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Wrath Demon Blade (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Contribution Points +130,000! Gold Coins +160,000!]
He did not stop, spreading his wings as he swept toward another section of the battlefield.
Carodion, Lucian, and Tiana had already cornered the final two shadowkin powerhouses in the center.
The two of them were covered in blood, and the Immortal Singularity within their bodies had long since been exhausted. They were only one last strike away from death.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
Invisible chains of wind surged out of the void, binding the two shadowkin powerhouses tightly in place.
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
Dark clouds gathered as tens of thousands of thunder serpents poured down from above.
The last two shadowkin powerhouses died on the spot.
[Ding! Shadowkin Commander slain! Obtained "Intermediate Divinity Fragment (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Greed Armor (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Greed Spear (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Contribution Points +130,000! Gold Coins +190,000!]
[Ding! Shadowkin Commander slain! Obtained "Superior Divinity Fragment (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Helm of Pride (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Shield of Pride (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Heavenscar Ticket" ×1! Contribution Points +260,000! Gold Coins +350,000!]
Daniel stored all the spoils in his backpack, then lifted his eyes toward the pitch-black shadowkin castle in the distance.
The walls were packed shoulder to shoulder with shadowkin warriors, numbering in the millions.

They watched helplessly as their legendary-grade powerhouses fell one after another. Their eyes were filled with terror, yet they still gripped their weapons tightly and refused to retreat even a single step.
Daniel’s face remained expressionless as he raised Stellar Wrath.
[Arrowstorm]!
[Shattering Comet]!
[Aetherlance]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
The four skills bloomed at the same time, transforming into over a thousand attacks that poured down like an apocalyptic natural disaster.
Arrows, fire rain, light spears, and thunder serpents wove together into a net of death that blanketed the entire castle.
Crimson damage numbers cascaded down like a waterfall.
The city walls collapsed amid deafening roars. Arrow towers turned to ashes in the flames. The millions of shadowkin warriors were crushed like ants beneath that rain of death.
[Ding! Killed shadowkin elite-grade ×976! Obtained Gold Coins +1,360,000!
Obtained "Gluttony Armor (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Demonwar Blade (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Infernal Bracers (legendary-grade)" ×1!]
[Ding! Killed shadowkin warrior! Obtained Gold Coins +2,790,000! ...]
The system notifications surged in like a tidal wave, and Daniel directly turned off the repeated prompts.
An entire castle of a million shadowkin—
Slaughtered by one man alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 112 -112-The First Legendary-Grade Transcendent Powerhouse
paragraphs: [Global Announcement!!!]
[Player "Faustus" of World Zone 616 has successfully destroyed a six-star Abyss Rift shadowkin castle! Achievement completed: "Pillar of Humanity"!]
The announcement rang out three times in a row, like three bolts of lightning tearing through dark clouds.
The World Channel instantly exploded.
"??? What do you mean by this? Big shot, you’re only making the rest of us look useless!"
"Lord Faustus, don’t do this to us—leave at least a little soup for us to drink, okay?!"
"I just crawled out of a one-star Abyss Rift after dying there. We didn’t even get a clear look at what the shadowkin boss looked like before our whole party was wiped!"
"It’s infuriating comparing people to people. We’re all old players from the same launch batch, yet we nearly die clearing a one-star Abyss Rift, while he treats it like eating and drinking!"
"Come on, of all people to compare yourself to, you chose Lord Faustus?"
[Ding! You have completed the achievement "Pillar of Humanity"! Achievement reward: Ascension Stone (legendary-grade) ×3!]
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
He had already obtained one Ascension Stone back in the five-star Abyss Rift.
With these three added in, he now had a total of four—just enough to give several of the legendary-grade powerhouses under his command the potential to advance to supreme-grade!
[Ding! You sold Ascension Stone (legendary-grade) ×3 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The item sold belongs to the Special Materials category. Please choose: quality boost / quantity boost!]
"Quality boost!"
[Ding! Congratulations! You obtained 3 gold coins! You obtained "Ascendant Starstone (supreme-grade)" ×3!]
He summoned Upton, Marco, Cole, and Theodore, distributing the four Ascendant Starstones among them.
"Raise your strength as quickly as possible to deal with the invasion of the shadowkin and the non-human races."
The four powerhouses accepted the crystals gratefully and used them at once.
Soon, four flashes of light passed through their bodies, and their auras surged sharply upward.
Upton opened his eyes and felt the power coursing within him. He could clearly sense that he had taken a massive step closer to that final threshold.
His eyes were filled with excitement.
"Thank you, my lord!"
A faint smile appeared on Daniel’s lips.
Among the eight powerhouses under his command, Carodion and Lucian were high-tier, while the other six had all advanced to the mid-tier.
Even across the entire empire, this was a force that could not be ignored.
"As expected, war is the fastest path to greater strength."
He raised his head and looked deeper into the Abyss Rift.
"Move quickly. We’re heading to the next one!"
"Yes, my lord!"
Seven-star Abyss Rift.
The moment Daniel and the others appeared above the shadowkin castle, seven terrifying auras shot up from within the city.
Two high-tier, two mid-tier, and three low-tier!
The seven legendary-grade shadowkin powerhouses stood in a row, their faces dark as they stared at them.
"Humans!"
The leading high-tier shadowkin ground his teeth. "What is the meaning of this?"
Daniel did not answer.
"Kill."
His voice was calm as still water.
In the next instant, the eight human powerhouses shot forward like unsheathed blades.
This battle began quickly—and ended even more quickly!
Only a few minutes later—
All seven legendary-grade shadowkin powerhouses had fallen.
The several million warriors inside the shadowkin castle were completely reduced to ashes beneath Daniel’s rain of arrows!
[Ding! Shadowkin Commander slain! Obtained "Superior Divinity Fragment (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Wrath Battle Armor (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Greed Bracers (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Heavenscar Ticket" ×1!
Contribution Points +260,000! Gold Coins +360,000!]
[Ding! Shadowkin Commander slain! Obtained "Superior Divinity Fragment (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Gluttony Helm (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Mana Bracers (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Heavenscar Ticket" ×1! Contribution Points +240,000! Gold Coins +360,000!]
[Ding! Shadowkin Commander slain!
Obtained Gold Coins +160,000! Obtained "Infernal Armor (legendary-grade)" ×1!]
[Ding! Shadowkin Commander slain!
Obtained Gold Coins +170,000! Obtained "Infernal Blade (legendary-grade)" ×1!]
[Ding! Shadowkin Commander slain!
Obtained Gold Coins +170,000! Obtained "Greed Grasp (legendary-grade)" ×1!]
[Global Announcement!!!]
[Player "Faustus" of World Zone 616 has successfully destroyed a seven-star Abyss Rift castle! Achievement completed: "Demon Adjudicator"!]
[Ding! Achievement reward obtained: Ascension Stone (legendary-grade) ×4!]
Daniel’s breathing stalled slightly.
This time, he had truly struck it rich!
The achievement reward had actually yielded so many Ascension Stones—these were priceless treasures capable of helping someone break past their limits and ascend to a higher realm!
[Ding! You sold Ascension Stone (legendary-grade) ×4 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The item sold belongs to the Special Materials category. Please choose: quality boost / quantity boost!]
"Quality boost!"
[Ding! Congratulations! You obtained 4 gold coins! You obtained "Ascendant Starstone (supreme-grade)" ×4!]
"Raise your strength as quickly as possible."
He handed the Ascendant Starstones to Carodion, Lucian, Tiana, and Evelyn!
The four powerhouses accepted the crystals, excitement flashing through their eyes.
"Thank you, my lord!"
Golden light flashed, and the four auras surged upward at the same time.
Carodion opened his eyes, and an invisible pressure spread out from his body.
That was the aura of a transcendent powerhouse!
With the enhancement of the Ascendant Starstone, he had actually advanced directly from a legendary-grade high-tier powerhouse to a legendary-grade transcendent powerhouse!
Evelyn, Lucian, and Tiana also completed their advancement, becoming standouts among legendary-grade high-tier powerhouses.
Lucian in particular could feel that it would not be long before he, too, broke through to the transcendent realm!
As Daniel gazed at the team under his command, boundless ambition surged in his heart.
One transcendent, three high-tier, four mid-tier.
Such a force was enough to shake the world!
But he was not satisfied.
At present, whether in the number or quality of the powerhouses under his command, he was still far from the point where he could truly look down on all existence.
"The next target: the eight-star Abyss Rift!"
"We are willing to follow you through life and death, my lord!"
All eight struck their chests in salute, blazing battle intent burning in their eyes!
Eight-star Abyss Rift.
Within Godscar, the human and shadowkin powerhouses were locked in fierce combat.
The eight powerhouses under Daniel’s command were fighting nine legendary-grade shadowkin powerhouses in a chaotic melee.
The numbers on both sides were close, but the humans had the transcendent powerhouse Carodion anchoring their side, so they held the upper hand from the very beginning.
Soon, Daniel found the perfect moment and cut across into the battlefield.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
His appearance was like the final boulder that crushed the camel’s back.
Within minutes, three low-tier shadowkin powerhouses were bound and slain.
The two mid-tier powerhouses likewise failed to hold out for long under the siege of five human powerhouses.
Next came that high-tier shadowkin Grand Lord!
[Wind’s Embrace]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
Carodion and Lucian struck at the same time, their two swords coming from left and right, driving that high-tier powerhouse into a desperate corner.
A streak of golden light shot forward at an angle that could not be evaded, plunging straight into the shadowkin powerhouse’s brain!
[Ding! Shadowkin Grand Lord slain! Obtained "Superior Divinity Fragment (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Lust Thorn (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Lust Blade (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Heavenscar Ticket" ×1!
Contribution Points +380,000! Gold Coins +450,000!]

What do you mean by this?
Big shot, you’re only making the rest of us look useless!"
"Lord Faustus, don’t do this to us—leave at least a little soup for us to drink, okay?!"
"I just crawled out of a one-star Abyss Rift after dying there.
We didn’t even get a clear look at what the shadowkin boss looked like before our whole party was wiped!"
"It’s infuriating comparing people to people.
We’re all old players from the same launch batch, yet we nearly die clearing a one-star Abyss Rift, while he treats it like eating and drinking!"
"Come on, of all people to compare yourself to, you chose Lord Faustus?"

You have completed the achievement "Pillar of Humanity"!
Achievement reward: Ascension Stone (legendary-grade) ×3!]
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
He had already obtained one Ascension Stone back in the five-star Abyss Rift.
With these three added in, he now had a total of four—just enough to give several of the legendary-grade powerhouses under his command the potential to advance to supreme-grade!

He summoned Upton, Marco, Cole, and Theodore, distributing the four Ascendant Starstones among them.
"Raise your strength as quickly as possible to deal with the invasion of the shadowkin and the non-human races."
The four powerhouses accepted the crystals gratefully and used them at once.
Soon, four flashes of light passed through their bodies, and their auras surged sharply upward.
Upton opened his eyes and felt the power coursing within him.
He could clearly sense that he had taken a massive step closer to that final threshold.
His eyes were filled with excitement.
"Thank you, my lord!"
A faint smile appeared on Daniel’s lips.
Among the eight powerhouses under his command, Carodion and Lucian were high-tier, while the other six had all advanced to the mid-tier.
Even across the entire empire, this was a force that could not be ignored.
"As expected, war is the fastest path to greater strength."
He raised his head and looked deeper into the Abyss Rift.
"Move quickly.
We’re heading to the next one!"
"Yes, my lord!"
Seven-star Abyss Rift.
The moment Daniel and the others appeared above the shadowkin castle, seven terrifying auras shot up from within the city.
Two high-tier, two mid-tier, and three low-tier!
The seven legendary-grade shadowkin powerhouses stood in a row, their faces dark as they stared at them.
"Humans!"
The leading high-tier shadowkin ground his teeth.
"What is the meaning of this?"
Daniel did not answer.
"Kill."
His voice was calm as still water.
In the next instant, the eight human powerhouses shot forward like unsheathed blades.
This battle began quickly—and ended even more quickly!
Only a few minutes later—
All seven legendary-grade shadowkin powerhouses had fallen.
The several million warriors inside the shadowkin castle were completely reduced to ashes beneath Daniel’s rain of arrows!

Evelyn, Lucian, and Tiana also completed their advancement, becoming standouts among legendary-grade high-tier powerhouses.

chapters.title: Chapter 113 -113-Forging Glory with Flesh and Blood
paragraphs: In the end, only that transcendent shadowkin Grand Lord remained on the battlefield!

The eight human powerhouses surrounded him completely. Carodion met him head-on, Lucian and Tiana attacked from the left and right, while Aliris and the others waited for openings to harass and strike.
And as for Daniel—his [Wind’s Embrace] never stopped for even a moment.
One minute.
Just one minute!
That transcendent shadowkin powerhouse died in hatred beneath endless restraint and relentless siege.
[Ding! Shadowkin Grand Lord slain! Obtained "Superior Divinity Fragment (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Abyss Battle Armor (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Abyss Protection (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Heavenscar Ticket" ×1!
Contribution Points +450,000! Gold Coins +510,000!]
Daniel did not stop.
He flew above the shadowkin castle and raised Stellar Wrath.
[Arrowstorm]!
[Shattering Comet]!
[Aetherlance]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
A million shadowkin warriors turned to ash beneath the rain of arrows.
[Ding! Shadowkin elite slain! Obtained Gold Coins +10,460,000! Obtained "Infernal Battle Armor (legendary-grade)" ×1!]
[Ding! Shadowkin warrior slain! Obtained Gold Coins +3,240,000! Obtained "Infernal Venom Sword (legendary-grade)" ×1!]
[Ding! Shadowkin priest slain! Obtained Gold Coins +4,640,000! Obtained "Demonhowl Bracers (legendary-grade)" ×1!]
[Global Announcement!!!]
[Player "Faustus" of World Zone 616 has successfully destroyed an eight-star Abyss Rift castle! Achievement completed: "Hell Inquisitor"!]
[Ding! Achievement reward obtained: Ascension Stone (legendary-grade) ×8!]
Daniel stared at the system prompt, momentarily dazed.
Another eight Ascension Stones!
[Ding! You sold Ascension Stone (legendary-grade) ×8 to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The item sold belongs to the Special Materials category. Please choose: quality boost / quantity boost!]
"Quality boost!"
[Ding! Congratulations! You obtained 8 gold coins! You obtained "Ascendant Starstone (supreme-grade)" ×8!]
As a top-tier material, the Ascendant Starstone could actually be used repeatedly, and repeated use could greatly accelerate the speed of advancement. However, very few people ever used it that way.
The reason was simple—it was far too difficult to obtain!
But for Daniel, things were different. He had plenty of opportunities and channels to acquire this supreme treasure, and through the system, he could even amplify it into supreme-grade.
Even if he used all of them to help the powerhouses under his command advance, he would not feel the slightest bit of regret!
In the crumbling world they now faced, strength was king!
Looking at the eight Ascendant Starstones in his hand, Daniel’s lips curled upward.
This meant that he would now command four transcendent elites and four high-tier elites.
Before the eight-star Abyss Rift, he had possessed one transcendent, three high-tier, and four mid-tier powerhouses...
Now, he had four transcendent and four high-tier.
The speed of this rise in strength could only be described as a one-step ascent to the heavens!
He distributed the Ascendant Starstones one by one.
Golden flashes lit up in succession, and each burst of light signified that another powerhouse had undergone a complete rebirth!

When the final ray of golden light faded, Daniel looked at the team before him—a force made up of four transcendent powerhouses and four high-tier powerhouses—and boundless ambition surged in his chest.
"Next, we head to the nine-star Abyss Rift to meet those shadowkin scum!"
Nine-star Abyss Rift, Infernal Fortress.
Godscar was like a giant overturned bowl, covering the entire sky.
This battlefield was vast enough to suffocate the soul, stretching across nearly the whole sky above the Abyss Rift.
Every few minutes, golden blood dripped from Godscar and poured down upon the earth like a torrential storm. Those were the traces left behind by fallen legendary-grade powerhouses.
How many experts were fighting within it?
How brutal had the battle become?
No one knew!
Just then, two corpses of legendary-grade powerhouses suddenly fell out of Godscar, crashing into the city below and kicking up clouds of dust.
"Glory eternal to the Overlord!"
"These human powerhouses are ridiculously hard to kill. They’re stubborn to the bitter end!"
"No problem. Our shadowkin have the advantage in numbers. There’s no need to panic at all!"
"Just wait—before long, the battle flags of the shadowkin will be planted in every corner of the Aetheria Continent!"
The shadowkin warriors looked up at that twisted sky, their fists clenched tight.
At the edge of Godscar, two figures fell from the sky in a wretched state and crashed into the human camp.
Julian and Hawke were both covered in blood, barely managing to steady themselves as they supported each other.
Julian’s left arm hung limply at an unnatural angle, while Hawke had a deep wound across his chest, so deep that bone could be seen. Golden blood was still seeping out without end.
"My lords, are you all right?"
"How serious are your injuries?"
More than a dozen human powerhouses gathered around them.
Every one of them was wounded. Some had lost a leg, some had gone blind in one eye, and some had half their bodies burned into charred black ruin.
The heavily injured lay sprawled on the ground, unable to move even a single finger without difficulty.
In this great war between the two races, the human side had deployed forty powerhouses, while the shadowkin had sent more than eighty.
And on the shadowkin side, there was even Baal, the overlord—a legendary-grade transcendent peak powerhouse!
From the very beginning of the clash, the humans had been suppressed by the shadowkin!
By now, three human powerhouses had already died, more than a dozen had been gravely wounded, and another twenty were still fighting desperately against the shadowkin within Godscar.
Julian coughed up several mouthfuls of golden blood, his eyes filled with grief.
"This time, the shadowkin are simply too powerful... the human race has almost no hope left!"
Hawke took over in a hoarse voice. "Our people are still forcing themselves to hold on... but not many of them can keep going much longer."
At this point, this high-tier legendary-grade powerhouse who had lived for centuries actually had red-rimmed eyes.
"We have failed those comrades who died in battle... failed the trust the people of the human race placed in us..."
Silence.
The scene fell into a deathly silence.
The dozen or so human powerhouses lowered their heads. Some had red eyes. Some collapsed weakly to the ground. Others stared up at that twisted sky, their eyes full of despair.
"How... how did the human race come to this?!" Julian’s grief-stricken voice echoed over the empty wasteland.
The human race had not been lacking in powerhouses to begin with.
But Winterhold in the northern frontier had tied down a considerable portion of their strength, while the Abyss Rifts in the south also required defenders.
These forty were already the limit of what the Empire could mobilize.
If they all fell here, then nothing would stand in the shadowkin’s way any longer. Their iron hooves would sweep across the entire human empire.
And without reinforcements, Winterhold in the north being breached by the sixfold host would only be a matter of time!
When that happened, the human race would be plunged into an abyss of eternal damnation!
A powerhouse wrapped all over in bandages suddenly stood up, his eyes burning with resolute fire.
"I cannot stand by and watch the inheritance of countless human ancestors be buried in our hands."
His voice was hoarse, yet firm. "In this battle, I am willing to perish together with the shadowkin and shed my last drop of blood for the human race!"
Before his words had even fully fallen, golden flames ignited across his body.
He was burning his Immortal Singularity—burning his very life!
He raised his head toward Godscar, a cold light flashing in his eyes, then leapt into that twisted sky.
Boom—!
A world-shaking explosion erupted from within Godscar, and even the distorted space itself rippled violently from the blast.
The self-destruction of a powerhouse was terrifying beyond measure. This was the human race’s final stubborn defiance!
"My friends, I’ll be going ahead as well!"
Another powerhouse rose to his feet, golden flames blazing fiercely around him.
She gave the others an elegant bow, then turned resolutely and charged into Godscar.
Boom—!
Boom—!
Boom—!
One explosion after another rang out from within Godscar.
With every blast, the corpse of a shadowkin powerhouse fell from the sky, smashing into the black earth and throwing up towering clouds of dust.
"Then let our flesh and blood forge the eternal immortality of the human race!"
The remaining powerhouses exchanged glances and simultaneously ignited the flames of life upon their bodies.
Streak after streak of golden figures shot across the sky like meteors, hurling themselves into that twisted battlefield.
The explosions continued without end, while shadowkin corpses rained down like falling stars.
And from within Godscar also came the furious roar of the shadowkin overlord, Baal.
"Damn you humans! The day my shadowkin set foot upon the continent will be the day your human race is exterminated!"

chapters.title: Chapter 114 -114-The Return of the Dead, the Tide of Battle Turns
paragraphs: Daniel unfurled his Eternal Darkgold Wings. In the howling dark winds of the Abyss Rift, the dark-gold feathers snapped loudly in the air.
Leading the eight legendary-grade powerhouses under his command, he shot toward the nine-star Abyss Rift.
This time, he intended to wipe out the shadowkin threat once and for all.
Nine-Star Abyss Rift.
When Daniel descended upon this land shrouded in darkness, the sight before him made his heart tremble slightly.
The sky looked as though it had been torn apart.
A colossal Godscar hung overhead, so vast it was suffocating to behold. Like an inverted giant bowl, it covered the entire heavens.
Within that twisted expanse of space, bursts of multicolored light flashed from time to time—the aftershocks of clashes between legendary-grade powerhouses.
Every few moments, golden blood rained down from the battlefield above, pouring onto the scorched black earth like a storm.
At that very moment, one world announcement after another exploded across the sky like funeral bells.
[Emergency Global Announcement: Deputy Garrison Commander of the Nine-Star Abyss Rift, human legendary-grade powerhouse "Hawk," has fallen in battle!]
[Emergency Global Announcement: Deputy Garrison Commander of the Nine-Star Abyss Rift, human legendary-grade powerhouse "Julian," has fallen in battle!]
[Emergency Global Announcement: Deputy Garrison Commander of the Nine-Star Abyss Rift, human legendary-grade powerhouse "Bruno," has fallen in battle!]
One.
Two.
Five...
A total of twelve.
Since the launch of the game, there had never been such a dense succession of announcements reporting the deaths of legendary-grade powerhouses.
Each announcement marked the end of a life.
Each toll of the bell meant the loss of one of humanity’s greatest warriors.
Standing at the edge of the Godscar, Daniel gazed at that distorted sky, the killing intent in his eyes nearly solid enough to take form.
"You go in first and assist the human powerhouses in holding back the shadowkin."
Carodion, Lucian, Tiana, and the others nodded. In the next instant, they transformed into eight streaks of light and plunged straight into the twisted battlefield.
Daniel withdrew his gaze and took the [Banner of Valor] from his backpack.
Stars were embroidered across the banner’s surface, and in the dark winds of the Abyss Rift, it fluttered sharply.
Closing his eyes, he sensed the remnant souls of the twelve fallen human powerhouses who had just perished.
They seemed to still be drifting in the wind.
[Notice: Spend 1.2 billion gold coins to condense the remnant souls of twelve human legendary-grade powerhouses?]
"Yes."
Golden light spread out from the war banner like an invisible net, gathering those remnant souls one by one before they could fade away.
[Notice: Remnant soul condensation successful! Remnant souls captured: Hawk, Julian, Bruno... twelve in total!]
Daniel opened his eyes and continued.
[Notice: Spend 1.2 billion gold coins to convert the remnant souls of these twelve powerhouses into relics?]
"Yes."
[Notice: Remnant soul conversion complete!]
He stowed the banner back into his inventory and cast Seraphic Revival.
Soon, pale golden light began to swirl before him, like sacred flames waiting to be kindled.
[Notice: Spend 1.2 billion gold coins to revive twelve human powerhouses?]
"Yes."
Golden radiance erupted before his eyes.
One figure after another stepped out from within the light.
Hawk. Julian. Bruno...
Every one of them wore a dazed expression, lowering their heads to look at their own hands.
Then, in unison, they dropped to one knee before Daniel.
"We pay our respects, my lord!"
Daniel nodded, his gaze sweeping across them one by one.
Among the twelve, four were high-grade, five were mid-grade, and three were low-grade.
Together with the four transcendent and four high-grade powerhouses he had already commanded, he now had twenty legendary-grade powerhouses under him.
"Follow me into the Godscar!"
His voice was calm as still water.
"Kill every shadowkin invader!"
Before the final word had even fallen, he had already spread his wings and shot toward that twisted sky.
The twelve resurrected powerhouses followed close behind, turning into twelve streaks of light as they entered the Godscar.
Outside the Godscar.
The surviving human powerhouses who witnessed everything were all dumbstruck.
Daniel’s arrival with his legion of powerhouses had already left the human defenders at the edge of the Godscar utterly stunned.
They had never imagined that humanity had been hiding so many high-grade combatants.
But what came next robbed them completely of speech.

Those comrades who had just moments ago died heroically before their eyes—blowing themselves up to perish together with the enemy—were now standing once more, alive and breathing, atop the ritual platform.
Familiar figures.
Faces burned deep into memory.
They stepped back into this blood-soaked sky through golden light.
"By the gods..."
An old veteran muttered under his breath, nearly dropping the longsword in his hand.
"By the gods... I’m not seeing things, am I? Weren’t those Julian and Hawk just now?"
"I saw Cole’s chest pierced through by a demon blade with my own eyes... How is he back?"
No one could answer.
Only stunned gazes passed silently from face to face.
"Not just them—Carodion, Tiana... weren’t they dead long ago? Have we fallen into some shadowkin nightmare? Are we all seeing the same illusion?"
"Could it be some kind of resurrection method?! We all saw that man pull them back from the altar!"
"Resurrection... That young man can actually revive legendary-grade powerhouses?"
The human warriors looked at each other, their eyes filled with shock and bewilderment.
Inside the Godscar.
With the arrival of Carodion and the others, humanity’s crumbling battle line finally gained a chance to recover.
What stunned the human powerhouses even more, however, was that these newcomers were all old acquaintances.
"Carodion? Is that really you? Weren’t you...?"
"Lady Tiana? Didn’t you fall defending Winterhold?"
"And Evelyn too? You were clearly just..."
Bathed in blood from head to toe, the elderly Ansel swept his gaze over Carodion and the others, his heart surging like a storm-tossed sea.
These people had clearly died in battle.
So why had they appeared here again?
But he quickly noticed something strange.
Carodion’s eyes were empty and cold. When he looked at Ansel, there was not the slightest trace of their former friendship—only pure composure.
"They’ve probably been resurrected by someone,"
Ansel murmured in a low voice, his tone heavy with complicated emotion.
"But they’ve also lost all their memories."
While the human side was still reeling in shock, chaos had already erupted among the shadowkin.
"That’s impossible! Weren’t those humans already dead? How are they standing again?!"
"And their auras... those four are transcendent legendary-grade? What kind of joke is this?!"
"Four transcendents and four high-grades... where did humanity suddenly pull so many powerhouses from?!"
The shadowkin formation began to waver.
The numerical advantage they had been so proud of vanished in an instant.
And at the deepest part of the battlefield, the shadowkin overlord Baal was currently locked in combat with two human transcendent powerhouses.
Even so, he held the absolute upper hand, for he was a Peak Transcendent legendary-grade existence—the strongest among all the warriors of both races present on the battlefield.
But when his gaze swept over the newly arrived human reinforcements, his expression finally changed.
Because he recognized several of those faces.
Some of them were people he had personally slain.
And yet now, they stood there alive upon the battlefield once more, their auras even stronger than they had been in life.

sentences.text: Daniel unfurled his Eternal Darkgold Wings.
In the howling dark winds of the Abyss Rift, the dark-gold feathers snapped loudly in the air.
Leading the eight legendary-grade powerhouses under his command, he shot toward the nine-star Abyss Rift.
This time, he intended to wipe out the shadowkin threat once and for all.
Nine-Star Abyss Rift.
When Daniel descended upon this land shrouded in darkness, the sight before him made his heart tremble slightly.
The sky looked as though it had been torn apart.
A colossal Godscar hung overhead, so vast it was suffocating to behold.
Like an inverted giant bowl, it covered the entire heavens.
Within that twisted expanse of space, bursts of multicolored light flashed from time to time—the aftershocks of clashes between legendary-grade powerhouses.
Every few moments, golden blood rained down from the battlefield above, pouring onto the scorched black earth like a storm.
At that very moment, one world announcement after another exploded across the sky like funeral bells.
[Emergency Global Announcement: Deputy Garrison Commander of the Nine-Star Abyss Rift, human legendary-grade powerhouse "Hawk," has fallen in battle!]
[Emergency Global Announcement: Deputy Garrison Commander of the Nine-Star Abyss Rift, human legendary-grade powerhouse "Julian," has fallen in battle!]
[Emergency Global Announcement: Deputy Garrison Commander of the Nine-Star Abyss Rift, human legendary-grade powerhouse "Bruno," has fallen in battle!]
One.
Two.
Five...
A total of twelve.
Since the launch of the game, there had never been such a dense succession of announcements reporting the deaths of legendary-grade powerhouses.
Each announcement marked the end of a life.
Each toll of the bell meant the loss of one of humanity’s greatest warriors.
Standing at the edge of the Godscar, Daniel gazed at that distorted sky, the killing intent in his eyes nearly solid enough to take form.
"You go in first and assist the human powerhouses in holding back the shadowkin."
Carodion, Lucian, Tiana, and the others nodded.
In the next instant, they transformed into eight streaks of light and plunged straight into the twisted battlefield.
Daniel withdrew his gaze and took the [Banner of Valor] from his backpack.
Stars were embroidered across the banner’s surface, and in the dark winds of the Abyss Rift, it fluttered sharply.
Closing his eyes, he sensed the remnant souls of the twelve fallen human powerhouses who had just perished.
They seemed to still be drifting in the wind.
[Notice: Spend 1.2 billion gold coins to condense the remnant souls of twelve human legendary-grade powerhouses?]

Golden light spread out from the war banner like an invisible net, gathering those remnant souls one by one before they could fade away.

Daniel opened his eyes and continued.

"Yes."
[Notice: Remnant soul conversion complete!]

Soon, pale golden light began to swirl before him, like sacred flames waiting to be kindled.

Golden radiance erupted before his eyes.

Julian.

chapters.title: Chapter 115 -115-The Final Battle — Slaying the Overlord Baal
paragraphs: "That’s impossible!"
Baal let out a furious roar. With a single slash, he forced back the opponent before him, then fixed his gaze on those resurrected human powerhouses.
"I cut off your heads with my own hands! I watched you get blasted into dust with my own eyes!"
No one answered him.
Only an even fiercer wave of attacks came crashing down like a flood.
And just as Baal was barely managing to steady his footing, another twelve streaks of light appeared at the edge of the Godscar.
Daniel had returned to the battlefield, leading the twelve powerhouses he had just revived.
Baal’s pupils contracted sharply.
He recognized every one of those twelve people.
Every single one of them should have been a corpse long since dead.
Even the shattered remains of their bodies were still scattered across the battlefield.
"What kind of joke is this?!"
Baal felt an overwhelming sense of futility, as though all his efforts had come to nothing.
He had spent an enormous price and paid grievous costs to slaughter the human powerhouses one by one.
And now not only had all of them come back to life, they had even grown stronger!?
Worse still, who knew whether they might revive again after dying?
By now, both sides had already suffered catastrophic losses in this battle.
But at the sight of these familiar reinforcements, Baal hesitated.
"Kill every shadowkin!"
Daniel’s voice echoed through the Godscar, cold and resolute.
"As you command, my lord!"
All twenty legendary-grade powerhouses answered in unison, like twenty unsheathed blades lunging toward their respective prey.
The balance of the battlefield began to shift.
Originally, the human side had fewer than thirty powerhouses desperately holding the line. Now, with the twenty reinforcements Daniel had brought, their total had exceeded forty.
On the shadowkin side, after round upon round of bloody fighting, they had only a little over forty powerhouses left.
The two sides were now evenly matched in number.
But in terms of quality, the humans had four transcendent and eight high-grade powerhouses, while most of the shadowkin’s top-tier combat strength had already been exhausted in the earlier slaughter.
The scales of victory were visibly tilting toward humanity.
Daniel did not remain at the edge of the battlefield to watch.
With God Speed activated, his figure flashed continuously through the Godscar, and in the blink of an eye he arrived at Carodion’s side.
Carodion was currently locked in battle with a shadowkin high-grade powerhouse.
Golden sword-light and dark crimson demonic flames intertwined, tearing crack after crack through the surrounding space.
Daniel raised Stellar Wrath.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
Invisible chains of wind surged out from the void, binding that shadowkin high-grade overlord in place.
Pale golden runes flowed along the chains, each one containing an ancient law of wind.
The shadowkin overlord’s eyes widened in shock as he discovered that he could not even move a finger.
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
Storm clouds gathered in an instant, and tens of thousands of lightning serpents poured down from the sky.
Carodion raised the longsword in his hand high overhead, and a golden sword beam condensed from Immortal Singularity came crashing down.
"Divine Judgment!"
Within only a few breaths, that shadowkin high legendary-grade powerhouse was reduced to ashes amid an unwilling howl.
[Ding! You have slain a shadowkin overlord! Obtained: "High-tier Divinity Fragment (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained: "Wrath Warblade (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained: "Wrath Warhammer (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained: "Heavenscar Pass" ×1!
Contribution Points +400,000! Gold coins +500,000!]
Daniel did not pause.
His gaze swept rapidly across the battlefield, locking onto one target after another.
"Go after the high-grades first. Break open the situation as fast as possible,"
he said quickly to Carodion.
"As you command."
Although those shadowkin high-grade powerhouses could break free from [Wind’s Embrace], every attempt to do so consumed a large amount of Immortal Singularity.
Transcendent powerhouses, however, were different. They possessed enough methods and foundation to easily break his restraints.
So for Daniel, killing high-grades offered the greatest efficiency.
The two of them worked together with perfect coordination, as though they were a single person.
Daniel provided control and suppression. Carodion dealt devastating frontal damage. In the end, Daniel delivered the finishing blow.
Two. Three...
In less than half an hour, fifteen shadowkin high-grades and twenty-five shadowkin mid-grades had fallen to their hands.
At the deepest part of the battlefield, the shadowkin overlord Baal was being besieged by more than twenty human powerhouses.
His body was covered in wounds, and purple blood seeped constantly from the gashes.
Even a Peak Transcendent powerhouse could not hold out forever when surrounded by dozens of legendary-grade opponents.
His counterattacks were growing weaker and weaker, and his defenses more and more fragile.
Daniel turned his gaze toward this final Boss and cast a detection skill.
[Shadowkin Overlord · Baal (Peak Transcendent · legendary-grade)]
Level: ???
Attack: ???
Defense: ???
Skills: ???

Description: The overlord of the shadowkin, a supreme powerhouse at Peak Transcendent legendary-grade. He commands the shadowkin, rules over thirty-six shadowkin overlords, and controls the immortal power hidden in the deepest reaches of the abyss.
Daniel frowned slightly.
This was the first time he had encountered an enemy whose detailed attributes could not be read by his detection skill.
As expected of the shadowkin overlord.
"Kill him, and half of humanity’s crisis will be resolved."
He narrowed his eyes, and a burning gleam flashed within them.
He could not help but wonder what kind of treasure a Peak Transcendent Boss might drop.
A few minutes later, Baal finally could not endure any longer.
Driven into a corner by the human powerhouses, the Immortal Singularity within his body was nearly exhausted, and there were too many wounds on him to count.
Every exchange of blows left a fresh wound on his body.
"Lord Faustus!"
Carodion shouted loudly.
Daniel’s figure instantly appeared before Baal.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
Baal was bound fast by the chains of wind, utterly unable to move.
He glared viciously at Daniel, his eyes filled with humiliation and unwillingness.
"You damned insect... all you know is how to hide in the back and rely on cheap tricks!"
Those were the last words he left in this world.
Boom—!
The body of the shadowkin overlord Baal exploded beneath the lightning, shattering into countless fragments across the sky!
[Ding! You have slain the shadowkin overlord Boss "Baal"! Gained EXP +3,000,000,000, Contribution Points +1,000,000, Gold coins +2,000,000!]
[Obtained "High-tier Divinity Fragment" ×10!
Obtained "Heavenscar Pass" ×10!
Obtained SSS-rank class forbidden art "Permafrost Prison" ×1!
Obtained "Ring of Space (legendary-grade)" ×1!
Obtained "Immortal Singularity Fragment" ×10!]
[Ding! Your mission "Twilight of the Empire" completion progress: 1/2.]
[Global Announcement!!!]
[Player "Faustus" from World Region No. 616 has successfully slain the shadowkin overlord "Baal"! Becoming the first player to kill a Peak Transcendent legendary-grade powerhouse!]
[Special reward granted to this player: honorary achievement "Human Watcher"!]
[Global Announcement!!!]
[Player "Faustus" from World Region No. 616 has successfully crushed the shadowkin invasion!! Special reward granted to all players in World Region No. 616: Double EXP for 48 hours!]
