chapters.title: Chapter 125 -125-The Official Dissolution of Ragnarok Guild
paragraphs: "Duke Faustus... truly is an extraordinary man!"
"He is a great archer, and an even greater warrior."
"Mom, Duke Faustus is an archer, right? So how can he also be a warrior?"
"Hahaha... anyone who fights for justice is the bravest kind of warrior!"
A little boy wiped his nose with his sleeve and looked up at the statue with eyes full of longing.

"He killed the Shadowkin Overlord and destroyed the alliance of non-human races... When I grow up, I want to become a great warrior like Duke Faustus too—to protect the Empire and protect the human race!"
"Starting today, I have one more idol, and that’s Duke Faustus!"
"Give me a break. You get a new idol every other day!"
"Pah, stop talking nonsense. Tomorrow I’m packing my things and heading to Polaris City to contribute my Strength to the development of my idol’s territory!"
"Well said, my friend. I’m planning the same thing. And I heard that Polaris City’s construction and development are flourishing right now—the perks there is excellent!"
"Count me in. I just want to go over there and take a look!"
Temple of the Gods.
Clang, clang, clang...
Weapons slipped from the hands of the gathered powerhouses and fell to the ground one after another, producing crisp metallic sounds.
Each of them stood there dumbfounded, unable to react for a long time.
"Duke Faustus... destroyed the spatial passage to the Undead Realm? The Undead Cataclysm... was stopped just like that?"
"I’m not dreaming, am I? Why does this feel so unreal?"
"Faustus... I remember him. During the battle at the nine-star Abyss Rift, we crossed paths with him."
"I remember too. Back then, we even fought alongside him and killed the allied forces of the non-human races."
"This is simply too unbelievable. He’s just an adventurer—how could he possibly shatter the Undead Realm’s spatial passage?"
"Exactly. Setting aside how difficult it is to destroy the passage, just locating it would require enormous time and effort... How on earth did he do it?"
"Hahaha... wonderful. Duke Faustus truly is a hero of the Empire and of humanity."
"Yes. He saved the Empire, and he saved humanity as well... truly a person worthy of respect!"
When these Temple of the Gods powerhouses first received the news of the Undead Realm’s invasion, they had still been worrying about how much devastation this calamity would bring upon the Empire.
And yet in the blink of an eye, the catastrophe had been erased by a single adventurer.
They were shocked and confused—but even more than that, they felt joy and respect.
Imperial Capital, Royal Palace.
The aged Emperor was glowing with vigor, as if he had suddenly become ten years younger.
Standing before the great hall, his voice rang out like a bell.
"Men! Deliver my decree—send an envoy and reward Duke Faustus with one blackgold-grade gold mine!"
A minister stepped forward trembling, then spoke cautiously.
"Your Majesty... You have already dispatched three envoys and rewarded Duke Faustus three times with various mineral resources..."
The Emperor froze for a moment, then burst into loud laughter.
"Then send ten more envoys for me! See what else can be rewarded, and send all of it to Duke Faustus!"
The minister did not know whether to laugh or cry, but could only bow and accept the order.
"As you wish, Your Majesty."
Multiversal World Channel.
"Damn it! Why doesn’t our World Zone have someone like Faustus?!"
"World Zone 616 has gone too far! You people have a cheating monster like Faustus, but our World Zone 1213 doesn’t..."
"Forget destroying the Undead Realm’s spatial passage—we don’t even know where the passage is! This is seriously infuriating!"
"Exactly. If we could find where it was, I alone could complete this quest too!"
"Bitch, you sure are good at talking big. If I hadn’t seen that you were only level 24, I might actually have believed you!"
"You players from World Zone 616 don’t know how to play fair! You’re always relying on cheats to seize the advantage!"
"I refuse to accept this. Why do we have to fight the Undead Cataclysm while World Zone 616 doesn’t?"
"Friends from the other World Zones, have you noticed? All the good things go to World Zone 616, while all the bad things happen to us outsiders..."
"A bunch of idiots showing off their low-level superiority here. If you’re so capable, then do what they did. If you don’t have the ability, then shut up!"

"What exactly are you World Zone 616 players feeling superior about? Isn’t it just because you have Faustus? Put Faustus in our zone instead, and he’d still beat your World Zone 616 so badly you’d question your lives. Believe it or not?"
"The guy above is clearly just jealous. Case closed."
"Heh. You people are just lucky, that’s all..."
The news that Faustus’s statues had been erected in all nine main cities spread across the entirety of World Zone 616 like a raging storm.
Nine plazas. Nine statues!
That young archer holding a longbow and gazing toward the heavens had been forever fixed, in stone and bronze, into the sight of every player.
In the World Channel, amazement and doubt intertwined into a vast sea of chatter.
"By the gods... statues erected simultaneously in all nine main cities? This has to be the highest honor the Human Empire can bestow upon a player, right?"
"Is Great God Faustus about to ascend into legend?"
"It’s nothing but good luck. I could’ve done the same."
Someone muttered sourly.
"You? You can’t even beat the wild wolves outside the Starter Village."
"Hahaha, invincible. All I can say is—absolutely invincible!"
"Seriously though, after playing this game for so long, I’ve practically developed feelings for these NPCs. Sometimes it really feels like they’re actual living people."
"Yeah. I still remember Old Jack from Stone Lake Village. I spent that whole stretch of time fishing with him every day!"
"Exactly. I’d actually feel a little reluctant seeing those villagers die in battle. This move from Great God Faustus is genuinely unbeatable!"
"Hahaha, even though it’s definitely a good thing, what exactly are wish points? I’ve never even seen them before, hahaha..."
But unlike the jubilant mood among the general player base in World Channel, the atmosphere inside the core channels of the major guilds was completely different.
Silence. Oppression. Even a hint of despair.
After hearing the news, Duskfang, the guild leader of Ragnarok, remained silent for a full minute.
Inside the guild channel, everyone held their breath and waited.
At last, he slowly spoke, his voice hoarse and exhausted:
"We can’t compete with him. From today onward... Ragnarok is dissolved..."
No one objected.
Because they all knew that in front of that name, any struggle was meaningless.
Meanwhile, another scene was playing out in the public channel of Eternal Eagle.
Whitehead Falcon was delivering an impassioned speech.
"Everyone, at the very least, here we are all upper management, and we can enjoy the best perks. But anywhere else, we’d only be the lowest foot soldiers!"
The silence from the upper ranks was deafening.
Everyone knew exactly what "anywhere else" the guild leader was referring to.

"No matter how strong Doom Guild is, it’s still only a private guild. But Eternal Eagle is a guild that has gathered countless top talents from the entire Morgan Consortium. We will never bow our heads!"
As soon as the message was sent, the channel exploded with approval.
"That’s right! We’d rather die than submit!"
"Let them see our backbone! They’re afraid of Doom Guild, but we’re not!"

chapters.title: Chapter 126 -126-Make Faustus Beg for Cooperation?
paragraphs: "Our Eternal Eagle Guild is not just the Eagle of Earth—we will become the Eagle of Stellar as well!"
"That’s right! The divine eagle is eternal!"
"Once the big shots from the financial consortiums start throwing their weight around, Faustus’s Doom Guild will meet its true doom!"
Yet beneath this boiling wave of passion and shouting, the upper management remained strangely silent.
Throw their weight around? How?
Almost every purchasable industry in the entire empire had already been monopolized by Faustus alone. Even if they had money, there was barely any room for them to squeeze in.
And it was not just commerce. Military power, politics, territory, guilds...
Faustus had already built a legendary-grade empire, one capable of crushing every consortium on Earth through the efforts of a single man alone.
He had achieved near-total monopoly in almost every field within Stellar.
And yet, despite all that, he could still provide tremendous benefits and advantages to every single guild member.
It was no exaggeration to say that even an ordinary Doom Guild member enjoyed待遇 no worse than the top brass of their own high-ranking guilds.
Of course, that referred to in-game resources.
In fact, Doom Guild spared no effort when it came to benefiting its members—it was practically one step away from handing out gold coins directly into their palms.
Blackgold-grade equipment that players outside would have to grind an entire week just to catch a glimpse of could be picked out in the Doom Guild shop like cabbages at a market stall.
Every kind of top-tier resource was available there. If you could think of it, they had it.
With such overwhelming supply, Doom Guild had forcibly created the astonishing spectacle of occupying 99% of the spots on the rankings.
Their own guild master might still be in the top ten for now, but that had come at the cost of the entire guild’s leveling progress grinding to a halt.
The Eternal Eagle Guild’s second-ranked member had not even made it into the top hundred.
The upper echelon had long since grown dissatisfied.
So while the ordinary members were still roaring with passion, covert messages had already begun quietly flowing toward Doom Guild’s recruitment office.

Those same high-ranking leaders who usually strutted around with arrogance, barking at ordinary players at the slightest provocation, were now carefully choosing their words as they inquired about the requirements for joining Doom Guild.

Some offered high sums for an introduction. Some pulled strings and asked acquaintances to pass along a message. Others even sent thousand-word letters of loyalty directly through Faustus’s private channel.
"Lord Faustus, I am willing to bring one hundred and twenty elite brothers under my command to merge into Doom Guild. I beg you to take us in."
"Guild Master, though I am untalented, I do have considerable experience in business management. If I may join your guild, I am willing to offer up all my assets."
"Please... just let me in. I can do anything!"
The messages poured in like a tidal wave, forcing Doom Guild’s HR department to temporarily assign three additional officers just to handle the flood of applications.
Meanwhile, those ordinary members still shouting about "having backbone" in the public chat had no idea that the leaders they admired had already secretly submitted their pledges of allegiance.
Snowspire.
"Fuck you! The number one guild in World Zone 616? The so-called number one player in Stellar? This is it?"
"Unbelievable. We came to him in complete sincerity to seek cooperation, and he actually looked down on us!?"
"Sure, he’s strong, but my favorability toward Faustus has now dropped to negative ten thousand!"
"Exactly! I still remember that receptionist from Doom Guild—polite on the surface, but with that condescending smile!"
Charles’s expression was no better. He let out a bitter laugh.
"Enough... Faustus refusing to meet us may have had other reasons."
He paused, his tone growing even more bitter.
"But since cooperation with Doom Guild is clearly off the table, I think we still need to establish a guild of our own."
Cecilia nodded at once.
"That’s right. Relying on others will never compare to relying on ourselves."
"Even with just our own strength, we should still be able to resolve this Undead Cataclysm crisis to some extent!"
Her words immediately drew agreement from the other players.
"What’s so great about Doom Guild? Just wait—sooner or later, they’ll be the ones begging us to help deal with the Undead Cataclysm!"
"Exactly! There are so many top-tier players among us. Before this, our leveling speed was restricted by the Hidden World. Now that we’ve arrived in the main world, this is our true home ground!"
"Once our guild takes off, we’ll make Faustus experience what rejection feels like too!"
And just then, a global announcement and a World Zone 616 announcement rang out one after the other...
[Global Announcement: Player "Faustus" has single-handedly destroyed the undead spatial passage, halting the descent of the Undead Cataclysm...]
The two announcements struck them like twin bolts of thunder from a clear sky, leaving them charred inside and out.
The players stared at one another, all frozen in place for a moment.
After a long silence, Charles was the first to break it, his voice bitter.
"We misunderstood Faustus... He had already become so powerful that he didn’t need to cooperate with us at all."
The players who had just been ranting in anger moments ago now flushed crimson with embarrassment.
"No, seriously—Faustus completed the task by himself? That’s just insane!"
"Wasn’t the Undead Cataclysm an Exalted-grade mission...? What kind of joke is this?"
"I think I finally understand why Doom Guild can dominate everything on its own. We may have severely underestimated Faustus..."
"I think we made a huge mistake—arrogance."
"Yeah. Only now do I realize that we never really investigated Faustus or Doom Guild’s past. We just assumed with confidence that we could surpass them easily!"
Listening to the discussion, Charles let out another sigh of agreement.
"But since Faustus clearly doesn’t think much of us, then let’s focus on improving our own strength first. We need to prove our value before anything else!"
"Right. We can’t neglect the guild issue either. I heard George’s side is also preparing to establish one."
Cecilia spoke up.
"But... Faustus is so absurdly overpowered. Even if we create a guild, who knows whether it can really develop?"
The players looked at one another, then fell silent.
The moment George heard the global announcement, his entire body trembled for no reason at all.
His face turned ashen, and he blurted out,
"Th-This... is this some kind of bug?"
"The difficulty of the Undead Cataclysm is beyond imagination. I never thought the mission could be handled like this!"
"Faustus... no, are you kidding me? He alone shattered the spatial passage to the Undead Realm?"
George’s mind was completely blank.
For the first time, he began to doubt the very logic of this game world.
He simply could not imagine a player becoming as powerful as Faustus.
By his own strength alone, he had forcibly brought an end to an apocalyptic calamity.
That was the Undead Cataclysm!
How could something this outrageous even be possible?
The players around him were equally stunned into speechlessness.
"Shit, where the hell did this monster Faustus crawl out from?!"

"Maybe those players from the other zones were right—Faustus really is a cheater. I’m not even jealous. I just genuinely can’t imagine how strong a player would have to be to stand against the Undead Cataclysm!"
"Do you think it’s possible that as long as you find the undead spatial passage within the time limit, destroying it is actually easy?"
The moment those words left his mouth, everyone around him turned to stare at him as if he were an idiot.
"Don’t ever say something like that again. It makes all of us sound brain-dead."
"That said, Faustus really is insanely strong. I’m starting to believe that Faustus is even stronger than that Unvanquished Fiend, Quin."
As George listened to the others talking, an absurd feeling suddenly welled up within him.
For the first time in his life, he felt like the frog at the bottom of the well from the story—
believing the patch of sky he saw was the whole heavens, and that he himself was the very best.

chapters.title: Chapter 127 -127-Forcibly Kill a Supreme-Grade World Guardian?
paragraphs: At the Undead Realm gateway of World Zone No. 1213, the longsword in Quin’s hand flashed with cold brilliance as one fierce skill after another crashed relentlessly against the Blackbone Gate.
Under his frenzied assault, faint cracks had already begun to appear on the gate’s surface.
"It’s still not enough... but I’m running out of time!"
Gritting his teeth, Quin attacked like a madman.
Then, all of a sudden, two world announcements exploded in his ears—
[Global Announcement: Player "Faustus" has single-handedly destroyed the undead spatial passage, halting the descent of the Undead Cataclysm...]
"What? World Zone No. 616 actually shattered the Undead Realm’s spatial passage?"
"Faustus? Who’s that? Wait... isn’t that the rank-one player from World Zone No. 616?"
Quin’s attack abruptly halted, his face filling with disbelief.
This was absurd!
He looked at the damage he himself had dealt to the gate, then thought about that man named Faustus...
A deep sense of doubt rose uncontrollably within him.
"If he completed the mission alone, that means he didn’t rely on outside help... so the gap between me and Faustus... is really that huge?"
Roar—!
The crimson dragon beneath him let out a thunderous roar, snapping him out of his daze.
At the same time, a regional announcement rang out.
[World Zone No. 1213 Announcement: The Undead Cataclysm will officially begin in twenty seconds! All players, please prepare yourselves!]
Quin bit down hard, his eyes full of unwillingness.
"Damn it! If I were level one hundred too—or if I had just a little more time... maybe World Zone No. 1213 wouldn’t have to suffer this catastrophe!"
He hurriedly urged the dragon beneath him forward, and in an instant, it turned into a streak of crimson light that vanished into the horizon.
Polaris City.
The moment Daniel returned to headquarters, he immediately summoned all senior officers of the legions.
"Pass down my order—both legions are to prepare for war with full force!"
Hudson, supreme commander of the Polaris Legion, froze slightly before stepping forward.
"As you command, Your Grace!"
"But may I ask—what is the target of this battle?"
A faint smile curved at the corner of Daniel’s lips, a cold gleam flashing through his eyes.
"We will crush World Zone No. 1213!"
He paused, his gaze sweeping across everyone present.
"As long as we forcibly kill the World Guardian, we can trigger the world war by force. All of you need only prepare and await my assembly order."
Hudson’s eyes widened as he blurted out, "But... but..."
"There are supreme-grade beings among the World Guardians!"
Swish, swish, swish—
In an instant, every eye in the room turned toward Daniel.
The World Guardian of every World Zone was a supreme-grade existence. In the current version, where legendary-grade was the upper limit, supreme-grade represented invincible power!
Killing a World Guardian?
That was well beyond anything they could imagine.
Daniel looked across the gathered senior officers under his command, a confident smile tugging at his lips.
"Supreme-grade?"
His voice was not loud, yet it crashed in everyone’s ears like thunder.
"Even a supreme-grade being has HP, doesn’t it? If there is something I want to do, not even the entire Godrace can stop me!"
"Whoever stands in my way will meet only one end—death!"
The many legendary-grade powerhouses and high-ranking legion officers present all straightened their backs at those words.
They gazed at the young lord before them with utter admiration.
Perhaps in terms of raw power, their Grand Duke was not yet truly invincible...
But in terms of sheer bearing and boldness, he was utterly unmatched.
As subordinates of such a lord, they could feel nothing but their blood boiling with excitement!
"As you command!"
"We are willing to be shattered to pieces for Your Grace!"
Hudson, Victor, Alan, Roland, and the other high-ranking officers all bowed in submission.
A smile appeared on Daniel’s face as he nodded.
"Then let us go and meet this supreme-grade World Guardian!"
He activated the Ring of Void and drew twenty legendary-grade powerhouses into it.
With the experience of several past lives, Daniel understood better than anyone else just how difficult it was to forcibly trigger a world war.
Originally, he had planned to lead all NPC and player armies in a human-wave assault to kill the World Guardian by brute force.
But now, with one hundred million wish points in his hand, there was no need to waste that much time and effort.
He was going to directly summon a supreme-grade powerhouse to fight for him!
Even though he had no idea how many wish points it would cost, he was willing to gamble on it.
As long as he forcibly killed the World Guardian of World Zone No. 1213, the world war would begin.
And once that happened, his class change mission would be completed, allowing him to continue leveling up!
Otherwise, he would be permanently stuck at the threshold of level one hundred.
That was something he absolutely could not accept.
Daniel searched through the memories of his past lives.
"The World Guardian of World Zone No. 1213... if I remember correctly, he’s near Baypark, outside Baem Port."
Baem Port.
Swish!
A figure stepped out of the portal.
In his previous lives, the world war had only begun after the number of level one hundred players reached one billion, so he was not especially clear on Baypark’s exact location.
After opening the map and confirming the general direction, he spread the wings of the Eternal Black King and flew toward Baypark.
Outskirts of Baypark.
A gigantic portal stood here.
This portal was dozens of times larger than the ones inside the main city, forming an enormous teleportation zone.
At this very moment, a supreme-grade powerhouse was stationed here!
He was the World Guardian of World Zone No. 1213—
Addison.
Swish—!
Just then, a figure descended from the sky and landed on the ground not far away.
Daniel sized up the World Guardian of World Zone No. 1213, who was seated cross-legged on a grass mat, and cast a detection spell.
[Addison · World Guardian of World Zone No. 1213 (Supreme-Grade)]
Level: ???
Attack: ???
Defense: ???
Skills: ???
Daniel took a deep breath.
A supreme-grade being!
He knew that on the unseen reverse side of this portal, there was another portal as well.
But the one stationed there was the supreme-grade World Guardian of World Zone No. 616.
Until the time for the world war officially arrived, these supreme-grade beings would not leave their posts.
Right in front of the guardian of World Zone No. 1213, Daniel opened the wish interface.
[Ding! You are now using wish points. Please state your wish!]
Daniel said directly, "I want to summon a supreme-grade powerhouse to assist me in battle."
[Notice: You may only summon a supreme-grade powerhouse from a friendly faction. Current options: "Human Race," "Godrace."]
"I choose a human powerhouse."
[Notice: This summoning will consume all of your current wish points (100 million), and the summoned ally will only remain for twenty minutes. Please confirm!]
Daniel frowned slightly.
So the summoning came with such restrictions?
Still, twenty minutes should be enough!
After all, this was going to be a righteous group beatdown!
He confirmed without hesitation!
[Ding! You have consumed 100 million wish points and successfully summoned a Human Sage (Supreme-Grade)!]
The moment the system notification ended, an incomparably vast aura suddenly flooded the entire area.
That presence was ancient and boundless, as though it had walked out of the primordial age itself, carrying with it the oppressive might of countless years.
Addison was instantly jolted awake by that terrifying aura.
His eyes snapped open, and a sharp gleam flashed through them.

chapters.title: Chapter 128 -128-The Human Sage from the River of Time
paragraphs: Addison turned toward Daniel and barked out a harsh question.
"Who are you? Why are you summoning a supreme-grade powerhouse here?"
Daniel let out a cold snort and could not even be bothered to answer him.
When had Addison ever suffered such contempt?
His expression instantly turned incomparably ugly.
Yet before he could erupt, an aged and imposing figure slowly stepped out of the void and stood in front of Daniel.
It was an elderly man with snow-white hair, dressed in ancient, simple armor and holding an old wooden staff.
A faint glow shrouded his entire body, obscuring all his features. Only the calmness radiating from him remained visible—a tranquil composure that seemed to have seen through all worldly matters.
"Young man,"
The old man turned back to look at Daniel, his voice low and gentle.
"I shall aid you for only twenty minutes. After twenty minutes, regardless of victory or defeat, I will leave."
Daniel gave a slight nod. "That will be enough. Thank you, sir."
The old man turned around, faced Addison, and slowly raised the ancient wooden staff in his hand.
Addison’s face instantly turned ashen.
"You are the human sage of World Zone No. 616?"
Grinding his teeth, he shouted, "How dare you interfere in mortal affairs without permission?!"
The old man replied indifferently, "I was summoned here. Nothing more."
Before his words had even fully fallen, the staff in his hand erupted with dazzling blue light, dyeing the entire sky blue.
The moment he saw this, fine beads of cold sweat suddenly seeped out across Addison’s forehead.
He felt a shudder rising from the depths of his soul.
Whoosh—!
Addison shot into the air. A suffocating pressure exploded from his body—the sign of a supreme-grade powerhouse pushing his Strength with everything he had.
He tightened his grip on the long blade in his hand. Dark-red light flowed across its edge like congealed blood.
He had decided to strike first!
But at that very moment, a sphere of lightning suddenly appeared.
That lightning sphere looked almost exactly like the ordinary Lightning Orb spell found in mid-grade magic.
It was only the size of a fist. Blue-white arcs of electricity danced across its surface, giving off soft crackling sounds.
There was no earth-shaking spectacle, no overwhelming phenomenon blanketing the sky. It simply hovered there quietly in the air, as though it could be shattered with a casual touch.
"What kind of Strength is that?!"
Addison suddenly let out a horrified roar.
Clearly, he had already sensed something from that seemingly ordinary lightning sphere—something far beyond his understanding.
It was the crushing force of a higher dimension.
Absolute. Irrefutable. Unstoppable.
He gripped his blade with both hands, pouring the entirety of his Strength into it, and slashed viciously at the lightning sphere.
A blazing-red elemental sword aura tore across the sky, carrying enough might to split mountains in half, and struck the sphere head-on.
And yet—
The lightning sphere did not move in the slightest!
Not only did that overwhelming flame sword aura fail to disperse it, it was instead swallowed whole, vanishing into the sphere like a stone sinking into the sea.
Now, an extra layer of dancing fire had appeared on the surface of the blue-white lightning sphere.
Half lightning. Half flame.
Two completely opposing powers coexisted within that small sphere in perfect harmony.
Whoosh—!
A shrill tearing sound suddenly rang out.
The lightning sphere accelerated in an instant, like a falling meteor, and shot straight toward Addison.
Addison only had time to swing a second slash.
The instant his blade struck the sphere—
BOOM!!!
A world-shaking explosion erupted.
The lightning sphere detonated, and the lightning and flames within it instantly engulfed Addison’s entire body.
That ball of elemental power resembled a miniature purgatory, with lightning and blazing fire churning wildly inside it, shredding everything caught within.
Very soon, Addison’s miserable screams rang out from within the sphere.
"No! Impossible! This kind of Strength—"
"Who exactly are you?! This is absolutely not a power an ordinary person could wield!"
"Could it be... you are the legendary god-grade?! No... that kind of existence cannot descend into this world!"
Addison’s voice grew weaker and weaker, fainter and fainter, as though he were falling into a bottomless abyss.
At last, all he left behind was one powerless murmur.
"Damn it... why would one appear at a time like this..."
Whoosh—!
The elemental power wrapped around him abruptly dispersed.
The spot where he had stood was spotless.
No corpse. No remains. Not even a drop of blood.
Addison had completely disappeared from the world, as though he had never existed at all.
Daniel stared blankly at the scene, momentarily dazed.
The supreme-grade guardian of World Zone No. 1213... had just died like that?
He had not even managed to touch the shadow of his opponent before being annihilated by a single skill?
Daniel frowned, countless questions rising in his heart.
Hadn’t he also summoned a supreme-grade powerhouse?
Could the gap in strength between supreme-grade beings really be this vast?
And besides, Addison’s total erasure was somewhat regrettable.
After all, in the current version, it was impossible for a supreme-grade powerhouse to appear naturally. In other words, reviving a supreme-grade being was practically impossible.
Daniel had originally hoped to leave behind some remains so that once a future version was released and the revival conditions became available, he could resurrect him then.
But now, it seemed even that opportunity was gone.
Just then, a clear and resonant voice rang out.
"A mere supreme-grade..."
Daniel’s eyes lit up abruptly. Only then did he realize that the old man, who had clearly been standing right in front of him just moments ago, had disappeared without a trace.
When he tried to lock onto the direction the voice had come from, he discovered that it seemed to be coming from everywhere at once—ethereal and impossible to pinpoint.
This was utterly absurd!
In all his memories from his previous lives, there had absolutely never been a supreme-grade existence possessing this level of Strength.
Just what realm had that old man reached?
Daniel took a deep breath and asked with a hint of curiosity,
"Sir... what realm are you actually in?"
He had no idea whether this human sage had already left. He only asked on the off chance.
To his surprise, that clear voice rang out again.
"Mmm... in the spacetime you inhabit, I am naturally supreme-grade."
"But I have already mastered eternal spacetime magic. Within the River of Time, every version of me across every stretch of time possesses boundless power."
The voice paused for a moment, carrying a faintly lazy smile.
"If you wish to see me, then go study that [Chronoverse Prologue Codex]. Perhaps... we will meet again very soon."
The voice quickly faded, and silence returned to heaven and earth.
Daniel stood there without speaking for a long time.
He only half understood what the human sage had meant.
But at the very least, he understood one thing—
The hundred million wish points he had spent had summoned an utterly terrifying existence.
An existence capable of instantly killing a supreme-grade powerhouse in a single move.
An existence that could roam through the River of Time.
An existence that could amplify itself across every era of its own existence.
Such an ability...
was simply too heaven-defying.

chapters.title: Chapter 129 -129-Full Army Mobilization, the World War Begins
paragraphs: Daniel lowered his head and looked at his own hands, and for the first time, he truly felt that his strength was still far from enough.
Especially that [Chronoverse Prologue Codex].
It was a supreme-grade item he had exchanged for an enormous amount of points in a secret realm, and he had always regarded it as one of his most important trump cards.
In his previous lives, it had been known as the ultimate pursuit of all players!
At that thought, Daniel became even more eager to trigger the world war.
Only by raising his level further would he have more chances to gather the various elemental cores, and only then could he unlock that codex sealed with the mysteries of time and space!
Daniel turned his gaze toward the World Zone No. 1213 portal before him.

Originally, he had prepared an entire army of legendary-grade powerhouses to deal with Addison, yet he had not expected that mysterious sage summoned with one hundred million wish points to solve everything so effortlessly.
Still, the gains from this wave were not small at all!
With the guardian of World Zone No. 1213 dead, this world portal had lost its protector and could now be used freely.
Daniel activated the Ring of Void and released all thirty legendary-grade powerhouses.
"Aliris,"
he called out. "Go inform the legion high command—full army mobilization!"
"As you command, my lord!"
Aliris turned into a streak of light and shot toward Polaris City.
Daniel, meanwhile, took out a set of portal components from his inventory and began assembling them on the spot.
He still had a large number of portal parts in his bag—more than enough to build portals wherever he went.
Polaris City.
The Doom Legion was assembling at emergency speed.
Countless players moved with crisp efficiency, rapidly finding their respective teams and lining up in neat, disciplined formation.
No one knew what exactly had happened. They only knew that when Guild Master Faustus raised his arm, all they had to do was charge forward behind him!
"What’s going on? Why is the Doom Legion suddenly mobilizing?"
"With a formation this huge, it’s definitely no small matter! I just don’t know who the Guild Master is going to crush this time..."
"Could it be the elf race? If so, I volunteer to be the vanguard!"
"Who doesn’t know what you’re really thinking? I’m too embarrassed to even expose you."
As commander of the Doom Legion, Alan was standing atop the high platform, his gaze sweeping over the dark sea of people below.
Seeing that the legion had nearly finished assembling, he raised a hand and said in a deep voice, "Silence!"
The moment he spoke, the players fell quiet at once.
Alan looked over the crowd before him and said solemnly,
"This time, our target lies in another World Zone!"
"Our assembly point is Baypark in Baem Port!"
The moment those words fell, excitement instantly burst across the players’ faces.
"Another World Zone? This is the rhythm of a world war!"
"No, wait—if a war on this scale is about to begin, how come I’m only hearing about it now? I didn’t get any system notification! Is my system broken or what?"
"World war! Baypark belongs to Baem Port on the map, and the portal in Baem Port... I just checked the info, and it seems to connect to World Zone No. 1213!"
"Holy shit! Don’t tell me we’re really going to fight World Zone No. 1213? Then I’d better bring out one hundred and twenty percent of my strength!"
"WTF?! Is the Guild Master really this ferocious? He’s forcing open a world war!"

"Hmph. The people from World Zone No. 1213 and World Zone No. 250 are the ones who deserve to get beaten up the most. They spend all day slandering Lord Faustus and mocking the players of our World Zone No. 616 on the Multiversal World Channel!"
"True. They’re a bunch of idiots. I’m already itching for this! Last time, that secret realm world war wasn’t nearly enough to satisfy me!"
"Thanks, Lord Faustus! This time I’m really going to beat them senseless!"
The news spread like wildfire.

The rumor that Faustus was about to forcibly open the world portal and launch a campaign against World Zone No. 1213 first spread from the mouths of Doom Legion players, then rapidly swept through the entire Doom Guild.
Inside the guild channel, countless players lamented in regret.
"My level was too low back then, so I missed my chance to join the Doom Legion... Not being able to fight in the invasion of World Zone No. 1213 this time is killing me!"
"Tell me about it. The legion’s roster is locked down hard now. Once they recruited 120 million players, they stopped taking anyone else!"
"Even if we don’t have a chance to fight directly, we can still help the Doom Legion indirectly!"
"That’s right—we can deposit money into the bank so the Guild Master has more funds to burn. World wars are wars of money!"
"But does the Guild Master really look like someone who lacks money?"
"It’s about the thought, get it? Besides, we can also buy and craft potions, forge weapons and equipment, then supply them to the legion players—that counts as participating indirectly too!"

"That’s a great idea! I’ve got another one—we can help transport the military supplies and siege equipment forged by the dwarves of Polaris City. Even if we can’t fight personally, it still counts as contributing!"
"Perfect! Then let’s get moving right now!"
World Passage Transfer Zone.
Squad after squad of legion warriors marched in perfect order, their footsteps beating like war drums.
They came to a halt at the outer perimeter of the transfer zone, waiting for the final command.
Daniel hovered in midair. Looking out, he saw an endless mass of legion warriors packed so densely that their numbers stretched beyond sight, like an ocean without end.
This expedition had mobilized the entire Doom Legion—all 120 million players—in addition to 20 million Polaris Legion warriors and every powerhouse of epic-grade and above.
Daniel nodded toward the legion leadership, signaling that the transfer could begin.
Then he spread his wings and flew toward the world portal.
[Ding! You are using the World Zone No. 1213 world portal!]
[After use, you will appear within World Zone No. 1213. Your coordinates in that zone will be tracked in real time, and World War mode will be activated by default. Please confirm.]
"Confirm."
[Notice: Transfer is about to begin—]
Whoosh—!
In the next instant, white light swallowed everything.
World Zone No. 1213, World Portal of World Zone No. 616.
A flash of light passed, and Daniel stepped out.

[Global Announcement: Player "Faustus" of World Zone No. 616 has passed through the world portal and appeared in World Zone No. 1213 at (6461, 2664). This player’s position will be tracked in real time. All players of World Zone No. 1213, please take note!]
[Global Announcement: Player "Faustus" of World Zone No. 616 has initiated a "World War" between World Zone No. 616 and World Zone No. 1213! The World War system is now officially unlocked!]

[Notice: After World War begins, players of each World Zone will automatically enter "Regional Combat Mode." Killing players from hostile World Zones will grant "World War Points," while the slain will drop a certain amount of items. The World War Points leaderboard has now opened!]
[Notice: World War Points can be obtained by killing hostile NPCs and players, as well as by capturing enemy cities. All players, please take note!]
This string of global announcements left all of Stellar’s players utterly dumbfounded.
"The game system hasn’t even officially unlocked world war yet, and Faustus can force it open anyway? That’s completely insane!"
"World Zone No. 616 is already this strong, and World Zone No. 1213 is still dealing with the Undead Cataclysm... I’ve got a feeling World Zone No. 1213 is finished this time!"

"Hahahaha... serves them right. Out of all the zones, it’s always the players from World Zone No. 1213 who have the foulest mouths, always looking down on this one and mocking that one. Now the big boss has come to deal with them in person!"
"Still though... after Faustus finishes with World Zone No. 1213, are we next?"
As soon as the players of World Zone No. 1213 heard the global announcements, their anger exploded on the spot!
"Shameless players of World Zone No. 616! Invading while we’re in the middle of fighting the Undead Cataclysm!"
"You’re nothing but opportunists taking advantage of others in a crisis! Sooner or later, World Zone No. 616 will suffer retribution!"

"Special reminder—under no circumstances can anyone get killed by Faustus! That bastard’s running some kind of broken cheat. If you die to him, not only will you lose levels, you’ll end up owing him a huge debt too!"

chapters.title: Chapter 130 -130-Taking It Offline for Real, Occupying Mauler
paragraphs: Compared to the shock and fury of the players from other World Zones, the players of World Zone No. 616 were far more excited and exhilarated.
"Faustus is unbeatable! The boss never bothers arguing, never stoops to keyboard wars—he just crushes clowns in real life!"
"This was so damn satisfying! Those clowns from World Zone No. 1213 were running their mouths before, and now they’ve finally learned to behave!"
"Hahahaha... I’m dying here. Look at the disgusting faces of the players from World Zone No. 1213. Now they’re actually trying to take the moral high ground and guilt-trip Faustus?"
"Some people get so shameless they forget their own damn names!"
World No. 1213.
Countless players from World Zone No. 616, along with vast NPC armies, streamed out of the inter-world portal like an endless tide.
The World Guardian of World No. 616 sat quietly in the distance, turning a blind eye to everything.
His duty was only to guard the passage and prevent players from World Zone No. 1213 from crossing through. As for who came over from his side, that was none of his concern.
"Holy shit! Does this count as crossing into another world? We’re actually standing on foreign territory!"
"Tsk, tsk... You know, the architectural style of World Zone No. 1213 is totally different from ours. And just look at the map—there are so many rare mineral veins here!"
"This time, we’re definitely turning World Zone No. 1213 into our colony from another world! Hahaha!"
"As for those foul-mouthed outsiders, we’ll just make them mine for us. Hahaha..."
At the temporary World War command center, Chief Strategist Hudson, together with Victor and Alan, had already finalized their battle plan.
"We’ve selected two major cities as our strategic footholds—Mauler and Aha Harbor."
Hudson pointed to the two marked locations on the map and spoke in a deep voice.
Daniel nodded.
He had studied the map as well and knew these two fortresses were the nearest major cities in World Zone No. 1213, both occupying highly advantageous strategic positions.
"Then it’s settled."
Daniel said calmly, "I’ll take the cities first. Your armies can move in afterward and take over."
Hudson and Victor answered in unison, "As you command, Grand Duke!"

Daniel left Tiana, Cole, Upton, and the other transcendent powerhouses behind for the command center to deploy, just in case legendary-grade experts from World Zone No. 1213 attempted a surprise raid.
He himself led the rest of the legendary-grade powerhouses and shot off toward the two great fortresses of World Zone No. 1213.
Daniel flew through the sky.
The heavens above World Zone No. 1213 were dim and overcast.
Ever since the Undead Cataclysm had descended, this eerie phenomenon had shrouded the land without end.

On the ground, squad after squad of undead creatures swept across the wilderness like the scythes of death itself, harvesting every form of life they encountered—even wild monsters were spared no mercy.
Soon, the outline of a fortress came into view before him.
At this moment, Mauler was on the highest alert.
But not because the World War had begun.
It was because of the Undead Cataclysm.
The city walls were packed shoulder to shoulder with NPC defenders and players alike. Their eyes were fixed on the black-mist-covered wasteland beyond the city, filled with exhaustion and fear.
A figure came to a halt high above Mauler.
Daniel descended, and his presence was instantly noticed by the players and NPCs of World Zone No. 1213.
"Enemy att—!"
The shrill warning cry had only just sounded when Daniel had already summoned ninety-nine clones.
The clones spread out through the fortress with perfect precision, ensuring their skills could cover the entire city.
Daniel raised Stellar Wrath.
At the same time, the legendary-grade powerhouses around him launched their attacks as well.
[Arrowstorm]!
[Shattering Comet]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
[Aetherlance]!
In an instant, a sky-blotting rain of arrows engulfed the entire fortress.
Golden radiance, violet lightning, and burning meteors intertwined into a net of death, tearing every living being caught within it into pieces.
[Ding! You have slain "Captain of the Mauler Guard"! Obtained: Gold Coin +300,000!
Obtained: "Heavenscar Pass (Legendary-grade, Low-grade)" x1!
Obtained: World War Points +1,000,000!]
[Ding! You have slain "Lord of Mauler"! Obtained: Gold Coin +400,000!
Obtained: "Heavenscar Pass (Legendary-grade, Low-grade)" x1!
Obtained: World War Points +2,000,000!]
[Ding! You have slain player "Gluttonous Astronaut"! Obtained: Gold Coin +100,000!
Obtained: World War Points +20,000!
Obtained equipment...]
System notifications poured down like a waterfall.
Inside Mauler, countless players from World Zone No. 1213 were killed before they even had time to react.
The unluckiest were those who had bound their resurrection point to Mauler.
After dying, they lost levels, emptied their backpacks, lost all their equipment, and even wound up owing Faustus a huge amount of gold coins.
Yet the moment they revived, before they could even steady themselves, they were drowned once more beneath the storm of skills filling the sky.
Those with higher levels might manage to survive one more round.
Low-level players, however, were sent directly back to Starter Village.

Back in the previous Secret Realm World War, only around ten billion players from other zones had invaded in total, and of those, two hundred million players from World Zone No. 1213 had been killed badly enough to lose levels.
That had been only one-tenth of all players in World Zone No. 1213.
But now, the average level of mainstream players across the world had already risen above Level 60. Many of them could endure being killed by Faustus several times over.
Yet no matter how many times they could survive, once they were killed by Faustus, that account was basically ruined.
A few minutes later, not a single living enemy remained in Mauler.
Daniel ceased his attack and led the legendary-grade powerhouses charging into the Lord’s Manor, where they shattered the fortress stele.
[Ding! You have shattered the fortress stele! Obtained: World War Points +50,000,000!
Please choose: "Occupy" or "Destroy."]
"Occupy."
[Notice: You have occupied "Mauler"!]

[World Announcement: Congratulations to player "Faustus" of World Zone No. 616 for occupying the fortress "Mauler" in World Zone No. 1213! He has become the first player to occupy a fortress in a foreign World Zone! Special rewards granted to this player: Administrative NPC x1,000,000, Commercial NPC x5,000,000!]
Listening to the system prompt, Daniel curled his lips into a satisfied smile.
He glanced at his current total of World War Points—
3.4 billion.
"So many points... I wonder how many Primordial Crystals I can exchange for."
He opened the World War Point exchange interface. His gaze swept over the dazzling assortment of goods before finally stopping on a gem radiating seven-colored light.
[Primordial Crystal (Extremely Rare)]
Exchange Cost: 500,000,000 points
Effect: Upon use, increases the origin Strength of the user’s world and raises the world’s overall quality.
Description: A crystallization of the World Heart, containing the power of planar origin. Only those who have achieved glorious military merit in the World War are qualified to exchange for it.

chapters.title: Chapter 131 -131-Players Who Refused to Believe, The Hunt Begins
paragraphs: If Daniel wanted to break past the Level 100 limit, he had to complete the prerequisite SSS-rank quest, Worldwept, and obtain ten Primordial Crystals.
Wasn’t that exactly why he had been so impatient to start the World War in the first place?
At that thought, he clicked exchange without the slightest hesitation.
[Ding! Consumed 3 billion points. Obtained: Primordial Crystal x6!]
As he stared at the six gems in his inventory, the smile on his lips simply refused to fade.
"There are still 400 million World War Points left..."
"I need ten crystals to reach the class change quest... I’m still short three."
He had already decided on his next target—
Aha Harbor.
As long as he harvested another wave of World War Points there, it would be enough to exchange for the remaining three Primordial Crystals.
Daniel left several legendary-grade powerhouses behind to guard Mauler and wait for the two great armies to arrive and take over.
Then he spread his wings and flew toward the next fortress.
Aha Harbor.
At this moment, the sounds of slaughter shook the heavens outside the city.
Countless players from World Zone No. 1213, together with vast NPC armies, were locked in a bloody battle against a tide of undead creatures.
The undead legion had a strict hierarchy.
Among them, the Hellreapers were the strongest, each possessing legendary-grade combat power. At this moment, they were fighting fiercely against the elites of World Zone No. 1213 inside Godscar.
Below them were the Lich Kings, which were Exalted-grade monsters.
The Vampires were epic-grade.

Further down the chain were Hellswordsmen as first-tier units, Sin Wraiths as second-tier, Rot Corpses as third-tier, while Skeleton Warriors were the weakest—but also the most numerous, swarming across the land like a plague of locusts.
The most terrifying part of the Undead Cataclysm was not the undead themselves.
It was that the moment an NPC died in battle, they would immediately be seized by necrotic power and turned into fresh soldiers for the undead army.
The undead could only grow stronger the longer they fought.
The undead could only grow more numerous the longer they fought.
They were almost endless.
Such a horrifying undead trait was nearly impossible to counter.
That was exactly why the Undead Cataclysm was known as an apocalypse capable of destroying the world.
Whoosh!
Daniel hovered above the clouds, silently watching the fierce battle below.
The players of World Zone No. 1213 roared with killing intent, while the undead army advanced without fear.
The moment they sensed living prey, they surged forward like a black tide.
"Kill these damned skeleton monsters!"
"Charge! For the glory of World Zone No. 1213!"
"What Undead Cataclysm? They’re just skeleton soldiers. I’d be too lazy to farm EXP from trash like this!"
Daniel did not rush to make his move.
He simply remained suspended in the sky, watching the two sides below fight with blazing passion.
But it was not long before a sharp-eyed player from World Zone No. 1213 spotted the figure hovering in midair.
"That ID is... Faustus? Wait, when did he get here?"
"The real question is, what is he doing up there right now?"
"What else could he be doing? Waiting for the perfect moment to wipe us all out in one shot!"
"That old fox! He forced the World War open right when the Undead Cataclysm was invading!"
"Brothers, remember this—better to die to the undead than die to Faustus. If he makes a move later, kill yourselves if you can!"
"Bastard! How can you even say something so demoralizing? What are we players afraid of? At worst, we revive and charge back in!"
"Exactly. No matter how strong he is, he’s only one person. We’ve got all of World Zone No. 1213 behind us. One spit from each of us would be enough to drown him!"
"That’s right. What a coward. Even if he were a god, as long as he has HP, he can only tremble before players! And he’s just one man!"
"You... you people!"
The player who had warned them at the beginning was flushed red from being shouted down by the crowd.
"Forget them. We already gave them a fair warning. If they won’t listen, then whatever happens is on them."
"Exactly. Once Faustus kills them once, they’ll understand."
The clash between the players of World Zone No. 1213 and the undead army was nothing short of spectacular.
Even Daniel, watching from above, found it astonishing.
In almost every game and online setting, players were known as the Fourth Calamity.
Meanwhile, the undead, as the Undead Cataclysm, were likewise famed for being deathless and unending.
Now that these two supposedly undying forces were smashing into each other head-on, the whole scene was undeniably entertaining.
Players who had just fallen on the front lines would revive and rush out from the city again, fearlessly throwing themselves back into the battlefield.

But the players of World Zone No. 1213 fought without any real coordination. They were practically no different from the undead themselves—charging forward and spamming skills blindly was enough for them.
By contrast, the Doom Legion under Daniel’s command was on a completely different level.
Those players had gone through many large-scale wars and already understood the power of teamwork.
Under the control of NPC commanders, every layer of the formation—from large battalions to small squads—had its own coordination and tactics.
Watching the chaotic, smoke-filled mess of the World Zone No. 1213 player formation, Daniel shook his head in disdain.
Soon enough, the brutal battle finally came to an end.
In the end, it was the players who claimed victory.
After all, the undead had limited revival counts and limited resurrection speed. And once those undead priests were killed, the speed at which the undead could revive dropped dramatically.
By contrast, the death penalty for players was not particularly severe, and once revived, they could return to the battlefield at full combat strength.
This result was entirely within Daniel’s expectations.
At this point, only the battle inside Godscar was still continuing.
An hour later, after paying a grievous price, the NPCs of World Zone No. 1213 finally managed to outlast the Hellreapers.
Daniel felt that the time was about right.
He activated the Ring of Void and released all of the legendary-grade powerhouses under his command.
"Attack Godscar immediately."
"Kill every legendary-grade expert of World Zone No. 1213."
"And remember to bring back their remains."
"As you wish!"
The powerhouses turned into streaks of light and shot straight toward Godscar.
Daniel then lowered his gaze toward the players of World Zone No. 1213 below, who were still immersed in the joy of victory.
"Long live World Zone No. 1213! Glory belongs to us!"
"Hahaha... What bullshit Undead Cataclysm? Didn’t we still win in the end?"
"These undead dropped quite a lot of good loot. Add that to the EXP bonus from the kills, and we made a killing in this battle!"
Hearing those optimistic voices, the corners of Daniel’s lips curved upward slightly.
Yes, it was true that you killed the undead.
But their drops...
did not necessarily belong to you.
At once, he summoned ninety-nine clones and raised Stellar Wrath.
[Shadowfont]!
[Shattering Comet]!
[Aetherlance]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
[Arrowstorm]!
The smiles on the faces of the players from World Zone No. 1213 were still bright and carefree.
But in the very next instant, countless skills crashed down and completely swallowed every player and NPC present from World Zone No. 1213.
Every flash of white light marked the death of yet another player or NPC from World Zone No. 1213.
Some players who had experienced this before tried to kill themselves first—
but they were already too late.
[Ding! You have slain World Zone No. 1213 player "Anjieke"! Obtained: Gold Coin +100,000!
World War Points +20,000!
Obtained: "Obsidian Armor (Blackgold-grade)" x1!
Obtained equipment...]
[Ding! You have slain World Zone No. 1213 player "Captain Starriver"! Obtained: Gold Coin +250,000!
World War Points +20,000!
Obtained: "Starlight Warblade (Epic-grade)" x1!
Obtained equipment...]
[Ding! You have slain World Zone No. 1213 player "Dream Specialist"! Obtained: Gold Coin +330,000!
World War Points +30,000!
Obtained: "Blazing Bracers (Blackgold-grade)" x1!]

chapters.title: Chapter 132 -132-Level 120, Forbidden-Grade Archer
paragraphs: At the same time, Godscar quietly faded away.
Carodion and the others returned to report, carrying the severed fingers of two legendary-grade powerhouses in their hands.
Daniel nodded.
With remains on hand, reviving legendary-grade powerhouses would be much easier.
As for gold coins, they had long since become nothing more than a number to him.
He cast Seraphic Revival.
[Ding! Do you want to spend 1 trillion gold coins to revive two legendary-grade powerhouses?]
"Yes."
[Notice: 1 trillion gold coins have been consumed. Two legendary-grade powerhouses have been successfully revived.]
A flash of golden light passed, and two figures stepped out from the holy radiance.
"Greetings, my lord. Please bestow names upon us, Master."
Daniel said calmly, "You will go by numbers. You’ll be called No. 1 and No. 2."
"As you command! We are willing to die for you, Master!"
Daniel gave a slight nod.
For the time being, there would be no more fighting here.
He lifted his eyes toward Aha Harbor in the distance.
"Follow me and take this castle."
"As you command, Master!"
At this moment, Aha Harbor was in total chaos.
Countless players from World Zone No. 1213, stuck at the resurrection point, were on the verge of collapse.
In the multiverse World Channel, they were denouncing Daniel one after another.
"I dropped five levels! My equipment bag is completely empty! And I even owe him over a hundred thousand gold coins now! What kind of sick joke is this?!"
"And you people still say Faustus isn’t hacking? If this isn’t a cheat, I’ll eat my words!"

"This is way too ridiculous! Getting killed by Faustus once wipes out all your assets? What kind of mechanic is this? I suggest we report it on the official forums and file a joint complaint against him for cheating!"
"Oh, give it a rest. Back during the Battle of Desperation, billions of players got killed by him and lost levels. Wasn’t that already a big enough scandal?"

"Exactly. Did you see the devs do anything about it? By the way, let me remind you—there’s a type of item in the game called a deathcurse potion! Its effect is to make targets lose levels and drop equipment!"
"What? There’s actually an item that vicious? Wait... are you saying Faustus deliberately drank that potion before killing us?!"
"No, seriously, how can a person be that cruel? Isn’t this completely destroying other people’s gaming experience? ...Wait, what’s that in the sky?"
"Oh no! The demon Faustus is here... Everyone, quick, kill yourselves!"
"It’s over! I forgot to set a new resurrection point!"
Daniel hovered above Aha Harbor and slowly raised Stellar Wrath.
[Shadowfont]!
[Shattering Comet]!
[Aetherlance]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
[Arrowstorm]!
Ninety-nine clones cast skills at the same time.
In an instant, the entire Aha Harbor was blanketed by a sky-covering rain of arrows.
The players of World Zone No. 1213 could only watch helplessly as the skills descended upon their heads, then turned into streaks of white light and were sent back to the resurrection point.
Especially those whose resurrection point was inside Aha Harbor—they had just revived, and before they could even react, they were vaporized again!
They could only watch in despair as their levels were gradually reduced to nothing...
A few minutes later, the Lord’s Manor obelisk was shattered.
[Ding! You have destroyed the Castle Obelisk and gained World War points +40,000,000! Please choose: "Occupy" or "Destroy."]
"Occupy."
[Notice: You have occupied "Aha Harbor"!]
[World Zone No. 1213 Announcement: Player "Faustus" of World Zone No. 616 has occupied the castle "Aha Harbor" of World Zone No. 1213!]
Daniel glanced at his points—2.3 billion!
"Enough."
He opened the exchange interface and traded for three Primordial Crystals.
[Notice: You have spent 1.5 billion points and successfully exchanged for "Primordial Crystal" ×3!]
[Ding! You have completed the SSS-grade class change quest "Worldwept." Please return to the main city as soon as possible to turn in the quest.]
A smile appeared on Daniel’s lips.
"As long as I go back and submit the quest, my level cap will be unlocked immediately..."
He opened the castle management interface and added Polaris City to his territory’s teleportation rules.
That way, his entire faction would no longer need to rely on world portals to conduct World War teleportation.
Of course, the portal was set to deny access to players from World Zone No. 1213.
Daniel stepped into the portal, and a flash of white light swept over him.
Luminara, Archer Class Hall.
The moment Daniel walked into the hall, the guards at the entrance all dropped to one knee. "Good day, Your Grace!"
Inside the hall, every eye turned toward him.
The mentors froze for a moment before hurriedly bowing in respect.
"Greetings, Your Grace!"
When had the players inside ever seen such a scene?
After all, Luminara had only one grand duke, and that was the city lord, Augusta.
But that figure was not someone ordinary players could ever meet.
Faustus, however, was different—this was a legend active among the player community!
"So this is the kind of presence Faustus has? Even these top-tier NPCs treat him with this much respect?"
"A grand duke? Hold on, when exactly did Faustus become a grand duke... Damn, that’s insane..."
"Even the class mentors have to bow to him. Faustus is seriously on a whole different level!"
"Faustus is invincible! Please, please give me a spot in Doom Guild!"
"Get in line. My application’s been in for two weeks already, and I haven’t said a word!"
"Please give me a chance, Boss..."
Daniel’s expression remained calm.
Once the game fused with reality, the entire world would be reshuffled, and all rules would be determined by the strong.
He had long since grown used to scenes like this.
He raised a hand lightly. "Rise."
Rustle, rustle, rustle...
Only then did all the NPCs stand up.
In the blink of an eye, Daniel walked straight toward the archer class mentor, Shadow Song.
Shadow Song looked at him, her face filled with complicated emotions.
She could be said to have witnessed this adventurer’s rise from nothing all the way to where he stood now.
As Faustus was an archer, seeing him achieve so much gave her a sense of pride as well.
"Sir Faustus," Shadow Song said in a clear voice.
Daniel smiled faintly. "I’ve already completed the class change quest, ’Worldwept.’"
He placed ten Primordial Crystals on the table.
Shadow Song was momentarily stunned.
Even though she had been mentally prepared, she still found it difficult to believe.
The Primordial Crystal class change quest had many restrictions. Its hardest part was that the quest required an enormous amount of World War points to exchange for the number of crystals needed.
At times, even she felt the quest was excessively harsh.
But the forbidden-grade archer was, after all, the absolute pinnacle of the archer class. A difficult class change quest was only reasonable.
After confirming the crystals were correct, Shadow Song handed Daniel a golden Class Awakening Scroll.
"Congratulations, sir, on completing your class change quest. Please take this."
Daniel accepted the scroll, and the system prompt immediately rang out.
[Ding! You have completed the class change quest and obtained "Forbidden-Grade Archer Class Awakening Scroll" ×1!]
He used the scroll without hesitation.
The fragments turned into specks of golden light and sank into his body.
[Ding! Congratulations! Your class change was successful!]
[Notice: The restriction on your EXP bar has been removed. You may continue leveling up!]
Daniel chose to level up without the slightest hesitation.
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 101. You have gained Attribute Points ×20.]
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 105. You have gained Attribute Points ×20.]
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 120. You have gained Attribute Points ×20.]

[Notice: You have not yet completed the next stage of your class change quest. Leveling is now restricted again. Excess EXP will be stored in the EXP Pool. Please complete your next class change quest as soon as possible to remove the level cap.]
Daniel allocated all his attribute points into Agility, increasing his damage output yet again.
From level 100, he had instantly jumped to level 120. Next, he would have to take on the level 150 quest.
He looked at Shadow Song.
Before he could even speak, Shadow Song skillfully issued another quest.
[Notice: Do you wish to accept the class change quest "Collect the Fragment of the Immortal Singularity"?]

paragraphs: [Notice: Do you wish to accept the class change quest "Collect the Fragment of the Immortal Singularity"?]
"Accept!"
[Ding! You have accepted the class change quest "Collect the Fragment of the Immortal Singularity." Your quest log has been updated.]
Daniel opened his quest log.
[Collect the Fragment of the Immortal Singularity]
(Forbidden-Grade Archer Class Change Quest)
Quest Difficulty: SSS-rank
Quest Objective: Collect 300 Fragments of the Immortal Singularity

Quest Description: From the moment you accept this quest, you will obtain Godslayer’s Blessing—whenever you kill an enemy legendary-grade powerhouse, they are guaranteed to drop a Fragment of the Immortal Singularity. The Immortal Singularity, also known as god power, contains endless mysteries.
Special Reminder: Godslayer’s Blessing will disappear after the quest is completed.
Quest Reward: Forbidden-Grade Archer Class Awakening Scroll ×1
Daniel opened his status panel.
Sure enough, a newly appeared buff was there.
[Godslayer’s Blessing (Supreme-Grade)]
Effect 1: Killing a legendary-grade powerhouse guarantees the drop of a Fragment of the Immortal Singularity.
Effect 2: The number of fragments required to synthesize an Immortal Singularity is reduced by 50%.
Duration: Permanent!
[Ding! Due to the effect of the Eternal Ring, the duration of the special buff Godslayer’s Blessing has been changed to permanent!]
Hearing the system notification, a brilliant smile appeared on Daniel’s face.
With this buff, he was practically making a killing!

Back when he had fought against the shadowkin and the non-human races, he had no idea how many legendary-grade powerhouses he had slain. He had even gathered enough higher-tier Divinity Fragments, yet he had never once gotten a Fragment of the Immortal Singularity.
That was because the item was unbelievably rare!
And now this buff actually guaranteed its drop. The effect was simply outrageous!
As for Effect 2, it cut the number needed for synthesis in half.
In other words, where it would normally take one hundred fragments to synthesize one unit of Immortal Singularity, now it only required fifty!
As expected of a Supreme-Grade blessing—absolutely overpowered!
And best of all, he had gotten this blessing for free...
A huge profit!
Daniel looked toward his inventory. He remembered that when he had killed Harland earlier, one Fragment of the Immortal Singularity had dropped.
"As long as I kill legendary-grade powerhouses, I can get fragments..."
The corners of his lips curved upward slightly.
For him, that was far too easy.

Whether they were legendary-grade powerhouses from the non-human races, powerful human NPCs from World Zone No. 1213, or even legendary-grade undead from the Undead Cataclysm, all of them could provide him with fragments.
Three hundred was not a large number.
After bidding Shadow Song farewell, Daniel immediately returned to World Zone No. 1213.
Sky Mountains.
[Ding! Your level has increased! Current level: 100. You have gained Attribute Points ×10.]

[Notice: You have not yet completed your class change quest. Your EXP bar is full, and excess EXP will be stored in the EXP Pool. Please complete your class change quest as soon as possible to remove the level cap.]
George let out a deep breath. Picking up the loot dropped by the boss on the ground, he revealed a satisfied smile.
A group of players immediately crowded around him.
"George, how is it? Did you hit max EXP?"
After receiving a positive answer, everyone instantly became excited.
"Fuck! This is awesome! Our World Zone No. 616 has finally produced a second player with full EXP!"
"I knew it—the one who could catch up to Faustus was always going to be you, George!"
"Of course! If that Hidden World hadn’t restricted Big Bro George’s leveling, he probably would’ve broken level 100 a long time ago!"
George was overjoyed.
At last—level 100.
Now, in World Zone No. 616—no, in the entire Stellar game!
At this moment, the entire game had only two max-level players!
"Faustus, just wait for me to put an end to your number-one position, hahaha!"
George opened the World Level Ranking.
But the instant he saw the leaderboard, the smile on his face froze.
Seeing something was wrong with him, the others hurriedly opened the ranking list as well.
Hiss—!
"Faustus... Level 120!!!"
"No wonder players across all of Stellar say he’s a cheater..."
"The more ordinary the class, the easier the class change quest. Hidden classes—especially their class change quests—are absurdly difficult. And he cleared it this fast?"
"Faustus is a straight-up hacking dog. If you insist on judging him by the standards of a normal person, you’ll only discover that you’re a complete idiot."
Earth, the real world.
Inside a graceful and elegant courtyard, a group of experts and Earth’s high-ranking officials had gathered.
A man with an air of iron-blooded resolve stood up, holding a report in his hand.
"Based on the experimental data, it has now been confirmed that the Stellar game is having a significant effect on Earth’s reality."
He paused, then continued, "During the initial phase of testing, we discovered that the game only enhanced the players’ basic physical attributes."
"But now, D-rank talent users from the game world have already started appearing in the real world!"

"We have reason to suspect that this game, which appeared out of nowhere, is definitely far more than just a game! As time passes and players continue to grow stronger, the talents, skills, and perhaps even items from the game may very well begin appearing in the real world too."
This research report immediately stunned everyone present!
Human evolution was measured in tens of thousands of years.
Yet the appearance of Stellar had directly shattered that natural law.
Such a terrifying discovery sent chills down the spines of all the high-level officials.
A young man wearing glasses frowned and asked,
"Do you think it’s possible... that the Stellar world will eventually form some kind of real connection with reality?"
The eyes of the gathered experts and scholars lit up, and they nodded.
"That possibility cannot be ruled out."
"Judging by the current situation, the odds are not low!"
"Dr. Mir, your speculation is indeed very worthy of consideration!"
The bespectacled man fell silent for a moment, then said, "If that’s really the case, then we’re in trouble."
The moment he said that, everyone in the room turned to look at him.
"If the game and reality truly begin to overlap..."
He said worriedly, "Then doesn’t that mean the monsters in the game might also appear in the real world?"
Hiss—!
Everyone present was among humanity’s elite, and they immediately grasped the implication.
If the game and reality truly were likely to merge, then such a scenario would inevitably occur.
But there was one enormous problem:
The real world had no resurrection points!
If a person died, then they were truly dead.
And the disasters in the game were often world-ending in scale!
Without the mechanism of endless resurrection, could humanity really withstand that kind of devastating assault?
The Stellar game could accelerate humanity’s evolution, but at the same time, it also carried the risk of civilization’s destruction!
Faced with such a possibility, everyone could not help but feel the weight in their hearts grow heavier.
And they also remembered one more thing—
The multiverse!
Aside from countless monsters, there were also vast numbers of humans from other worlds.
Whether those outsiders would be enemies or allies was not something that could be explained in just a sentence or two.
All eyes turned toward the elderly man seated at the head of the room.
His hair was completely white, yet his spirit was vigorous, and his eyes gleamed with sharp light.
Sensing everyone’s gaze, the old man slowly lowered the hands that had been clasped before him, his calm eyes sweeping across the entire room.
