Whether those outsiders would be enemies or allies was not something that could be explained in just a sentence or two.
All eyes turned toward the elderly man seated at the head of the room.
His hair was completely white, yet his spirit was vigorous, and his eyes gleamed with sharp light.
Sensing everyone’s gaze, the old man slowly lowered the hands that had been clasped before him, his calm eyes sweeping across the entire room.

chapters.title: Chapter 134 -134-The Strong Make the Rules
paragraphs: The old man slowly raised his eyelids, his gaze as deep as an abyss.
After a moment of thought, he spoke, his voice carrying the calm steadiness of someone who had weathered the passage of years.
"If that is the case, then we should immerse ourselves even more deeply in that virtual realm—to learn, to temper ourselves, and to seize strength."
He paused slightly, his eyes sweeping across every face in the room.
"Only when every citizen of Earth grows stronger will we have the confidence to face the unpredictable storms that may come in the future."
"I propose that we mobilize the entire population. Anyone capable of entering that world should do so."
The young man with glasses nodded, his tone heavy with clarity.
"I agree. This may... be the only path left for our civilization to survive."
The iron-blooded man frowned.

"This game has already swept across the entire world. The number of players currently online has reached two billion, basically covering the entire population between the ages of eighteen and forty-five."
"But the key issue is that world has its own order. The authority of the NPC empires and the power of player guilds are intertwined into a complex and firmly established web."
"If we are to place our hopes in it, then should we fight for control of that web? That is a question we cannot avoid."
The bespectacled man adjusted his glasses and nodded.
"Judging from the current situation, the power structure of World Zone No. 616 has basically taken shape."
The old man let out a soft sound of interest, and a trace of curiosity flashed in his eyes.
"I do not know much about that world. Can you explain it in greater detail?"
The young man smiled faintly, his voice tinged with respect.
"At present, the player with the greatest power and influence in World Zone No. 616 is named Faustus."
"This man possesses unmatched prestige. All the top players have gathered under his command, and at this very moment, he is leading an army in a campaign against World Zone No. 1213."
"Because that World Zone showed tremendous hostility toward both World Zone No. 616 and Faustus himself, the current situation came to be..."
Hearing this, the corners of the old man’s mouth slowly curved upward.
"This person... seems quite remarkable."
He leaned back in his chair and looked out the window at the sky dyed red by the evening glow.
"Since that world has laws of its own, then we should follow those laws."
"As for who holds the initiative..."
He withdrew his gaze, and a sharp light flashed in his eyes.
"Do you really think that when the day comes for the game and reality to merge into one, the initiative will still remain in our hands?"
His words fell like a boulder into the center of a lake, stirring up a thousand waves.
Everyone present was shaken.
That was right.
The moment the two worlds truly merged would also be the moment the entire world order was reshuffled.
When that time came, whoever possessed the greatest strength would be the one who made the rules.
The old man chuckled softly, his laughter carrying both ease and clarity.
"So there is actually very little we can do... Make a plan and let the entire population enter that world. In the end, the future still belongs to the young."
World Zone No. 1213, Aha Harbor
The city’s defenses had already been fully taken over by the army of World Zone No. 616, and heavy troops were stationed throughout the city.
Flash!
Daniel stepped out of the portal and walked straight into the Lord’s Manor.
After accepting the class change quest, he had a new idea.
Hunting legendary-grade powerhouses was now his top priority.

After all, Fragments of the Immortal Singularity were special bound items. They could not be obtained through sales boosted by Millionfold Boost. He would have to personally kill three hundred legendary-grade powerhouses to complete the quest.
And ordinary players could not participate in battles against legendary-grade enemies.
They should not waste their time in World Zone No. 1213.
Instead, they should seize the opportunity presented by the current chaos in World Zone No. 1213 and use it to grow stronger.
The growth potential of players far surpassed that of NPCs.
Perhaps in the early stages, NPC strength was an insurmountable mountain.
But by the middle and later stages, players would inevitably soar.
One day, legendary-grade players would be everywhere, and supreme-grade players would be a common sight.
Now was the time to strengthen the player base.
The stronger his legion players became, the stronger Daniel effectively became as well.
The imperial NPC forces possessed foundations deeper than anyone could imagine.
This Undead Cataclysm, barring any unexpected development, was bound to end in failure.
But Daniel did not want it to fail too quickly.
For every extra day the Undead Cataclysm continued, the foundations of World Zone No. 1213 would be worn down for one more day.

Under these circumstances, it was the perfect situation for players to fight in small squads, gradually eroding the strength of World Zone No. 1213’s players while also easing the pressure on the undead, allowing them to last longer.
Daniel opened the mission editing panel. After finishing his revisions, he sent it out.
The players of Doom Legion enjoyed abundant benefits, and their resources ranked among the richest in all of World Zone No. 616.
Daniel set the requirement for accepting the mission at one gold coin.
[Legion Announcement: Legion Commander "Faustus" has issued the mission "Campaign Against World Zone No. 1213"! Requirement to accept: 1 gold coin!]
The announcement rang out three times in succession.
When the players of Doom Legion heard it, they were all stunned.
This was the first time they had ever seen their guild leader issue a legion mission.
Although there was a one-gold-coin requirement, to them it was negligible.
Tens of millions of players immediately accepted the mission and opened the quest panel to check its details.
[Purge Sector E of World Zone No. 1213] (Legion Mission)
Mission Issuer: Faustus
Mission Difficulty: S-Rank
Mission Objective:
Exterminate every hostile player within Sector E. Leave nothing behind.
Mission Description:

World Zone No. 1213 has now been divided into five sectors—A, B, C, D, and E. The iron hooves of the legion have already crushed part of the cities in Sector E, yet remnants of the enemy still lurk in the shadows, roaming about and causing trouble.
All who accept this order may temporarily lay down their legion duties and either form teams or act alone to hunt down every hostile player within Sector E.
Wherever our blades point, that land shall become our territory.
May all of you return in triumph!
Mission Duration: Long-term
Mission Rewards: Large amounts of merit points, guild points...
After reading the mission, the legion players were thrilled.
"Our guild leader is unbeatable! If I were the one who had captured that castle in World Zone No. 1213, I would definitely hold it to the death and never retreat."
"This is what a true warrior looks like—attack, attack, attack!"
"There’s no need to say anything more. Wherever the guild leader’s command points, that’s where my sword will strike."
"Which priest has the strongest healing? I want to find one for some buffs..."
"Three-man combat squad, average level 80+, recruiting one priest with Resurrection to complete the mission together. Minimum level 50."
"Seven-man combat team, still missing one top-tier archer. Ranged damage dealers with area-of-effect attacks preferred."
"Recruiting for an all-knight squad! We currently have eight members and five open slots. Top-tier knight players are welcome to join our Round Table Knights. Excellent terms offered!"

chapters.title: Chapter 135 -135-Why Are Players from Other Zones So Weak?
paragraphs: On the desolate plain, a five-man squad from World No. 616 lay hidden in ambush.
Not far ahead, another five-man team from World Zone No. 1213 was grinding an Undead Boss.
The lineup of the No. 1213 World Zone squad consisted of two archers, one warrior, one priest, and one mage.
Meanwhile, the team from World No. 616 had a far more complete composition—an archer, an assassin, a mage, a priest, and a warrior, each fulfilling their role perfectly.
At this moment, the players from World Zone No. 1213 had already chipped away half of the Boss’s HP.
Watching the scene unfold, the players from World No. 616 could not help but feel a strange sense of disbelief.
The warrior, Dreamchaser, frowned and said,
"Skylight, why do I feel like that warrior from World Zone No. 1213 is ridiculously weak?"
Captain Skylight curled his lips into a faint smile.

"Don’t forget how many guild blessings we have stacked on us—Guild Glory and Legion Blessing layered one over another. With buffs like that, if we were only about as strong as the players from World Zone No. 1213, wouldn’t that be a complete joke?"
The assassin, Nightblade, let out a soft chuckle.

"Exactly. And what the captain mentioned is only the tip of the iceberg. The real key is that we have access to guild channels, which let us buy EXP cards and skill books. On top of that, our massive stockpile of merit points allows us to exchange for divine weapons and legendary armor."
His eyes lit up with reverence.
"If it weren’t for Lord Faustus, how could we possibly have such absurd combat power? Even those big shots from real-world financial empires envy our gear and battle strength..."
He clicked his tongue twice before continuing.
"Under normal circumstances, players like the ones from World Zone No. 1213—hovering around a few thousand damage per hit—that’s what ordinary players are actually supposed to look like."
Dreamchaser nodded deeply in agreement.

"That’s true. After staying in the guild for so long, I started thinking everyone was more or less on our level. But after seeing these players from other zones, I finally understand why the players of World No. 616 dominate the level rankings."
The priest, Sacred_Word, joked with a grin,
"Doesn’t everyone feel like we’ve been cultivating in seclusion deep in the mountains for a thousand years, only to come down and suddenly realize we’re invincible?"
The group exchanged looks and burst into laughter.
Just then, Skylight lowered his voice.
"Nightblade, the time’s about right. Go in under stealth and get ready to steal their Boss."
Nightblade nodded, activating an assassin secret art as his figure melted into the shadows.
"Everyone, stay sharp. The players from World Zone No. 1213 may be weak, but that doesn’t mean we can afford to get sloppy."
"Don’t worry, Captain."
"I guarantee I’ll send them straight back to the respawn point the moment we meet."
The warrior from World Zone No. 1213 raised his shield and barely managed to block one of the Boss’s attacks in time.
In the next instant, a beam of holy light descended upon him.
He knew immediately that it was his team’s priest keeping his HP topped up.
"Exploding Fireball!"
A blazing fireball slammed into the Boss.
The warrior from World Zone No. 1213 brightened at once. One of their archers had actually triggered a critical hit.
The Boss’s aggro instantly shifted away from the warrior and onto the archer.
Seeing the Ghost Knight about to charge toward the archer, the warrior of World Zone No. 1213, Berserker Bear, quickly used his taunt skill the moment it came off cooldown.
"You big idiot, fight me instead!"
Roar—!
As expected, the Ghost Knight’s aggro snapped back onto the warrior.
From the rear, long-range attacks kept raining down on the Boss, whose HP had already been reduced to a sliver.
All it would take was a single hit, and this Epic-grade Boss would fall!
Then, all of a sudden—
Whoosh!
An arrow shot through the air.
At the same time, a figure abruptly appeared behind the Boss.
"Ambush!"
Fatal Strike!
Roar!
The tall Undead Boss’s green flames went out in an instant, and its entire skeletal body collapsed to the ground.
The five players from World Zone No. 1213 froze on the spot.
They stared blankly as the assassin calmly and expertly picked up the loot dropped by the Undead Boss, their minds going completely blank.
"What a beautiful strike—that damage was insanely high!"
"Wait... our team... doesn’t seem to have this guy, does it?"
"Huh? Right, who the hell is he?"
At that moment, one of their teammates behind them suddenly shouted,
"Holy shit! He’s a player from World No. 616! That bastard stole our Boss!"
Berserker Bear snapped back to his senses and hurriedly raised his shield.
The assassin from World No. 616 looked at them with blatant contempt and sneered.
"This Boss even dropped an Epic-grade piece of equipment. Not bad at all."
He paused for a beat, then added the final twist of the knife.
"Thanks for your hard work."
With that, his figure suddenly vanished from the spot.
Hearing those words, the players from World Zone No. 1213 were so angry they nearly coughed up blood.
That assassin’s taunting "skill" was even more effective than a warrior’s!
"Dreamchaser, that dumb warrior is yours."
Skylight drew his bow and aimed at the two archers from World Zone No. 1213.
Without another word, Dreamchaser activated Sprint and charged straight at the enemy.
At the same time, Skylight released the string.
Seven arrows struck the two archers from World Zone No. 1213 at the same instant.
The two archers were killed on the spot.
Meanwhile, the priest of World No. 616, Sacred_Word, had already thrown a full set of debuffs onto the mage from World Zone No. 1213.
At almost the same moment, that mage finished his chant, and an Exploding Fireball appeared above his head.
But the fireball had actually shrunk by sixty to seventy percent, becoming even smaller than the most basic Fireball spell. Its flight speed was so slow that even a cripple could dodge it.
The mage from World Zone No. 1213 stared in disbelief.
"This priest’s debuffs are this overpowered?!"
Before he could recover from the shock, a shout rang out from behind him.
"Lightning Stab!"
The vanished assassin, Nightblade, suddenly reappeared at his back, and a string of attacks instantly took him down.
At that very moment, a lightning spell struck the priest of World Zone No. 1213 from above.
The fragile priest dropped dead on the spot.
Skylight gave the mage, Lightning Dancer, a thumbs-up.
"One-shot kill!"
Lightning Dancer shrugged.
"These players from World Zone No. 1213 are way too weak."
In the blink of an eye, the only one left standing on the field was the warrior from World Zone No. 1213, Berserker Bear.
Seeing all his teammates watching him, Dreamchaser flashed a wide grin, his white teeth gleaming.
"Kid, let me send you on your way."
"Flameburst Impact!"
In an instant, his greatsword was engulfed in blazing fire as he brought it crashing down onto the shield.
The next second, the shield shattered outright, and the blade continued through, slashing into the opponent’s body.
Berserker Bear was instantly killed!

chapters.title: Chapter 136 -136-Unvanquished Reaper Quin Requests to Join the Battle
paragraphs: Skylight and the others gathered together to divide the spoils.
Leaving aside the experience and merit points, just the items dropped by those five players from the other zone were enough to make them grin from ear to ear.
Not to mention the treasures dropped by the Epic-grade Boss.
This trip had been a guaranteed profit.
"Following Guildmaster Faustus really was the smartest choice," Skylight said with a sigh of admiration.
"Yeah, thanks to the Guildmaster keeping us in mind, we got to come here first and hunt down these players from World Zone No. 1213," Dreamchaser chimed in.
Nightblade said with a smile, "If nothing unexpected happens, by the time this mission ends, our strength will definitely jump by another huge margin."
The priest Sacred_Word said calmly, "Enough talk. We need to hurry and kill a few more players from World Zone No. 1213."
"Exactly. We get stronger while also earning merit points and guild points. Opportunities like this don’t come around often."

Light flashed in Skylight’s eyes. "Let’s not waste time on those lone players from World Zone No. 1213. Leave them to the others. With the strength of just the five of us, we can pull off something big!"
"Agreed! They’re all trash!"
"I feel like I could push all the way to the main city by myself, hahaha..."
World Zone No. 1213, Imperial Capital.
On the square in front of the Grand General’s Manor, Quin sat cross-legged with tens of thousands of players behind him.
The sea of people stretched as far as the eye could see, dense and silent, solemn as an expeditionary army on the verge of setting out.
It was a magnificent sight, drawing countless NPCs and passing players from World Zone No. 1213 to stop and watch.
"I heard that Unvanquished Reaper Quin is here?"
One player from World Zone No. 1213 craned his neck curiously.
"That long-haired guy is him."
Someone pointed at the lone, aloof figure standing at the very front of the crowd, his face full of disdain.
"Why do they call him Unvanquished Reaper?"

"I heard Quin has a hidden class called Savage Evil Ghost, and supposedly he also possesses the unique SSS-grade talent Undying Ghost Body. In the Hidden World, he once fought ten Epic-grade NPCs alone and remained undefeated, suppressing every single player in that secret realm by himself."
"It seems that everyone there died at least once at his hands, so those people started calling him Unvanquished Reaper."
"By the gods... he’s that terrifying?!"
The players of World Zone No. 1213 were visibly shaken.
"Terrifying my ass. He couldn’t even stop the Undead Cataclysm, which just proves he’s still inferior to Faustus of World Zone No. 616!"
The player who had just explained it looked openly annoyed.
This Quin called himself a god of war, yet in the end he had changed nothing, and his temper was terrible too. He had been unhappy with him for a long time.
"So why are they sitting here?"
Another player from World Zone No. 1213 lowered his voice and explained,
"These are all members of the rising guild Demonwood. They gathered here to respond to the invasion from World Zone No. 616."
"That cheating bastard Faustus forcibly triggered a World War, seized our fortress, and slaughtered our people... but the Empire seems to have no intention of intervening."
He let out a sigh. "It’s probably because the Undead Cataclysm has tied down too much of the Empire’s attention, leaving them with no energy to spare."
Only then did the surrounding players come to a sudden realization.
"So... Demonwood is staging a sit-in here to request that the Empire send troops to eliminate those invaders?"
"That’s probably exactly it."
As soon as those words were spoken, the nearby players were instantly filled with righteous indignation.
"Those bastards from World Zone No. 616 are just too hateful! Last time, not only did they steal my Undead Boss, they even ambushed and killed me!"
That sentence was like opening a floodgate.
Countless players rushed to recount their own experiences.
"That’s nothing. You only lost a Boss and your life. What I went through was ten times worse than that!"
Everyone’s gaze immediately focused on the speaker.
Through gritted teeth, he said, "Those demons are absolutely insane!"
"They deliberately lured hordes of undead to attack our villages and towns. Then, after we fought the undead until both sides were crippled, they jumped out from the shadows..."
"And wiped out both us and the undead in one sweep! Tell me, is there any act more shameless and despicable than that?"
"This is the greatest humiliation!"
The moment those words came out, the surrounding players of World Zone No. 1213 instantly felt the same rage. Flames of fury burned in every pair of eyes.
"By the gods! Those cheating dogs from World Zone No. 616 are rotten to the core!"
"These devils have no shame at all!"
"No wonder Demonwood’s members are asking the Empire to send troops. All those invaders deserve to die!"
Originally, many of them had thought their own experiences were unlucky enough. Who would have imagined that others had suffered even worse?
And once people started talking, they realized that almost everyone had gone through something similar.
"Drive out the invaders from World Zone No. 616!"
"Send them back to their own World Zone!"
"World Zone No. 1213 is our land, not a place for them to trample as they please!"
The crowd surged with anger, voices crashing like a tidal wave.
Just then, a rider on a fast horse came galloping out from the direction of the imperial palace, heading straight for the Grand General’s Manor.
The players of World Zone No. 1213 quickly parted to make way.
The knight reined in his horse before the players of the Demonwood guild and swept his gaze across the crowd.
"Who is Quin?"
Quin stood up and raised his eyes toward the knight. "I am."
The knight looked him up and down, then took out a scroll from his robes and handed it over.
"His Majesty has approved your request."
With that, the knight turned his horse and rode off.
Quin took the scroll, and a faint smile rose at the corner of his lips.
The core members of Demonwood immediately crowded around him.
"Boss, we did it! We can finally mobilize a great army to wipe out those invaders!"
"Lord Quin, please make sure to take me with you in the punitive campaign!"
"Lord Quin, hurry and check the mission. Did the Empire assign us dozens of Legendary-grade powerhouses?"
"That cheating dog Faustus is way too overpowered. Only Legendary-grade experts can contend with him!"
Quin unrolled the scroll and gave a slight nod.
The news spread like wildfire.
In less than half a day, word that Quin, the number one expert of World Zone No. 1213, was about to lead a campaign against Faustus had spread throughout the entire zone.

And as the rumor spread, it became more and more absurd. By the end, it had turned into Quin leading hundreds of millions of troops and hundreds of Legendary-grade powerhouses on an expedition to crush Faustus.
The whole of World Zone No. 1213 fell into a state of feverish excitement.
No matter how strong Faustus was, could he kill hundreds of Legendary-grade powerhouses?
No matter how elite his legion was, could it stand against hundreds of millions of troops?
What’s more, Quin was the number one expert of World Zone No. 1213, while Faustus was the number one expert of World Zone No. 616.
Who said Quin had to be inferior to Faustus?
Who said the players of World Zone No. 1213 had to be weaker than those of World Zone No. 616?
Maybe Faustus’s reputation was enormous, but that was only because he had never crossed paths with Quin!
After all, Quin was a super powerhouse who had swept through the entire Hidden World without a single rival!
And Faustus had a dragon—but their Lord Quin had a dragon too!
At this moment, Quin stood at the center of attention in World Zone No. 1213.
Countless players of World Zone No. 1213 looked upon him with burning admiration, just as the players of World Zone No. 616 acknowledged Faustus.
"Demonwood will win!"
"Lord Quin, drive out the invaders and defeat that cheating dog Faustus!"
"The time for World Zone No. 1213 to turn the tables is finally coming!"

chapters.title: Chapter 137 -137-War Is About to Erupt — A Clash Between Supreme Powers
paragraphs: Because the players of World Zone No. 1213 had publicized it so aggressively, every World Zone had already heard the news.
The Multiversal World Channel was in an uproar.
"Unvanquished Reaper Quin, charge! Take Faustus down! We of World Zone No. 250 are backing you all the way!"
"Brother Quin, keep it up! Unvanquished Reaper, forever undefeated!"
"The players of World Zone No. 82 have been waiting to see that cheating dog Faustus fall from his pedestal! Brother Quin, win some honor for us!"
Then the channel of World No. 616 exploded as well.
"Unvanquished Reaper? He sure talks big."
"I know that guy—the one ranked first in the Hidden World."

"Oh, give me a break. The Hidden World is tiny. The top player there, no matter how you dress it up, is just some local champion from a backwater village. Our Lord Faustus is on a whole cosmic level!"
"The guy above is absolutely right! A village-level player got hyped into a universe-level legend—what a joke. Is he even worthy?"
"Lord Faustus probably can’t even be bothered to pay attention to a clown like that!"
"But I heard World Zone No. 1213 is sending several hundred million troops, along with hundreds of Legendary-grade powerhouses... Can Lord Faustus really withstand that?"
"Listen carefully. There are two ironclad truths in this world."
"What two truths?"
"First, if you get stabbed, you die. Second—Lord Faustus is the eternal god!"
"Faustus is my idol. He’s invincible. Anyone who disagrees is welcome to challenge him!"
"So when exactly does the battle start? Too bad I’m not in Doom Guild. I can’t go to World Zone No. 1213, so I won’t get to witness Lord Faustus making his move with my own eyes."
"Aren’t there portals in the game? Once the armies clash, we should be able to see it soon enough."
"I don’t care how the armies fight. I just want to watch Lord Faustus grind that so-called Unvanquished Reaper into the dirt."
"Come on, everyone, let’s chip in and buy fireworks. Once the final result is out, we’ll celebrate properly."
"Don’t you people think you’re getting happy a little too early?"
"A real man ought to have this kind of confidence!"
The battle for the title of the world’s strongest player!
The decisive showdown between World No. 616 and World Zone No. 1213!
The first collision between the legendary Faustus and Unvanquished Reaper Quin!
An explosive event like this, packed with conflict and tension, instantly went viral across the entire internet and even spilled over into the real world.

Players from World Zone No. 1213 began live text coverage on both the game forum’s World section and the World Zone No. 1213 section, documenting this major event that was destined to be written into gaming history.
Coincidentally, players from World No. 616 also started real-time live coverage in both the World section and the World No. 616 section.
At the moment, those threads still contained no actual content, yet countless excited players had already manually bumped them to the top as if pinning them in place.
Faustus and Quin—these two players who could determine the future course of history for World No. 616 and World Zone No. 1213—had become the center of attention for the entire player base.
Even in the real world, media outlets from every region were scrambling to report on the coming in-game war.
[Stellar Erupts! Peak Showdown Between World Zone No. 1213 and World No. 616 — Who Will Laugh Last?]
[The Battle for Stellar’s Number One — Who Is Stronger, Faustus or Quin?]
Player-versus-player conflict in Stellar had become the hottest topic on the internet!
Countless NPC shops hung banners in support of Quin, shouting: "Charge, Unvanquished Reaper!"
But in World No. 616, the scale of attention and excitement was far greater than in World Zone No. 1213.
According to statistics, fireworks in many major cities on Earth had already been bought out completely.
Shops and companies from all walks of life had launched support events for Faustus, each one waving banners and cheering him on.
[Today, the two great World Zones of Stellar may finally decide victory or defeat!]
[Exclusive Bombshell — The True Strength of Faustus’s NPC Powerhouses Finally Revealed! World No. 616 Will Win!]
[Shocking! Faustus’s True Face Turns Out to Be This...]
And it was not only World No. 616 and World Zone No. 1213—every World Zone was drowning the airwaves with reports on this coming battle of the century.
Compared to World No. 616 and World Zone No. 1213, which cared more about the outcome itself, the other World Zones were more focused on something else...
The profound impact that the game Stellar was having on the real world.
At least for now, the game world had already dealt a massive shock to reality.
Mauler.
Scout reports kept arriving one after another at Daniel’s side.
"The detailed forces deployed by World Zone No. 1213 are as follows: thirty million troops from the Imperial Legion, with special units making up ten percent. Their average level is Level 80."
"The player legion is centered on the core members of Demonwood Guild, numbering five million. In addition, approximately ten million players from World Zone No. 1213 have joined voluntarily."
"There are thirty to thirty-five Legendary-grade powerhouses, one hundred twenty-six Exalted-grade powerhouses, and one thousand two hundred twenty Epic-grade powerhouses."
"Guildmaster, the Imperial Legion of World Zone No. 1213 has already appeared at Earth City!"
When Daniel heard that, his eyes lit up.
"Earth City..."
Earth City.
A streak of Blackgold-grade light cut across the sky.
Daniel came to a steady halt a hundred miles outside Earth City.
At that moment, the army of World Zone No. 1213 was marching right through that area.
The formation of tens of millions of troops stretched for thousands of miles, with no end in sight.
His sudden appearance caused the entire army of World Zone No. 1213 to stop advancing.
Countless players from World Zone No. 1213 raised their heads and looked toward the solitary, aloof figure in the sky.
"By the gods—Faustus, that cheating dog, actually dares to come out and attack on his own!"
"Has he been scared stupid? Is he here to kneel and beg for mercy?!"
"Hahahaha... maybe that’s exactly it. Otherwise, why would he dare come alone?"
"No, we absolutely cannot accept his surrender. Even if he kowtows until his forehead splits open, we can’t forgive him—unless he voluntarily hands over the resources of World No. 616!"
"Exactly. If apologizing were enough, then what would be the point of us gathering here?"
"We’re going to kill our way into World No. 616 too, and let those cheating dogs see what we’re made of!"
"That’s why Lord Unvanquished Reaper is the real deal. He hasn’t even made a move yet, and cheating dog Faustus has already pissed himself in fear, hahaha..."
In the distance, the second Legendary-grade powerhouse Daniel had recently recruited was hovering at a high vantage point with a wide field of view, carrying a human player in one hand.
Lucas was so excited he could barely contain himself.
He had never imagined that Guildmaster Faustus would choose him to serve as the recorder of this great war.
The tangled hostility between World No. 616 and World Zone No. 1213 was destined to make this decisive battle part of gaming history.
And now, the honor of witnessing it had fallen upon him.

chapters.title: Chapter 138 -138-Explosion! With a Raise of His Hand, He Annihilated a Ten-Million-Strong Army!
paragraphs: Lucas quickly opened the game’s built-in forum and started a real-time text livestream simultaneously in the Multiverse section and the No. 616 World Zone section.
[17:00 — No. 616 World Zone · Faustus, standing alone against an army of tens of millions!]
In the post, Lucas wrote down his impressions of the battlefield.
[The imperial army from World Zone No. 1213 stretches beyond the horizon. They cover thousands of miles — how could their numbers possibly be counted in mere tens of millions?]
[And yet Faustus stands right in front of an army like that. The wind tugs at the corners of his robe, and there he is, all alone, standing proudly in place.]
[He’s planning to... challenge the entire army of an empire by himself!]
Under the livestream thread, players from World Zone No. 616 began piling up replies one after another.
"Faustus is really alone? This scene is making me think of that World War in the secret realm last time..."
"Relax, relax. Faustus is famous for being a humanoid natural disaster — by himself, he’s worth an entire army."
"Seriously invincible. Facing tens of millions all alone and not even flinching!"
"Hold on, boss! Once you win, give me a chance to join Doom Guild!!"
"The guy upstairs is dreaming."
Daniel gazed coldly at the forces before him.
He treated the tens of millions of warriors from World Zone No. 1213 as if they were nothing, as though they were no more than ants by the roadside.
Roar—!
Hisss...
Yet in the very next moment, the mounts and pets within the legion of World Zone No. 1213 suddenly grew restless all at once, neighing and shrieking one after another.
A bone-deep chill abruptly rose through the bodies of countless warriors from World Zone No. 1213.
The man in their field of vision did not look particularly special, and yet he gave them the suffocating pressure of facing a legendary-grade powerhouse.
The momentum of the tens-of-millions-strong army from World Zone No. 1213 was actually being completely suppressed by Faustus alone.
Lucas faithfully recorded this moment.
[From the looks of it, Faustus is clearly crushing them with sheer pressure. He’s practically making those guys from World Zone No. 1213 unable to breathe!]
[To put it simply, he’s not just going to crush them in strength — he’s going to make sure they can’t even lift their heads in terms of aura!]
"This move doesn’t do much damage, but the humiliation factor is off the charts."
"Holy shit, that arrogant? I’m actually starting to respect Faustus for real now. He’s way too insane!"
"The boss is truly wild — but I like it!"
"Even if the whole world stands against him, it still won’t stop Boss Faustus from moving forward!!"
"Who says a single stick breaks easily? Look at Faustus right now — this is what legendary-grade individual strength really means!"
"After this battle, let those pieces of trash from Zone 1213 who love slandering and smearing others experience what true despair feels like!"
At the same time, the livestream thread from players of World Zone No. 1213 had also gone live.
[That cheating dog Faustus is insanely arrogant. Just waiting for him to slap himself in the face...]
Players from World Zone No. 1213 flooded the thread with replies.
"Demonwood, charge! Let that cheating dog see what we’re made of!"
"Warriors of Demonwood, teach that Faustus bastard how to behave!"
"He’s just one person! If we still lose this battle, we might as well kill ourselves to apologize!"
"That bastard!"
"He’s dead for sure!"
At this moment, the players of World Zone No. 1213 had flames practically shooting from their eyes. This was an enormous humiliation to them!
They all turned their gazes toward Quin.
Quin’s face was ashen, his eyes flickering uncertainly.
And then, right at that moment—
Ninety-nine clones suddenly materialized around Daniel!
The instant those clones appeared, they activated God Speed, blinking across the battlefield and dispersing to every corner of World Zone No. 1213’s military formation.
At the same time, they all raised Stellar Wrath.
[Shattering Comet]!
[Shadowfont]!
[Arrowstorm]!
[Aetherlance]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
Tens of thousands of skills poured down in the same instant, as though heaven and earth were collapsing.
Golden arrow rain, purple thunder-serpents, dark curses, and burning meteors intertwined into a death net that blanketed the sky.
Blood-red damage numbers cascaded down like a waterfall.
In a single exchange, the number of warriors in World Zone No. 1213’s legion was reduced by one-third!
More than ten million lives vanished in less than a second!
At this rate, it would take only three waves for the mighty army of World Zone No. 1213 to be completely wiped out.
Lucas’s hands trembled as he recorded the scene, overwhelmed with excitement.
[Faustus has made his move! With one attack, a third of World Zone No. 1213’s army is gone — my eyeballs are about to pop out of my head!]
The replies from players of World Zone No. 616 exploded instantly.
"WTF? Is the boss playing match-three or something?"
"Match-three my ass — that’s a freaking army of tens of millions! Since when does match-three work like that?! He’s invincible!"
"Today, Faustus is teaching everyone the proper way to use AoE skills!"
"I understand the principle, I’m just missing the cheat. Where do I pick one up? (doge)"
"No, seriously, why is an archer’s AOE skill producing the effect of a mage’s forbidden curse? What kind of joke is this?"
"Absurd, right? Watch carefully and learn. Forbidden curse? A forbidden curse isn’t even close!"
World Zone No. 1213 battlefield.
"Faustus!"
"Today will be the end of your legendary-grade reign!"
A dragon’s roar suddenly exploded across the sky, the sound surging like rolling thunder.
Quin’s figure dove down from the clouds. Standing atop the dragon’s back, his long hair whipped wildly in the wind.
Sword in hand, his face was gloomy, and his gaze locked firmly onto the figure hovering in midair.
"What’s so impressive about slaughtering the weak? I am your true opponent!"
Before his words had even fully fallen, the dragon beat its wings and carried him forward like a meteor, charging straight at Faustus.
Faustus’s face remained calm as still water.
In his eyes, this so-called Unvanquished Reaper was not even worthy of polishing his shoes.
Lucas nervously recorded everything before him.
[Quin has appeared! He declared: killing that trash doesn’t count for anything — your opponent is me!]
[But what about Faustus? There isn’t even the slightest change in his expression. He doesn’t take Quin seriously at all.]
[Next, the ultimate showdown is about to begin!]
"Wait, ’killing that trash’? Are you sure those were Quin’s exact words?"
"Hahahaha... this thread is obviously filled with extremely strong subjective interpretation!"
"Faustus: barking in front of me? Are you worthy?"
"The show’s starting, the show’s starting! Charge, Boss Faustus!"
"The champagne’s already prepared — just waiting for the celebration!"
Facing Quin’s headlong charge, Faustus slowly raised Stellar Wrath.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
Invisible chains of wind surged forth from the void, binding Quin and his dragon tightly in place.
Quin let out a cold sneer. "You think a trick like this can hold me?"
A flash of light burst from his body, and he instantly broke free of the restraints.
Yet Faustus swung Stellar Wrath again.
A second [Wind’s Embrace] followed immediately after.
Quin was bound once more.
"He can cast a restraining skill infinitely?!"
Quin’s face instantly turned deathly pale.
His immunity skill required time to cool down, but Faustus’s restraint seemed endless.
Right now, as long as Faustus casually threw out any attack skill, Quin would die without a doubt!
When Lucas saw this, his heart pounded wildly.
He stared fixedly at Faustus, eagerly awaiting the moment he would strike and instantly kill Quin,彻底 dragging this number one expert of World Zone No. 1213 down from his pedestal.
And yet Faustus did not even spare a glance for the immobilized Quin.
He simply stood there, a faint smile hanging at the corner of his lips, as though waiting for something.
Lucas shuddered all over, and a chill rose from the bottom of his heart.
At that very moment—
Several dozen figures suddenly shot up into the sky from within World Zone No. 1213’s army and charged straight toward Faustus!

chapters.title: Chapter 139 -139-He Beat the Tears Out of Them
paragraphs: Those figures were none other than the legendary-grade powerhouses of World Zone No. 1213.
Faustus’s gaze sharpened, and he instantly activated [Ring of Void].
"Come out, all of you!"
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh—!
Several dozen legendary-grade powerhouses from World Zone No. 616 appeared out of thin air.
The moment they emerged, they turned into streaks of light and rushed forward to intercept the experts of World Zone No. 1213.
Godscar unfolded in an instant.
Quin had originally still held on to a sliver of hope, counting on those legendary-grade experts to turn the situation around.
But when he saw the legendary-grade powerhouses of World Zone No. 616 surge out like a tide, his heart sank completely into the abyss.
Faustus had actually brought this many legendary-grade experts with him...
Quin fell into terrified despair.

Especially when he saw Faustus’s ninety-nine clones descend upon the battlefield, effortlessly crushing the tens of millions of warriors and players from World Zone No. 1213 like wheat before a scythe, his face turned deathly pale.
He felt as if he finally understood why Faustus had not killed him immediately.
It was so that he could watch with his own eyes as his people were slaughtered, as his empire was trampled beneath their feet!
A wave of bitterness rose from the depths of his heart to his throat.
Tears slid down Quin’s face uncontrollably.
"So this is... despair..."
"I lost."
Faustus looked at Quin indifferently, as if he were looking at an ant.
He raised Stellar Wrath.
[Piercing Spear]!
A ray of golden light instantly blasted Quin’s head apart!
Unvanquished Reaper — dead!
Lucas, who witnessed the scene with his own eyes, trembled all over with excitement.
The battle for the title of Stellar’s number one had been decided!
Faustus had won in absolute fashion!
The Unvanquished Reaper of World Zone No. 1213 had been utterly defeated!
[Holy shit! You people probably won’t believe this, but that so-called undefeated Reaper from World Zone No. 1213 got beaten by Boss Faustus until even his little pearls came falling out!]
[At this very moment, I am fortunate enough to witness this piece of history in person, and all I feel is pride and honor!]
The replies under the livestream post instantly exploded.
"Boss Faustus has ascended to godhood! Long live World Zone No. 616!"
"Faustus — I hereby declare him the strongest person in the entire Stellar world!"
"That’s right. In this whole Stellar world, there’s no one left who can compare with him."
"Friends, are the fireworks and champagne ready? Let’s go!"
Across the major castles of World Zone No. 616—
"Celebrate Boss Faustus’s great feat! Celebrate World Zone No. 616!"
"Light them up!"
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Countless fireworks and celebratory cannons burst into the night sky, dyeing the heavens into a brilliant seven-colored tapestry.
In the major main cities, countless mages spontaneously formed ranks, raised their staffs, and chanted in unison.
A moment later, innumerable fireballs shot into the sky and exploded overhead with thunderous blasts.
Countless priests shouted together:
"Boss Faustus is invincible! Long live World Zone No. 616!"
Thousands upon thousands of flash bombs soared into the heavens, blossoming into blazing light.
Countless shield warriors beat their weapons against their shields, their voices loud and passionate as they merged into a sky-shaking battle cry.
"Boss Faustus is invincible!"
"Long live World Zone No. 616!"
Faustus spread his wings and flew toward Earthspire.
No. 2 followed closely behind, carrying Lucas in one hand.
At Earthspire’s resurrection point—
Quin had just stepped out of the revival light when a series of icy system notifications rang out in his ears.
[Ding~ You have been killed by player "Faustus" of World Zone No. 616! "Crippling Blow" has been triggered. All current attributes -50%, duration: permanent!]
[Notice: You have suffered "Death Curse" — Level -5! Equipment -6 pieces! All materials in your backpack have dropped!]
[Notice: You have triggered "Pain Curse" — gold coin -150 million! Your wealth has been locked. Please repay your debt to player "Faustus" as soon as possible to lift the seal.]
After hearing all of it, Quin looked as though his soul had been hollowed out.
"Pfft—!"
He was so furious that he spat out a mouthful of blood on the spot.
[Notice: You have triggered "Crippling Blow" effect, HP -1000!]
He stood there in a daze, his mind completely blank.
He knew Faustus possessed terrifying death-penalty abilities, but he had never imagined they would be this outrageous.
Whoosh—!
At that moment, a figure appeared before him.
Faustus!
A faint smile rose on Faustus’s lips. "Looks like I’m pretty lucky. You really were here."
He had only come to try his luck, yet he had actually found him.
Faustus raised Stellar Wrath.
[Piercing Spear]!
Quin died again!
Faustus waited for him to resurrect once more, then dropped another skill on him.
The same scene repeated itself again and again. One minute later, Quin no longer appeared.
Lucas trembled as he recorded everything.
[It’s blown up! Faustus camped right outside the resurrection point and killed Quin over a dozen times in a row, personally sending him back to the Land of Rebirth!]
[At this very moment, I’m standing right here beside Boss Faustus — and even my calves are trembling...]
"Boss Faustus’s move is way too ruthless. Not only is he going to kill you, he’s going to kill you all the way through!"
"If a one-shot kill is onefold happiness, then camping the resurrection point is tenfold happiness!"
"That’s right. I’m going to stand right inside your territory’s castle and slaughter you over and over again in front of everyone!"
"Faustus, eternal god!"
After sending Quin back to Starter Village, Faustus turned to No. 2 and said,
"Put Lucas down. Then come with me to support Godscar."
No. 2 immediately set Lucas down.
Faustus flapped his wings and vanished from the spot, while No. 2 turned into a streak of light and followed close behind.
Inside Godscar, the battle was already nearing its end.

If Faustus had not given orders beforehand to leave these World Zone No. 1213 experts alive for him to harvest personally, the powerhouses of World Zone No. 616 would have already killed every last one of them.
At this moment, most of the legendary-grade experts from World Zone No. 1213 were already heavily wounded, while not a single person on World Zone No. 616’s side had been injured.
The reason the battle was so one-sided was simple: among the experts of World Zone No. 1213, only a handful were high-grade, while all the rest were mid- or low-tier.
Meanwhile, under Faustus’s command, there were several transcendent powerhouses, and more than ten high-grade experts alone!
Faustus smiled faintly and lifted Stellar Wrath.
The harvest had begun!
He instantly teleported to the side of a high-grade expert from World Zone No. 1213.
That man was currently struggling bitterly to hold out under Carodion’s assault.
Faustus raised Stellar Wrath, and several skills poured down in a torrent.
[Shadowfont]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
Under the terrifying flood of skills, the HP of that legendary-grade expert from World Zone No. 1213 was instantly emptied, and he fell straight toward the earth on the spot.
[Ding! You have killed the legendary-grade expert "Morris (high-grade)" from World Zone No. 1213!
Experience +1 billion! gold coin +290,000!
World War point +1.2 million!
Obtained "Void Ghostblade (legendary-grade)"!
Obtained quest item "Fragment of the Immortal Singularity" ×1!]
Faustus’s eyes flickered slightly.
With [Godslayer’s Blessing], legendary-grade powerhouses really did guarantee a drop of Fragment of the Immortal Singularity!
One had to know that back when he had suppressed the shadowkin and the non-human races, he had killed so many legendary-grade powerhouses and still had never seen such an item.
That alone showed just how incredibly rare it was!
Faustus understood the importance of the Fragment of the Immortal Singularity better than anyone.
Being able to freeload a supreme-grade buff like this was no less valuable than freeloading an SSS-grade super talent!

1213, only a handful were high-grade, while all the rest were mid- or low-tier.
Meanwhile, under Faustus’s command, there were several transcendent powerhouses, and more than ten high-grade experts alone!
Faustus smiled faintly and lifted Stellar Wrath.
The harvest had begun!
He instantly teleported to the side of a high-grade expert from World Zone No.
That man was currently struggling bitterly to hold out under Carodion’s assault.
Faustus raised Stellar Wrath, and several skills poured down in a torrent.
[Shadowfont]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
Under the terrifying flood of skills, the HP of that legendary-grade expert from World Zone No.
1213 was instantly emptied, and he fell straight toward the earth on the spot.
[Ding!
You have killed the legendary-grade expert "Morris (high-grade)" from World Zone No.
Experience +1 billion! gold coin +290,000!
World War point +1.2 million!
Obtained "Void Ghostblade (legendary-grade)"!
Obtained quest item "Fragment of the Immortal Singularity" ×1!]
Faustus’s eyes flickered slightly.
With [Godslayer’s Blessing], legendary-grade powerhouses really did guarantee a drop of Fragment of the Immortal Singularity!
One had to know that back when he had suppressed the shadowkin and the non-human races, he had killed so many legendary-grade powerhouses and still had never seen such an item.
That alone showed just how incredibly rare it was!
Faustus understood the importance of the Fragment of the Immortal Singularity better than anyone.
Being able to freeload a supreme-grade buff like this was no less valuable than freeloading an SSS-grade super talent!

chapters.title: Chapter 140 -140-Breaking Two Cities in a Row, Lord of Divine Wrath
paragraphs: Over the next dozen or so minutes, he killed all thirty-five legendary-grade powerhouses from World Zone No. 1213 one by one.
[Ding! You have killed Spencer (low-grade), a legendary-grade powerhouse from World Zone No. 1213!
Experience +200 million! gold coin +160,000!
World War point +800,000!
Obtained "Voidless Battle Armor (legendary-grade)"!
Obtained quest item "Fragment of the Immortal Singularity" ×1!]
When the last legendary-grade powerhouse from World Zone No. 1213 fell, Godscar slowly dissipated.
Faustus cast [Seraphic Revival], placing the remains of those thirty-five World Zone No. 1213 experts into the holy light one by one.
After paying the price of 350 trillion gold coins, the bodies of those thirty-five legendary-grade powerhouses from World Zone No. 1213 re-formed within the sacred radiance.
Once revived, they had lost all of their memories and became Faustus’s slaves.
Faustus intended to use these experts from World Zone No. 1213 as nothing more than cannon fodder.
If he encountered a troublesome enemy, they would be the first ones sent in.
As for the legendary-grade powerhouses of World Zone No. 616, those were his true core strength. They needed to be cultivated carefully and losses had to be kept to a minimum.
Following his usual habit, he named them No. 3 through No. 37.
At this point, the number of legendary-grade powerhouses under his command had doubled once again!
Faustus opened the class advancement quest panel.
"The quest requires 300 Fragments of the Immortal Singularity..."
He murmured in a low voice.
The level 150 class quest for a forbidden-grade archer required him to collect 300 Fragments of the Immortal Singularity.
At the moment, it was obvious that completing this quest would still be a long and difficult road.
He led his group of legendary-grade powerhouses back to Earthspire.
There were still a huge number of natives from World Zone No. 1213 inside the city.
Faustus showed not the slightest trace of mercy. He summoned ninety-nine clones and swung Stellar Wrath at the same time.
[Shattering Comet]!
[Shadowfont]!
[Arrowstorm]!
[Aetherlance]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
With such overwhelming damage and nonstop frenzied output, no one could survive under Faustus’s skills for more than three seconds!
In just half an hour, Earthspire was completely slaughtered clean.
Faustus then occupied the castle.
This was only a First-rank City, not a main city, so there was no world announcement and no legendary-grade powerhouse stationed there.
But Faustus did not care.
If there were none here, then there would certainly be some in the main city!
"Head for the main city of World Zone No. 1213!"
That crazy idea suddenly surfaced in his mind.
A world zone only had nine main cities.
The importance of a main city to a World Zone went without saying.
Each main city was like an independent kingdom.
Capturing one was no less than conquering an entire kingdom’s territory!
Yet Faustus quickly decided to carry out that idea.
With the number of legendary-grade powerhouses he currently possessed, taking a main city would be no more difficult than lifting a hand!
After planning out his target, he immediately spread his wings and flew toward the nearest main city of World Zone No. 1213.
Divine Wrath City!

This giant city had been built against the mountains. Its dark stone walls rose dozens of meters high, their surfaces engraved with defensive runes that shimmered with a cold, eerie sheen beneath the sunlight.
Layer upon layer of magical barriers covered the entire city, defending it against all outside attacks.
Arrow towers and magitech cannons densely lined the city walls, and several legendary-grade powerhouses stood guard there year-round. The entire city was as impregnable as a fortress of iron!
At that moment, a figure suddenly appeared in the sky, hovering beneath the clouds.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh—!
In the next instant, dozens of rays of light descended, and several dozen legendary-grade powerhouses appeared behind Faustus, releasing their legendary-grade pressure without restraint.
Inside Divine Wrath City, countless imperial citizens and players looked up toward the sky.
"It’s that cheating dog Faustus!"
"Fuck, how did he get here so fast? Run, brothers!"
"Idiot, just kill yourself now. Soon you won’t even have time to cry!"
At that very moment, five streaks of light shot up violently from within the city and charged straight toward Faustus.
"Enemy attack!!"
With a loud shout from Carodion, dozens of experts instantly opened Godscar, dragging those legendary-grade powerhouses of World Zone No. 1213 inside.
Space twisted.
Godscar unfolded.
A smile spread across Daniel’s face.
He had spotted two transcendent legendary-grade powerhouses from World Zone No. 1213!
Several dozen legendary-grade experts pinned those few enemies down completely. No matter how they struggled, they could not break free from the restraint, let alone reach Daniel.
Daniel let out a cold laugh and slowly raised Stellar Wrath.
[Shadowfont]!
[Shattering Comet]!
[Arrowstorm]!
[Aetherlance]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
[Ding! You have killed Phil (transcendent), a legendary-grade powerhouse from World Zone No. 1213!
Experience +1.8 billion! gold coin +980,000!
World War point +1.8 million!
Obtained "Wrathbringer Flying Blade (legendary-grade)"!
Obtained quest item "Fragment of the Immortal Singularity" ×1!]
A few minutes later, all five World Zone No. 1213 experts had been killed. They were then revived by Faustus and designated No. 38 through No. 42!
At that point, Divine Wrath City no longer had any legendary-grade powerhouses guarding it.
Faustus summoned his clones once again, slaughtered the entire main city clean, and then occupied it.
In the very next moment, a world announcement rang out across the entire Stellar world!
[Server-wide Announcement: Player "Faustus" of World Zone No. 616 has successfully occupied the main city "Divine Wrath City" of World Zone No. 1213! Imperial Morale of World Zone No. 1213 -10%!]
[The Emperor of World Zone No. 1213 is furious and has dispatched "Warden Lord" along with part of the Temple of the Gods’ elite forces to hunt down player "Faustus"!]

[Server-wide Announcement: Congratulations to player "Faustus" for becoming the first player to occupy a foreign-zone main city! Special rewards granted: World War point +100 million! Contribution Points +300,000! Obtained special title "Lord of Divine Wrath (legendary-grade)"!]
At this moment, all players across Stellar had gone completely numb.
"Faustus, that cheating dog! GM, hurry up and ban him already!"
"What kind of joke is this?! Faustus can even take an outside zone’s main city now. Is he going to attack the Imperial City next?"

"Greetings, friends of World Zone No. 616. We from World Zone No. 700 have loved peace since ancient times. Order and coexistence are the ideals we value most. We hereby express our warmest congratulations to Boss Faustus for his achievement!"
"Ahem... if I remember right, your World Zone No. 700 was part of the six-zone alliance in the Battle of Desperation, wasn’t it?"
"Aiya, aiya! Friend, you misunderstand. Our players were merely misled by those fellows from World Zone No. 1213 at the time, and thus strayed down the wrong path!"
"That’s right. Our pursuit of peaceful coexistence in World Zone No. 700 is as solid as iron!"
"Same here. We in World Zone No. 250 can also pursue peace!"
"Hahahaha... I’m dying. A whole bunch of fence-sitters!"

chapters.title: Chapter 141 -141-Attack the Imperial City? Has He Gone Mad?
paragraphs: [Ding! You have obtained the special title "Lord of Divine Wrath (legendary-grade)"!]
[Ding! You have been ranked first on the Empire Wanted List of World Zone No. 1213! Bounty amount: +10 billion gold coins!]
[Ding! You are currently being hunted and pursued! "Warden Lord" of World Zone No. 1213 will lead part of the Temple of the Gods’ forces to hunt you down! Countdown to pursuit: 9:56... 9:55...]
Expressionless, Faustus took out the title scroll.
[Lord of Divine Wrath (legendary-grade)]
Effect: After equipping, the level requirements for all equipment and skills are reduced by 20 levels.
Description: Only the mightiest conqueror is worthy of this title!
Faustus’s heart stirred.
He was currently level 120, still thirty levels short of the level 150 requirement for forbidden spells.
But if he equipped this title, then as long as he completed this class advancement quest, he would be able to use forbidden curses.
At that point, he would truly be invincible beneath the supreme-grade.
Without hesitation, he equipped the title.
[Ding! You have equipped the title "Lord of Divine Wrath"!]
At that moment, Faustus suddenly remembered the system notification.
The Warden Lord of World Zone No. 1213 would soon be coming to hunt him down.
"Warden Lord?"
He frowned slightly.
In the current version, supreme-grade powerhouses would not take part in mortal wars.
Which meant that the Warden Lord could be, at most, a legendary-grade Transcendent Peak.
Once he thought that through, Faustus stopped taking him seriously.
"Still... it seems the Temple of the Gods has a lot of legendary-grade powerhouses?"
He murmured softly, his gaze turning toward the direction of World Zone No. 1213’s Imperial City.
In the next moment, he spread his wings and flew in that direction.
World Zone No. 1213, Imperial City.
More than sixty legendary-grade powerhouses turned into streaks of light and came to a halt above the Imperial City.
All eyes were fixed on the young archer standing at the front.
Looking down from above, Daniel sized up the Imperial City before him.
In both scale and imposing presence, the Imperial City was far beyond comparison with an ordinary main city.
[Ding! Pursuer — "Warden Lord" of World Zone No. 1213 is rapidly approaching! Player, please be alert!]
Faustus ignored it.
He was currently searching the sky for the buildings of the Temple of the Gods.
Just then—
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
More than a hundred legendary-grade powerhouses shot out from a magnificent building within the Imperial City and hovered ten meters above the city, scrutinizing Faustus and his group.
"What the hell? Those look like invaders from another zone!"
"He seems to be that adventurer with the bounty from His Majesty the Emperor — Faustus!"
"What is he doing in the Imperial City? Don’t tell me he wants to attack this place? Has he gone insane?"
"He’s outrageously bold! Arrogant to the extreme!"
"How dare he humiliate us like this — damned bastard!"
"Lord Warden will be back soon. Let’s see how arrogant he can stay then!"
The legendary-grade powerhouses of World Zone No. 1213 were completely shaken by Faustus’s actions.
Even in their wildest dreams, they had never imagined someone could be this arrogant.
To bring only a few dozen legendary-grade powerhouses and dare march on the Imperial City of an entire empire — it was sheer madness.
This was the Imperial City!
The very center of the entire World Zone, where legendary-grade, exalted-grade, and epic-grade powerhouses were as common as trees in a forest!
And now a mere adventurer dared come here and provoke them?
He had truly lost his mind!
Just then, a majestic voice rolled over from the distance like heavenly thunder.
"By order of the Imperial Emperor — I have come to execute the invader!"
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
A peak legendary-grade powerhouse led more than a dozen high-grade experts through the void and arrived.
Moments later, the man at the front looked coldly at Faustus, his voice like ice.
"Chief culprit Faustus shall be executed without mercy!"
"So arrogant!!"
"Where do you get that confidence from?!"
"Stay alert for assassinations! Protect the Duke at all times!"
The moment Carodion and the others saw the domineering attitude of World Zone No. 1213’s powerhouses, they immediately shouted back.
Cursing as they went, they formed a tight protective circle around Faustus.
Faustus gave the Warden Lord a faint glance and quietly spat out a single sentence.
"Kill him."
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
The legendary-grade powerhouses of World Zone No. 616 did not waste a word. They directly unfolded Godscar and dragged the Warden Lord and all his subordinates inside.
The more than one hundred legendary-grade powerhouses from World Zone No. 1213 above the Imperial City did not remain idle either. They all charged in as well.
From the surface, World Zone No. 1213 held an overwhelming advantage in numbers in this battle.
The situation seemed extremely unfavorable for Daniel and his side!
Godscar.
"Kill that Warden Lord first."
Faustus said to Carodion.
Carodion and Aliris, the two transcendent powerhouses, exchanged a glance and immediately lunged forward, firmly entangling the Warden Lord.
Faustus casually tossed a detection spell over.
[Warden Lord of World Zone No. 1213 (Transcendent legendary-grade)]
Level: ???
Immortal Singularity: 1200 points
Attack Power: ???
Defense: ???
Skills: ???
Description: A guardian legend of a World Zone empire, one of the strongest beings in the current version!
Faustus narrowed his eyes.
As expected of one of the strongest beings in the version — his Immortal Singularity had actually exceeded a thousand!
The amount of this thing directly determined the strength of a legendary-grade powerhouse, which was also why Fragments of the Immortal Singularity were so incredibly rare.
Faustus teleported over and immediately loosed an arrow with Stellar Wrath.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
Facing the siege of two transcendent experts by himself, the Warden Lord was not the least bit flustered.
In the next moment, however, he suddenly felt his body stiffen. A look of disdain quickly appeared on his face.
With only a light exertion, he shattered the restraint!
Faustus was not surprised in the slightest.
Back when he had suppressed the shadowkin, there had already been shadowkin experts who smashed through his skills by forcefully spending Immortal Singularity.
The Warden Lord possessed several times more Immortal Singularity than an ordinary high-grade expert. To think he could be permanently locked down with mere skills?
What a dream.
When he fought the shadowkin overlord Baal, he had hardly taken action at all for precisely this reason — beings of that level simply did not care about that bit of control from his skills.
Thinking that through, Faustus immediately summoned ninety-nine clones and drew his bow again.
[Shadowfont]!
[Aetherlance]!
[Arrowstorm]!
[Shattering Comet]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
A string of skills slammed into the Warden Lord, yet the damage numbers that floated up made Faustus frown slightly.
This damage was dozens of times lower than his normal output!
Faustus threw another detection spell.
[Warden Lord]; Immortal Singularity: 1010 points!
"As expected..."
The Warden Lord had spent Immortal Singularity to cloak himself in [Damage Reduction].
Only someone who also possessed Immortal Singularity could break through that layer of turtle shell.
Suddenly—
"Divine Judgment!"
The longsword in Carodion’s hand flashed with golden light as he slashed down onto the Warden Lord.
Carodion’s damage had not been weakened, because he too was consuming Immortal Singularity to attack, perfectly offsetting the Warden Lord’s enhancement.
Faustus found that completely natural.
Once he fused with a godhead in the future, he too would be able to condense Immortal Singularity.
At that point, when fighting legendary-grade powerhouses, he would no longer have to fear this kind of unreasonable suppression.
And this kind of defense was only the most superficial use of Immortal Singularity.
Extending one’s lifespan, preserving eternal youth, flying through the heavens and burrowing through the earth...
These were only a tiny fraction of its countless wondrous applications!
Faustus remained perfectly calm.
Sooner or later, the enemy’s Immortal Singularity would run out.
But his MP and skills were effectively endless.
Using the infinite to wear down the finite — no matter how one calculated it, he was the one profiting.
So he was in no hurry at all. He simply continued leisurely throwing out skills and attacks, slowly grinding the Warden Lord down...

Faustus casually tossed a detection spell over.
[Warden Lord of World Zone No.
1213 (Transcendent legendary-grade)]
Level: ???
Immortal Singularity: 1200 points
Attack Power: ???
Defense: ???
Skills: ???
Description: A guardian legend of a World Zone empire, one of the strongest beings in the current version!
Faustus narrowed his eyes.
As expected of one of the strongest beings in the version — his Immortal Singularity had actually exceeded a thousand!
The amount of this thing directly determined the strength of a legendary-grade powerhouse, which was also why Fragments of the Immortal Singularity were so incredibly rare.
Faustus teleported over and immediately loosed an arrow with Stellar Wrath.
[Wind’s Embrace]!
Facing the siege of two transcendent experts by himself, the Warden Lord was not the least bit flustered.
In the next moment, however, he suddenly felt his body stiffen.
A look of disdain quickly appeared on his face.
With only a light exertion, he shattered the restraint!
Faustus was not surprised in the slightest.
Back when he had suppressed the shadowkin, there had already been shadowkin experts who smashed through his skills by forcefully spending Immortal Singularity.
The Warden Lord possessed several times more Immortal Singularity than an ordinary high-grade expert.
To think he could be permanently locked down with mere skills?
What a dream.
When he fought the shadowkin overlord Baal, he had hardly taken action at all for precisely this reason — beings of that level simply did not care about that bit of control from his skills.
Thinking that through, Faustus immediately summoned ninety-nine clones and drew his bow again.
[Shadowfont]!
[Aetherlance]!
[Arrowstorm]!
[Shattering Comet]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
A string of skills slammed into the Warden Lord, yet the damage numbers that floated up made Faustus frown slightly.
This damage was dozens of times lower than his normal output!
Faustus threw another detection spell.
[Warden Lord]; Immortal Singularity: 1010 points!
"As expected..."
The Warden Lord had spent Immortal Singularity to cloak himself in [Damage Reduction].
Only someone who also possessed Immortal Singularity could break through that layer of turtle shell.
Suddenly—
"Divine Judgment!"
The longsword in Carodion’s hand flashed with golden light as he slashed down onto the Warden Lord.
Carodion’s damage had not been weakened, because he too was consuming Immortal Singularity to attack, perfectly offsetting the Warden Lord’s enhancement.
Faustus found that completely natural.
Once he fused with a godhead in the future, he too would be able to condense Immortal Singularity.
At that point, when fighting legendary-grade powerhouses, he would no longer have to fear this kind of unreasonable suppression.
And this kind of defense was only the most superficial use of Immortal Singularity.
Extending one’s lifespan, preserving eternal youth, flying through the heavens and burrowing through the earth...
These were only a tiny fraction of its countless wondrous applications!
Faustus remained perfectly calm.
Sooner or later, the enemy’s Immortal Singularity would run out.
But his MP and skills were effectively endless.
Using the infinite to wear down the finite — no matter how one calculated it, he was the one profiting.
So he was in no hurry at all.
He simply continued leisurely throwing out skills and attacks, slowly grinding the Warden Lord down...

chapters.title: Chapter 142 -142-Conqueror’s Emblem, Replica Crystal
paragraphs: Ten minutes later!
Both Carodion and Aliris were already wounded, but the Warden Lord was in no better condition.
As he looked at Daniel, who was controlling the field from outside the main clash, the more he fought, the worse he felt!
[Shadowfont]!
[Aetherlance]!
[Arrowstorm]!
[Shattering Comet]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
Seeing that the damage he dealt had returned to normal, the corners of Faustus’s lips slowly curled upward.
The Warden Lord’s Immortal Singularity was finally close to running dry.
At that very moment, Carodion and Aliris surged forward again, madly unloading their skills onto the Warden Lord.
Faustus’s skills did not stop for even a moment.
One minute later—
"Damned invader..."
The Warden Lord let out a miserable howl, his body turning to ash within endless lightning.
The instant Faustus killed the Warden Lord, the system notifications and world announcements exploded almost at the same time.
[Ding! You have killed "Warden Lord" of World Zone No. 1213! Obtained gold coin +2,000,000! Experience +3 billion! Contribution Points +1 million!]
[Obtained special item "Forced Levy Emblem (legendary-grade)"! Obtained "Fragment of the Immortal Singularity" ×1!]
[Server-wide Announcement: Player "Faustus" of World Zone No. 616 has killed "Warden Lord" of World Zone No. 1213, shaking the entire world! Imperial Morale of World Zone No. 1213 -10%!]
[Congratulations to player "Faustus" for becoming the first player to kill the Warden Lord of World Zone No. 1213! Special reward granted: "Replica Crystal (supreme-grade)" ×1!]
The moment this world announcement came out, the entire world erupted in uproar.
The players did not know exactly how strong the Warden Lord was, but just from the title alone they knew he had to be one of the empire’s pillars, a ceiling-level combat force.
And yet even an existence standing at that peak had still been slaughtered by Faustus...
Did that not mean Faustus was already invincible under heaven!?
"By the gods! Hurry up and open the next version already, I’m sick of Faustus!"
"Faustus is fighting all the powerhouses of an entire nation by himself. Tell me, how absurd is that?"
"Faustus is truly invincible. If he wants anything, he can just come take it from my backpack!"
"Boss Faustus just smiles and says nothing. If he wants something, would you even dare refuse?"
"Keep it low-key, keep it low-key. Boss Faustus isn’t that kind of person..."
Listening to the system prompt, Faustus took out the item dropped by the Warden Lord from his backpack.
[Forced Levy Emblem (legendary-grade)]
Effect: After equipping, all damage dealt is raised to 10 million points (current upper limit). Final output damage is affected by the target’s strength.
Not bad. But it still had room for improvement!
[Ding! You sold "Forced Levy Emblem (legendary-grade)" to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The sold item belongs to the special equipment category. Please choose: quality boost / quantity boost!]
"Quality boost!"
[Ding! Congratulations! You obtained 1 gold coin! You obtained "Conqueror’s Emblem (supreme-grade)"!]
Daniel’s eyes lit up as he opened the detailed panel.
[Conqueror’s Emblem (supreme-grade)]
Level: 1
Trait: Growth-type
Effects:

After equipping, ignores all of the user’s level, attributes, skill, and equipment restrictions, forcibly raising all damage dealt to 100 million points (current level cap). Final output damage is still affected by factors such as defense, damage reduction, and Immortal Singularity. Each time damage is dealt, it additionally applies Forced Assault: ignores 50% of the target’s defense and resistance for 3 seconds (stackable).
Upgrade Requirement: Devour legendary-grade skill books (0/10)
Description: A badge said to have been worn by an ancient emperor while conquering countless worlds. It contains the supreme will of I am destiny itself — a top-tier growth-type special item.
After reading it, Faustus nodded inwardly.
Like his weapon Stellar Wrath, this item was also growth-type. That was its greatest value.
As for its effects, it directly forced his output to 100 million, ignoring level, skills, and base attributes... absolutely heaven-defying!
However, if he encountered a Transcendent Peak powerhouse like the Warden Lord, he still would not be able to deal that full hundred million damage before exhausting the enemy’s Immortal Singularity.
That was normal.
The power of Immortal Singularity stood above everything else.
Put simply, if you had Immortal Singularity, you were a god.
If you did not, then you were mortal.
That was how domineering it was.
As for the legendary-grade skill books required for upgrading it, those were not difficult for Daniel at all.
With the several billion World War points in his possession, exchanging for a few legendary-grade skill books would be child’s play.
In the end, it all came down to one truth:
The strong only grow stronger!
Things that ordinary players could only gaze at in envy were within effortless reach for him.
If ordinary players and powerhouses were given the same status and待遇, then what meaning would strength even have?
Faustus loathed one kind of person most of all: those who came out after the fusion of game and reality and tried to use morality to shackle the strong.
This world had always revered strength above all else.
Whoever had the bigger fist got to define justice and fairness!
With a casual motion, he equipped the emblem.
Faustus then took out the [Replica Crystal].
[Replica Crystal (supreme-grade)]
Effect: Can replicate all kinds of special fragments. Number of uses: 0/1

Description: It was originally created in order to use the regenerative properties of Immortal Singularity to automatically restore fragmented items into a complete form. However, the final result failed to reach the intended state, and it can only replicate fragment-type items.
After reading it, Faustus was overjoyed.
He was not seeing things, right? It could replicate fragments!
Did that not mean that Fragments of the Immortal Singularity could also be copied?
"This is the greatest harvest of the entire battle!!"
He muttered and immediately began operating it.
[Ding! You sold "Replica Crystal (supreme-grade)" to Doom Guild for 1 copper coin, triggering Millionfold Boost!]
[The sold item belongs to the special item category. Please choose: quality boost / quantity boost!]
This time, Daniel chose quantity boost.
[Ding! Congratulations! You obtained 1 gold coin! You obtained "Replica Crystal (supreme-grade)" ×1,000,000!]
Looking at the backpack now packed full of Replica Crystals, Daniel could not help but let the corners of his mouth rise.
With these Replica Crystals, the task of obtaining Immortal Singularity could practically be completed with a flick of his fingers. It was absurdly easy!
In an excellent mood, Daniel turned his gaze back toward the battlefield.
With the Warden Lord dead, the situation on the battlefield instantly reversed.
"Kill!"
Freed from restraint, the two legendary-grade transcendent powerhouses, Carodion and Aliris, pounced on the other legendary-grade experts of World Zone No. 1213 like gods of slaughter.
Daniel also joined the battlefield at once.
He continuously drew Stellar Wrath, firing skill after skill from his hands.
[Shadowfont]!
[Aetherlance]!
[Arrowstorm]!
[Shattering Comet]!
[Serpent’s Thundercell]!
[Ding! You have killed "Kamit (transcendent)," a legendary-grade powerhouse from World Zone No. 1213! Obtained experience +2.6 billion! gold coin +1,000,000!
World War point +3,000,000! Obtained "Bloodmoon Armor (legendary-grade)"!]
[Ding! You obtained quest item "Fragment of the Immortal Singularity" ×1!]
With the support of other legendary-grade powerhouses, Faustus’s current strength made wearing down and killing a transcendent no difficult matter at all.
Very soon, dozens of World Zone No. 1213’s experts fell one after another.
"Run! Run now!"
"Lord Warden has fallen! Retreat to the Imperial City at once!"
"Faustus is unstoppable — go!"
The remaining seventy-plus legendary-grade powerhouses of World Zone No. 1213 bolted out of Godscar like startled birds, fleeing in utter disarray.
They stumbled back into the Imperial City and only then barely managed to regroup, every face filled with shock and terror.
Never in their wildest dreams had they imagined that Faustus could actually kill even the Warden Lord!
That had been one of the empire’s strongest combat forces, an existence standing at the absolute peak of the mortal world!
Faustus looked at those World Zone No. 1213 experts fleeing in panic, and a cold smile slowly rose at the corners of his lips.
They might be able to run—
but their throne could not.
