chapters.title: Chapter 143 -143- The Emperor’s Humiliation, the Empire’s Lament
paragraphs: World Zone No. 1213, Imperial City.
Faustus led his band of powerful warriors out of the Godscar, their robes snapping in the wind like judges returning from a divine war.
Not far away, the experts of World Zone No. 1213 caught sight of him and began trembling uncontrollably.
It was a fear born from the depths of the soul. Not cowardice, but the instinctive shudder of prey standing before its natural predator.
"The Imperial City is protected by an ancient magic array."
Daniel glanced at Carodion, his voice icy.
"Attack. I want to see just how long this turtle shell can hold."
"At your command, my lord!"
With a sweep of his arm, Carodion gave the signal, and the legendary-grade experts under his command struck all at once.
Divine arts, forbidden spells, and torrents of elemental power poured down like a violent storm.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Countless attacks, each powerful enough to split the earth itself, were intercepted before they could even touch the walls of the Imperial City.

A magical barrier suddenly flared to life high above, like an enormous glass bowl turned upside down, covering the entire Imperial City. Light flowed across its surface, runes flickering in and out of view.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The experts of World Zone No. 616 did not stop. Their skills crashed down in relentless waves, one after another, like an angry sea battering the heavens.
Daniel stood with his hands clasped behind his back, watching coldly.

He knew better than anyone that every Imperial City in every World Zone carried the accumulated defensive magic arrays of a thousand years. Without days and nights of nonstop bombardment, it would be impossible to break through.
He was in no hurry to breach the city.
He was simply telling those experts of World Zone No. 1213 hiding behind that barrier one thing.
You are only fit to cower inside your shell and cling to your miserable lives.
Inside the royal palace.
The Emperor slumped on his throne, his face as pale as paper.
The thunderous blasts booming overhead sounded like funeral bells, each one striking his heart.
He covered his ears, his eyes red-rimmed.
"Useless! All of you are useless!"
He shot to his feet from the throne, his voice trembling with rage.

"The Imperial City has stood for a thousand years, the heart of the Empire, sheltering all its people—yet today it is trampled upon, humiliated, and bombarded at the invaders’ whim! This is the greatest disgrace imaginable!"

His finger stabbed toward the sky, the knuckles white with strain. "That adventurer named Faustus has shamed the entire Empire! What he humiliates is not merely me—he humiliates every citizen upon this land, the countless heroic souls who died for it, and the thousand years of glory this Empire once possessed!"
By the end, tears burst from his eyes.
"Wuu... the Empire... is finished... finished..."
At that moment, the ruler of an entire nation was weeping openly, sobbing until he could barely speak.
The ministers of the Empire all stood with lowered heads.
None dared speak.
None could.
Inside the Imperial City, the players of World Zone No. 1213 stared blankly up at the sky.
They watched the experts of World Zone No. 616 unleash apocalyptic power without restraint. They watched the magical barrier tremble under the ceaseless bombardment, flickering and dimming.
And hovering ten meters above the Imperial City, those legendary-grade experts—figures who had once been lofty, arrogant, and untouchable—were now shaking with rage.
Yet not a single one of them dared rush out beyond the barrier.
They had already been slaughtered into terror by Faustus and his people.
At this moment, the hearts of the players in World Zone No. 1213 had probably already died.
If even legendary-grade experts were like this, if even the Empire was powerless, then what could mere mortals like them possibly do?
"Hahahaha..."
After thoroughly humiliating the Empire of World Zone No. 1213 from top to bottom, Faustus finally laughed in satisfaction.
It was about time to stop.
The harvest from this trip was mountainous. It was time to return to his territory and digest it all properly.
Most important of all, he needed to use the Replica Crystal to duplicate three hundred Fragments of the Immortal Singularity.
Once he gathered enough, he could return to World Zone No. 616 and submit his class change quest.
And once the restrictions were lifted and his level started rising again, those forbidden spells would finally be able to display their true power.
Thinking of this, Faustus turned to Carodion and the others and said lightly,
"That’s enough. Leave His Majesty the Emperor his dog life for now."
"Withdraw."
All the experts answered in unison, "At your command, my lord!"
Mauler.
After returning to the Lord’s Manor, the first thing Faustus did was cast Summon of the Holy Angel.
He threw all the remains of the World Zone No. 1213 experts he had killed this time into the holy light.
After spending a massive amount of gold coins, thirty-eight legendary-grade experts of World Zone No. 1213 were reborn within the golden radiance.
Among them was that ruthless Transcendent Peak powerhouse—the Warden Lord of World Zone No. 1213!
Faustus gave him the name Hal, while the other thirty-seven were assigned names in sequence.
With the resurrection of this batch of legendary-grade experts, the strength under his command surged yet again.
He now had more than a hundred legendary-grade experts in his grasp, and the strongest among them was Hal—a Transcendent Peak existence!
Even Carodion was slightly inferior to him!
After counting the resurrected experts, Faustus shifted his attention to his backpack.
Inside lay seventy-three Fragments of the Immortal Singularity.
He only needed to use a single Replica Crystal, and his class change quest could be completed in one stroke.
The crystal could duplicate not only Fragments of the Immortal Singularity, but also Divinity Fragments.
However, he had already accumulated one hundred higher-tier Divinity Fragments, so there was no need to waste it on those.
He took out a [Replica Crystal] and one [Fragment of the Immortal Singularity].
[Ding! You are using the special item "Replica Crystal (supreme-grade)" to duplicate the special item "Fragment of the Immortal Singularity." Please confirm.]
"Confirm."
The Replica Crystal flashed several times. The light twisted, and it transformed directly into the appearance of a Fragment of the Immortal Singularity.
Immediately after, Daniel pulled out a huge handful of Replica Crystals from his backpack...
Three minutes later.
[Notification: You have used "Replica Crystal" and successfully obtained "Fragment of the Immortal Singularity" x1,000,000!]
The corners of Faustus’s lips curled upward.
He was delighted.
[Ding! Your class change quest has been completed. Please submit it as soon as possible.]
Now that the class change quest was complete, he could continue leveling up.
But there was no rush to return yet. He still had to clean up the mess over in World Zone No. 1213.

The gains from this trip were not limited to the system rewards. The number of legendary-grade experts under his command had soared, and on top of that, he had gained an entire main city and a major city.

He immediately summoned all the upper ranks of his legion and ordered troops to be dispatched to garrison the newly conquered cities. At the same time, he sent powerful experts to seize every city, large and small, within the territory of Divine Wrath City.
By this point, within World Zone No. 1213, one main city—[Divine Wrath City]—and three large cities—Mauler, Aha Harbor, and Earthspire—had all become Daniel’s territory.
If he also devoured all the subordinate cities beneath Divine Wrath City, then he would hold one-ninth of the Empire’s land in World Zone No. 1213 in his hands.
Besides, the experts under his command were both numerous and powerful, with a legendary-grade Transcendent Peak figure standing guard.
In terms of both number and level of legendary-grade experts, his faction was already capable of clashing head-on with the peak strength of World Zone No. 1213.
So he was not worried in the slightest that after he left, his territory would be counterattacked by either the Empire of World Zone No. 1213 or the undead army.
Only after everything had been more or less arranged did Daniel step into the portal and return to World Zone No. 616.

He was in no hurry to breach the city.
He was simply telling those experts of World Zone No.
1213 hiding behind that barrier one thing.
You are only fit to cower inside your shell and cling to your miserable lives.
Inside the royal palace.
The Emperor slumped on his throne, his face as pale as paper.
The thunderous blasts booming overhead sounded like funeral bells, each one striking his heart.
He covered his ears, his eyes red-rimmed.
"Useless!
All of you are useless!"
He shot to his feet from the throne, his voice trembling with rage.
"The Imperial City has stood for a thousand years, the heart of the Empire, sheltering all its people—yet today it is trampled upon, humiliated, and bombarded at the invaders’ whim!
This is the greatest disgrace imaginable!"
His finger stabbed toward the sky, the knuckles white with strain.
"That adventurer named Faustus has shamed the entire Empire!
What he humiliates is not merely me—he humiliates every citizen upon this land, the countless heroic souls who died for it, and the thousand years of glory this Empire once possessed!"
By the end, tears burst from his eyes.
"Wuu... the Empire... is finished... finished..."
At that moment, the ruler of an entire nation was weeping openly, sobbing until he could barely speak.
The ministers of the Empire all stood with lowered heads.
None dared speak.
None could.
Inside the Imperial City, the players of World Zone No.
1213 stared blankly up at the sky.
They watched the experts of World Zone No.
616 unleash apocalyptic power without restraint.
They watched the magical barrier tremble under the ceaseless bombardment, flickering and dimming.
And hovering ten meters above the Imperial City, those legendary-grade experts—figures who had once been lofty, arrogant, and untouchable—were now shaking with rage.
Yet not a single one of them dared rush out beyond the barrier.
They had already been slaughtered into terror by Faustus and his people.
At this moment, the hearts of the players in World Zone No.
1213 had probably already died.
If even legendary-grade experts were like this, if even the Empire was powerless, then what could mere mortals like them possibly do?
"Hahahaha..."
After thoroughly humiliating the Empire of World Zone No.
1213 from top to bottom, Faustus finally laughed in satisfaction.
It was about time to stop.
The harvest from this trip was mountainous.
It was time to return to his territory and digest it all properly.
Most important of all, he needed to use the Replica Crystal to duplicate three hundred Fragments of the Immortal Singularity.
Once he gathered enough, he could return to World Zone No.
616 and submit his class change quest.
And once the restrictions were lifted and his level started rising again, those forbidden spells would finally be able to display their true power.
Thinking of this, Faustus turned to Carodion and the others and said lightly,
"That’s enough.
Leave His Majesty the Emperor his dog life for now."
"Withdraw."
All the experts answered in unison, "At your command, my lord!"
Mauler.
After returning to the Lord’s Manor, the first thing Faustus did was cast Summon of the Holy Angel.
He threw all the remains of the World Zone No.
1213 experts he had killed this time into the holy light.
After spending a massive amount of gold coins, thirty-eight legendary-grade experts of World Zone No.
1213 were reborn within the golden radiance.
Among them was that ruthless Transcendent Peak powerhouse—the Warden Lord of World Zone No.
Faustus gave him the name Hal, while the other thirty-seven were assigned names in sequence.
With the resurrection of this batch of legendary-grade experts, the strength under his command surged yet again.
He now had more than a hundred legendary-grade experts in his grasp, and the strongest among them was Hal—a Transcendent Peak existence!
Even Carodion was slightly inferior to him!
After counting the resurrected experts, Faustus shifted his attention to his backpack.
Inside lay seventy-three Fragments of the Immortal Singularity.
He only needed to use a single Replica Crystal, and his class change quest could be completed in one stroke.
The crystal could duplicate not only Fragments of the Immortal Singularity, but also Divinity Fragments.
However, he had already accumulated one hundred higher-tier Divinity Fragments, so there was no need to waste it on those.
He took out a [Replica Crystal] and one [Fragment of the Immortal Singularity].
[Ding!
You are using the special item "Replica Crystal (supreme-grade)" to duplicate the special item "Fragment of the Immortal Singularity." Please confirm.]
"Confirm."
The Replica Crystal flashed several times.
The light twisted, and it transformed directly into the appearance of a Fragment of the Immortal Singularity.
Immediately after, Daniel pulled out a huge handful of Replica Crystals from his backpack...
Three minutes later.
[Notification: You have used "Replica Crystal" and successfully obtained "Fragment of the Immortal Singularity" x1,000,000!]
The corners of Faustus’s lips curled upward.
He was delighted.
[Ding!
Your class change quest has been completed.
Please submit it as soon as possible.]
Now that the class change quest was complete, he could continue leveling up.
But there was no rush to return yet.
He still had to clean up the mess over in World Zone No.
The gains from this trip were not limited to the system rewards.
The number of legendary-grade experts under his command had soared, and on top of that, he had gained an entire main city and a major city.
He immediately summoned all the upper ranks of his legion and ordered troops to be dispatched to garrison the newly conquered cities.
At the same time, he sent powerful experts to seize every city, large and small, within the territory of Divine Wrath City.
By this point, within World Zone No.
1213, one main city—[Divine Wrath City]—and three large cities—Mauler, Aha Harbor, and Earthspire—had all become Daniel’s territory.
If he also devoured all the subordinate cities beneath Divine Wrath City, then he would hold one-ninth of the Empire’s land in World Zone No.
1213 in his hands.
Besides, the experts under his command were both numerous and powerful, with a legendary-grade Transcendent Peak figure standing guard.
In terms of both number and level of legendary-grade experts, his faction was already capable of clashing head-on with the peak strength of World Zone No.
So he was not worried in the slightest that after he left, his territory would be counterattacked by either the Empire of World Zone No.
1213 or the undead army.
Only after everything had been more or less arranged did Daniel step into the portal and return to World Zone No.

chapters.title: Chapter 144 -144-Mastering Three Forbidden Spells, a Humanoid Nuclear Bomb
paragraphs: Luminara.
The moment Daniel stepped out of the portal, he realized that this main city was nothing like it had been before.
It was packed to the brim, teeming with noise and life.
The streets were flooded with players, long lines stretched outside every shop, and the portal’s light flashed nonstop without a moment’s rest.
What Daniel did not know was that, in the real world, public promotion for the game had begun much earlier than it had in his previous lives.
Overnight, the number of players in World Zone No. 616 had exploded from the original two billion to several billion more.
Every main city was now overflowing with people shoulder to shoulder.
Daniel looked over it all with cold indifference.
By now, he already stood at the very peak of all players in this Stellar world.
No player could ever hope to catch up to his shadow.
Besides, the strongest group of people were all already under his command.
Even if some new guilds emerged in the future, he could not be bothered to care.
As long as they did not touch his interests, they could do whatever they liked.
But if some blind fool actually dared provoke him, he could crush them into dust with a casual wave of his hand.
He shook his head, spread his Eternal Darkgold Wings, and flew toward the Hall of Class Mentors.
Before long, Daniel arrived at the Hall of Class Mentors.
The moment he stepped inside, all the NPCs in the hall turned to look at him. Some nodded in greeting, some stepped aside to make way for him. That was the treatment reserved for true powerhouses.
Daniel’s expression remained indifferent as he walked straight up to Shadow Song.
"These are the items for the class change quest."
He handed over the stack of Fragments of the Immortal Singularity.
Shadow Song accepted the fragments calmly.
She was no longer surprised that Daniel had completed the class change quest so quickly.
It seemed that no matter how difficult or convoluted the quest was, this Grand Duke could always crush straight through it with ease.
After putting the fragments away, she drew out a dazzling golden scroll from her sleeve and handed it to him.
"This is your Class Awakening Scroll."
Daniel took the scroll.
[Ding! You have completed the class change quest and obtained "Forbidden-Grade Archer Class Awakening Scroll" x1!]
The corner of his mouth lifted.
He could level up again.
Once this round of leveling was done, those forbidden spells he had been keeping at the bottom of his inventory could finally be brought out and used.
Without hesitation, he used the scroll. Strands of golden light poured into his body one after another.
[Ding! Your level cap has been unlocked. You may continue leveling up!]
Daniel immediately chose to level up.
[Ding! Your level has increased to 121. Reward: 20 attribute points!]
[Ding! Your level has increased to 130. Reward: 20 attribute points!]
[Ding! Your level has increased to 150. Reward: 20 attribute points!]

[Notice: You have not yet completed the next-stage class change quest. Your level cap has not been unlocked. Overflowing experience has been stored in the Exp pool. Please complete the subsequent quest to unlock the level cap.]
Daniel took out three forbidden spell skill books from his backpack, all of which he had accumulated over this period of time.
The fire-element [Skyfall Strike], the lightning-element [Thunder Abyss], and the ice-element [Permafrost Prison].
Without the slightest hesitation, Daniel immediately learned the first book.
[Ding! You have learned the forbidden spell "Skyfall Strike"!]
He opened his skill panel.
[Skyfall Strike (SSS-Grade)] (Low-Tier Forbidden Spell)
Effect:

Summons meteors from beyond the heavens to bombard a target area, covering a range of 1000 x 1000 meters. Each meteor deals 5000% damage. The number of meteors depends on the caster’s Intelligence attribute: every 1000 points of Intelligence adds 1 meteor, up to a maximum of 100 meteors.
After impact, each meteor explodes within a 50-meter radius, dealing an additional 2000% damage, and leaves behind a burning zone on the ground that lasts for 10 minutes.
Cooldown: 10 minutes
MP Cost: 10000

Description: One of the legendary forbidden curses of the Arrow God of Ruin. When cast, it resembles the descent of the apocalypse, reducing all things to nothingness. (How do you defend against an arrow storm descending from the heavens?)
Proficiency: 0/20000
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
As expected of a forbidden spell!
The duration stretched all the way to ten minutes. Added together, that was a total damage output of 60 billion!
One forbidden spell landing for 60 billion damage... what kind of concept was that?
It could probably instantly kill any legendary-grade expert below the Transcendent realm.
Even those above Transcendent would not last more than a few seconds if they failed to escape the forbidden spell’s range within ten minutes.
At this point, if he wanted to flatten World Zone No. 1213, it would be nothing more than a matter of throwing down a few more forbidden spells.
He then learned the second book.
[Ding! You have learned the forbidden spell "Thunder Abyss"!]
[Thunder Abyss (Legendary-Grade)] (Low-Tier Forbidden Spell)
Effect:

Summons abyssal lightning to form an eternal thunder prison in a designated area (range: 1000 x 1000 meters). All enemy targets within the domain are forcibly inflicted with the effects of [Paralysis], [Silence], and [Slowness].

Within the domain, one million lightning arrows are automatically generated, continuously attacking all enemies inside the area. Each lightning arrow deals damage equal to 100% of the caster’s Attack Power.
Duration: Infinite (can be terminated by the caster at any time; consumes 1% MP per second)

Description: A forbidden divine art said to have been created by an ancient Arrow God who drew upon the lightning of the abyss. Once a single arrow is loosed, ten thousand bolts answer its call. Those trapped within can only be reduced to ash amid endless storms of thunder.
Daniel drew in a deep breath.
Just as expected, this was another terrifying skill.
He then learned the last book.
[Ding! You have learned the forbidden spell "Permafrost Prison"!]
[Permafrost Prison (SSS-Grade)] (Low-Tier Forbidden Spell)
Effect:

Draws upon the power of absolute cold to form arrows, creating an eternal frozen domain in a designated area (range: 1000 x 1000 meters). All enemy targets within the domain are forcibly inflicted with [Freeze], [Slowness], and [Frozen Seal].
The domain deals damage equal to 200% of the caster’s Attack Power every second to all enemies within it.
Duration: Infinite (can be terminated by the caster at any time; consumes 1% MP per second)

Description: A forbidden spell created by an ancient Grand Bow Sage using the heart of a frost dragon as its catalyst. Once a single arrow is released, all lands for ten thousand miles are sealed in ice.
After learning all three forbidden spells, Daniel could finally bring out the full arsenal of a forbidden-grade archer.
To hold forbidden spells in one’s hand was the same as holding a Pandora’s box capable of destroying heaven and earth.
Add in the bonus from Skill Replication, the effects of his weapon, and his ninety-nine clones...
At this moment, Daniel was practically a nuclear bomb with two legs.
Only after finishing all that did Daniel turn to look at his class mentor, Shadow Song.
"I want to take the next forbidden-grade archer class change quest."
Shadow Song immediately understood. A streak of golden light shot into his body.
[Ding! Do you wish to accept the forbidden-grade archer class change quest "Starlight of Humanity"?]
"Accept."
Daniel frowned slightly.
The name alone made it obvious that this quest would be no simple matter.
[Ding! You have accepted the class change quest "Starlight of Humanity (Low-Tier)"! Please check your quest log for details!]
He opened the quest log.
[Starlight of Humanity (Low-Tier)]
(Forbidden-Grade Archer Class Change Quest)
Quest Difficulty: Exalted-Grade
Objectives:
Ascend to Heavenscar, Cloudcrest Peak
Obtain the achievement "Brilliant Starlight" within Heavenscar
Acquire the title "Supreme-Grade Heavenly Punishment"
Quest Description:

Heavenscar is the supreme-grade battlefield within this astral realm, where all races vie for supremacy. Only the most peerless geniuses—those who carry the fate and fortune of their race upon their shoulders—are qualified to set foot in this Realm Trial of Boundaries.

chapters.title: Chapter 145 -145-Meteoric Catastrophe, Wiping Out a City with a Wave of the Hand
paragraphs: Daniel’s brows drew tightly together.
To enter Heavenscar, one needed at least one hundred tickets.
Those who went in were gambling with their lives, wagering the fortune of their race against the many trials within Heavenscar.
If they endured and succeeded, the race’s destiny would surge, and they would gain all sorts of rewards.
If they failed, not only would their race’s fortune decline, they would also have to bear unimaginable punishment.
Within Heavenscar stood a mountain called Cloudcrest Peak.
Since ancient times, countless prodigies and powerhouses had dreamed of climbing it.
That alone showed just how absurdly difficult this quest requirement was.
For such a task to be stuffed into a class change quest, Daniel found it hard to imagine what kind of mindset the mission designer of the Archer Association had when creating it.
[Ding! Quest Rewards!]
[New Version Activation Scroll], [Forbidden-Grade Archer Class Awakening Scroll]
After reading the rewards, Daniel sucked in a sharp breath.
The authority to decide when a new version would be unlocked?!
The Class Awakening Scroll was something he absolutely needed, but that New Version Activation Scroll was even more essential if he wanted to stay ahead of everyone else in progression.
Only now did he finally realize what all those [Heavenscar Passes] he had obtained before were actually for.
And this quest was actually using the fate of the human race as the wager.
If he passed, all humanity feasted.
If he failed, all humanity suffered.
Even more ruthless was the fact that the objectives were listed in crystal-clear terms—he had to complete every single one of them.
It was not enough just to win.
He had to keep winning, all the way until he crushed the geniuses of every race beneath his feet.
This quest concerned the lives and deaths of countless humans. It concerned the fate of the entire human race.
Daniel drew in a deep breath.
This was going to be one hell of a challenge.
"If I want to prepare for this quest, I need to do it without distraction and get every resource I have fully ready."
He thought of the war in World Zone No. 1213, which had not yet been fully concluded.
"I need to sweep away every last worry before I can go into this light and unburdened."
He quickly pulled his thoughts together, bid farewell to Shadow Song, and turned to leave.
World Zone No. 1213, Mauler.
Daniel summoned all the high-ranking leaders under his command.
"For the next battle," he said calmly, "I’m going to destroy World Zone No. 1213."
The moment they heard those words, the eyes of the gathered leaders lit up. Every one of them was thrilled beyond measure.
Daniel swept his gaze over them and let it settle on Alan.
"Alan!"
"Awaiting your command!"
"The Doom Legion will deal with the players of World Zone No. 1213. Kill every single one you encounter. I want no survivors."
"At your command, my lord!"
Daniel nodded, then turned his gaze to Hudson.
"Hudson!"
"Here!"
"I’ll lead the siege myself. Your Polaris Legion will follow behind and absorb the territories we conquer."
"As you wish!"
Orb Star City.
Daniel descended directly from the sky, showing himself openly and without the slightest attempt to hide.
The moment he appeared, the entire city exploded into chaos.
At this moment, he was alone, while Orb Star City housed tens of millions of NPCs and players.
Yet from the very instant he appeared, the only expression left on the faces of the imperial citizens and players was despair.
"Enemy attack! The enemy—forget it, whoever wants to block him can do it, I’m running first!"
"By the gods above, it’s the devil Faustus!"
"Run! Head for the portal! Don’t let him kill you!"
Countless NPCs and players went mad, desperately shoving toward the city’s portal.
Devil Faustus—his reputation had been forged in blood.

He had personally killed the number one powerhouse of World Zone No. 1213, flown above the Imperial City itself, and bombarded it wildly while the entire Empire could do absolutely nothing to stop him.
The legendary-grade experts of World Zone No. 1213 had already been slaughtered into spineless terror by him.
By today, there was not a single person left in the entire World Zone No. 1213 who dared stand up and challenge him.
They feared Faustus the way people feared a natural disaster.
Daniel looked coldly at the city beneath him, now thrown into complete chaos by nothing more than his appearance, and a sneer curled onto his lips.
"You want to run?"
"You’re leaving without even saying hello. That’s just bad manners."
He summoned ninety-nine clones, all of them raising Stellar Wrath in unison.
[Skyfall Strike]!
The clear sky abruptly turned red.
Even the wind blowing through the air became frighteningly hot.
First, the roadside trees burst into flame on their own. Then the lakes outside the city began to smoke, bubbling and boiling.
The clouds above burned crimson like a sea of fire, and the air filled with the stench of scorching ash.
Then, before the horrified eyes of countless people—
the endless fire elements in the sky condensed into enormous flaming meteors, each as large as a mountain.
One. Hundreds. Thousands. Millions.
In the blink of an eye, they filled the entire sky.
And there were billions of them, all crashing downward at once in a rain of destruction.
The fleeing imperial citizens and players looked up, and their souls nearly left their bodies.
The flaming meteors blotted out the sun itself. Heaven and earth were drowned in firelight.
"Run! Run!"
That was the only thought left in their minds.
Unfortunately, it was already too late.
Billions of flaming meteors, trailing long tails of fire, smashed down into the city.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Boom! Boom! Boom...!
In the span of a single breath, all of Orb Star City was swallowed by a sea of flames.
Its towering spires, broad streets, and humble houses were all reduced to ash in that one attack.
It was as if the apocalypse had arrived, turning the entire land into a vision of hell.
A single forbidden spell had crushed an entire city and erased every living thing within it.
Daniel watched the scene expressionlessly.
In his field of vision, the once-busy and prosperous Orb Star City had become nothing more than a smoking wasteland of ruins.
System notifications exploded in his ears like a tsunami.
[Ding! You have destroyed "Orb Star City (World Zone No. 1213)"! Obtained World War Points +500,000,000! Contribution Points +2,000,000! Gold Coins +50,000,000,000!]
[Ding! You have destroyed "Orb Star City (World Zone No. 1213)"! Current Imperial Morale -10%!]
[Notice: Current Imperial Morale of World Zone No. 1213 is now 60%!]
[When public support falls below 10%, NPCs will begin to rebel, and the rule of outsiders will become easier to accept.]
Daniel blinked.
So public support had this kind of use as well.

In other words, if he drove the public support of World Zone No. 1213 below 10%, then the NPCs of World Zone No. 1213 would accept him, their new ruler, much more easily. Governing them would become far simpler too.
Once he understood that, he turned and left at once.
Straight for the next city.
Imperial City of World Zone No. 1213.
The Emperor personally went to the Temple of the Gods.
The legendary-grade experts of the Temple of the Gods came out silently to receive him.
Of course, they knew exactly why His Majesty had come.
But Faustus was already invincible!
What difference was there between opposing him and seeking death?
The Emperor’s glare swept across the assembled legendary-grade experts, his eyes burning as though he wanted to devour them alive.
"Faustus first seized Divine Wrath City, and today he destroyed Orb Star City as well!"
He gritted his teeth, his voice trembling. "Of the nine main cities, the Empire has already lost two! If he’s allowed to keep attacking like this, the end of the Empire will be right in front of us!"
His eyes were bloodshot, and his voice had already gone hoarse.
"If the Empire falls, then every one of you will become subjects of a ruined nation!"

To enter Heavenscar, one needed at least one hundred tickets.
Those who went in were gambling with their lives, wagering the fortune of their race against the many trials within Heavenscar.
If they endured and succeeded, the race’s destiny would surge, and they would gain all sorts of rewards.
If they failed, not only would their race’s fortune decline, they would also have to bear unimaginable punishment.
Within Heavenscar stood a mountain called Cloudcrest Peak.
Since ancient times, countless prodigies and powerhouses had dreamed of climbing it.
That alone showed just how absurdly difficult this quest requirement was.
For such a task to be stuffed into a class change quest, Daniel found it hard to imagine what kind of mindset the mission designer of the Archer Association had when creating it.
[Ding!
Quest Rewards!]
[New Version Activation Scroll], [Forbidden-Grade Archer Class Awakening Scroll]
After reading the rewards, Daniel sucked in a sharp breath.
The authority to decide when a new version would be unlocked?!
The Class Awakening Scroll was something he absolutely needed, but that New Version Activation Scroll was even more essential if he wanted to stay ahead of everyone else in progression.
Only now did he finally realize what all those [Heavenscar Passes] he had obtained before were actually for.
And this quest was actually using the fate of the human race as the wager.
If he passed, all humanity feasted.
If he failed, all humanity suffered.
Even more ruthless was the fact that the objectives were listed in crystal-clear terms—he had to complete every single one of them.
It was not enough just to win.
He had to keep winning, all the way until he crushed the geniuses of every race beneath his feet.
This quest concerned the lives and deaths of countless humans.
It concerned the fate of the entire human race.
Daniel drew in a deep breath.
This was going to be one hell of a challenge.
"If I want to prepare for this quest, I need to do it without distraction and get every resource I have fully ready."
He thought of the war in World Zone No.
1213, which had not yet been fully concluded.
"I need to sweep away every last worry before I can go into this light and unburdened."
He quickly pulled his thoughts together, bid farewell to Shadow Song, and turned to leave.
World Zone No.
1213, Mauler.
Daniel summoned all the high-ranking leaders under his command.
"For the next battle," he said calmly, "I’m going to destroy World Zone No.
The moment they heard those words, the eyes of the gathered leaders lit up.
Every one of them was thrilled beyond measure.
Daniel swept his gaze over them and let it settle on Alan.
"Alan!"
"Awaiting your command!"
"The Doom Legion will deal with the players of World Zone No.
Kill every single one you encounter.
I want no survivors."
"At your command, my lord!"
Daniel nodded, then turned his gaze to Hudson.
"Hudson!"
"Here!"
"I’ll lead the siege myself.
Your Polaris Legion will follow behind and absorb the territories we conquer."
"As you wish!"
Orb Star City.
Daniel descended directly from the sky, showing himself openly and without the slightest attempt to hide.
The moment he appeared, the entire city exploded into chaos.
At this moment, he was alone, while Orb Star City housed tens of millions of NPCs and players.
Yet from the very instant he appeared, the only expression left on the faces of the imperial citizens and players was despair.
"Enemy attack!
The enemy—forget it, whoever wants to block him can do it, I’m running first!"
"By the gods above, it’s the devil Faustus!"
"Run!
Head for the portal!
Don’t let him kill you!"
Countless NPCs and players went mad, desperately shoving toward the city’s portal.
Devil Faustus—his reputation had been forged in blood.
He had personally killed the number one powerhouse of World Zone No.
1213, flown above the Imperial City itself, and bombarded it wildly while the entire Empire could do absolutely nothing to stop him.
The legendary-grade experts of World Zone No.
1213 had already been slaughtered into spineless terror by him.
By today, there was not a single person left in the entire World Zone No.
1213 who dared stand up and challenge him.
They feared Faustus the way people feared a natural disaster.
Daniel looked coldly at the city beneath him, now thrown into complete chaos by nothing more than his appearance, and a sneer curled onto his lips.
"You want to run?"
"You’re leaving without even saying hello.
That’s just bad manners."
He summoned ninety-nine clones, all of them raising Stellar Wrath in unison.
[Skyfall Strike]!
The clear sky abruptly turned red.
Even the wind blowing through the air became frighteningly hot.
First, the roadside trees burst into flame on their own.
Then the lakes outside the city began to smoke, bubbling and boiling.
The clouds above burned crimson like a sea of fire, and the air filled with the stench of scorching ash.
Then, before the horrified eyes of countless people—
the endless fire elements in the sky condensed into enormous flaming meteors, each as large as a mountain.
One.
Hundreds.
Thousands.
Millions.
In the blink of an eye, they filled the entire sky.
And there were billions of them, all crashing downward at once in a rain of destruction.
The fleeing imperial citizens and players looked up, and their souls nearly left their bodies.
The flaming meteors blotted out the sun itself.
Heaven and earth were drowned in firelight.
"Run!
Run!"
That was the only thought left in their minds.
Unfortunately, it was already too late.
Billions of flaming meteors, trailing long tails of fire, smashed down into the city.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
Boom...!
In the span of a single breath, all of Orb Star City was swallowed by a sea of flames.
Its towering spires, broad streets, and humble houses were all reduced to ash in that one attack.
It was as if the apocalypse had arrived, turning the entire land into a vision of hell.
A single forbidden spell had crushed an entire city and erased every living thing within it.
Daniel watched the scene expressionlessly.
In his field of vision, the once-busy and prosperous Orb Star City had become nothing more than a smoking wasteland of ruins.
System notifications exploded in his ears like a tsunami.
[Ding!
You have destroyed "Orb Star City (World Zone No.
Obtained World War Points +500,000,000!
Contribution Points +2,000,000!
[Ding!
You have destroyed "Orb Star City (World Zone No.
Current Imperial Morale -10%!]
[Notice: Current Imperial Morale of World Zone No.
[When public support falls below 10%, NPCs will begin to rebel, and the rule of outsiders will become easier to accept.]
Daniel blinked.
So public support had this kind of use as well.
In other words, if he drove the public support of World Zone No.
1213 below 10%, then the NPCs of World Zone No.
1213 would accept him, their new ruler, much more easily.
Governing them would become far simpler too.
Once he understood that, he turned and left at once.
Straight for the next city.
Imperial City of World Zone No.
The Emperor personally went to the Temple of the Gods.
The legendary-grade experts of the Temple of the Gods came out silently to receive him.
Of course, they knew exactly why His Majesty had come.
But Faustus was already invincible!
What difference was there between opposing him and seeking death?
The Emperor’s glare swept across the assembled legendary-grade experts, his eyes burning as though he wanted to devour them alive.
"Faustus first seized Divine Wrath City, and today he destroyed Orb Star City as well!"
He gritted his teeth, his voice trembling.
"Of the nine main cities, the Empire has already lost two!
If he’s allowed to keep attacking like this, the end of the Empire will be right in front of us!"
His eyes were bloodshot, and his voice had already gone hoarse.
"If the Empire falls, then every one of you will become subjects of a ruined nation!"

chapters.title: Chapter 146 -146-The Main City of an Empire Doomed to Perish in the Heavenly Disaster
paragraphs: "Take the gamble... and maybe we can still carve out a path of survival for the Kalet Empire..."
He looked at them with pleading eyes, desperation written all over his face.
The powerhouses of the Temple of the Gods felt deeply unsettled when they heard him.

Among them were warriors who had rushed back from the front lines of the Undead Battlefield, where they had been fighting without regard for their lives; others had been dragged out of seclusion by force; and together with those who had already been stationed in the Temple of the Gods, there were now more than two hundred legendary-grade powerhouses gathered here!
Seeing their hesitation, the emperor clenched his teeth and said harshly,
"If the glory in your hearts and the Kalet Empire have already collapsed, then what am I, this emperor, but a joke? This empire would be nothing more than an empty shell without flesh or blood!"
"In that case, we might as well hand everything over to Faustus and let him rule the empire in our place!"
"Your Majesty, you must not!"
"Please calm down, Your Majesty!"
"That’s right—things haven’t reached that point yet..."
The expressions of the Temple of the Gods’ powerhouses turned ugly.
Let the adventurer Faustus rule the Kalet Empire?
What kind of absurd joke was that?!
The Kalet Empire belonged to the living beings of World Zone No. 1213, not to some foreign adventurer!
How could they allow an outsider to ride roughshod over them?
They feared Faustus, yes—but they feared even more the thought of the Kalet Empire being devoured by an outsider.
An old man with snow-white hair stepped forward in grief and fury.
"I am willing to fight Faustus to the death!"
"I will share the empire’s honor and disgrace!"
Someone immediately followed.
"He’s just a powerful enemy... I’ll go too!"
One after another, voices rose in answer.
"Then let’s stake everything on this!"
In the end, all the powerhouses of the Temple of the Gods roared in unison.
Divine Wrath City.
The moment Faustus appeared, panic once again exploded across the city.
"It’s over! That devil Faustus has come to Divine Wrath City!"
"Wasn’t he the one who just destroyed Orb Star City? Why is he here again?!"
"What kind of joke is this? Is he planning to wipe out our entire empire?!"
"Run, you idiots! I can see it now—Faustus isn’t going to spare a single person from World Zone No. 1213!"
Faustus looked coldly down at the city below.
He summoned his clones and raised Stellar Wrath.
[Permafrost Prison]!
The sunlight, which had still been warm just moments ago, now carried a bone-piercing chill.
Inch by inch, the land began to freeze. The buildings of every height and shape were covered in a thin layer of frost in the blink of an eye.
And that once-noisy main city fell silent in an instant...
The faces of the NPCs and players turned deathly pale, filled with panic, collapse, and despair.
Every kind of expression froze on their faces, as if they had been hit by a petrifying spell.
Then it was as though some invisible giant hand had seized them. Ice began spreading through their bodies.
The freezing current climbed upward from their feet, layer by layer, each sheet of ice growing thicker than the last, until every last one of them had become an ice sculpture.
In the space of a heartbeat, system notifications exploded in Faustus’s ears.
[Ding! You have destroyed "Divine Wrath City (World Zone No. 1213)"! Gained World War Points +500,000,000! Contribution Points +2,000,000! Gold Coins +5,000,000!]
[Ding! You have destroyed "Divine Wrath City (World Zone No. 1213)"! Current Imperial Morale -10%!]
After hearing them, Faustus’s expression did not change in the slightest.
With a beat of his wings, he flew toward the next target city.
Skyhold.
Faustus was on his way there, but before he even arrived, he saw more than two hundred legendary-grade powerhouses already standing in formation, waiting for him.
"Oh? Looks like you’re trying to stop me?"
Faustus narrowed his eyes, a sneer curling across his lips. "Fine by me. Saves me the trouble—I’ll wipe you all out in one go."
The instant he finished speaking, his wings trembled, and in the blink of an eye he shot in front of one of World Zone No. 1213’s powerhouses.
Shhk—shhk—shhk—!
Ninety-nine clones appeared all at once.
The moment the powerhouses of World Zone No. 1213 saw that formation, their hearts wavered.

It was no longer a secret that Faustus possessed a spatial ring capable of storing living people. These ninety-nine clones alone were already terrifying enough—who knew when he might suddenly release even more fighters from it?
What they did not know, however, was that this time Faustus had truly come alone.
At that moment, facing over two hundred legendary-grade powerhouses of World Zone No. 1213, Faustus grinned.
He raised Stellar Wrath and hurled skill after skill as though they cost him nothing at all.
[Skyfall Strike]!
[Permafrost Prison]!
[Thunder Abyss]!
In an instant, the very heavens changed color.
The moment those World Zone No. 1213 powerhouses felt the death domain of the forbidden spells spreading out, their faces turned stark white.
"This is... a forbidden spell?!"
"Gods above! How could an adventurer become this terrifying?!"
"What kind of joke is this? An adventurer actually wielding the power of forbidden spells?!"
Every single one of them turned ashen with despair. In their hearts, they understood perfectly well:
There were only two choices now—either endure the forbidden spells head-on, or kill Faustus before they were fully formed.
But the forbidden spells came far faster than they had imagined.
First, the entire world was frozen solid.
Even legendary-grade powerhouses had no hope of breaking free from that suppression unless they used their Immortal Singularities.
Then, countless magical beasts formed from thunder elements came surging in like a collapsing mountain and a crashing sea, swallowing all of them whole.
At the same time, a sky full of flaming meteors dragged long blazing tails behind them as they crashed down, bombarding the powerhouses of World Zone No. 1213 without mercy.
Against forbidden spells of this level, even high legendary-grade powerhouses would be instantly killed.
Even transcendent experts could only hold on for a few seconds longer—nothing more than a few extra breaths before death.
In the blink of an eye, ninety-nine percent of the more than two hundred powerhouses of World Zone No. 1213 died on the spot.
A few seconds later, even the last few transcendent experts were gone as well!
There was no helping it. The destructive force and range of three overlapping forbidden spells were simply too terrifying!
System notifications exploded in his ears like a tidal wave.
[Ding! You have killed World Zone No. 1213 legendary-grade powerhouse "Lomio (Transcendent)"! Gained EXP +2,500,000,000! Gold Coins +980,000!
World War Points +2,800,000!
Obtained "Blood Energy Bracers (Legendary-grade)"!
Obtained "Fragment of the Immortal Singularity" ×1!]
[Ding! You have killed World Zone No. 1213 legendary-grade powerhouse "Jastansen (Low Rank)"!
Gained EXP +800,000,000! Gold Coins +190,000!
World War Points +1,000,000!
Obtained "Tide Armor (Legendary-grade)"!
Obtained "Fragment of the Immortal Singularity" ×1!]
But the forbidden spells were still spreading!
Under the might of those three great forbidden spells, Skyhold visibly began collapsing before the naked eye.
The people of World Zone No. 1213 inside the city could only watch this apocalyptic scene unfold and let out cries of utter despair.
Half an hour later—
Boom!
With an earth-shaking explosion—
Skyhold was gone.
[Ding! You have destroyed "Skyhold (World Zone No. 1213)"! Gained World War Points +500,000,000! Contribution Points +2,000,000! Gold Coins +5,000,000!]
[Ding! You have destroyed "Skyhold (World Zone No. 1213)"! Current Imperial Morale -10%!]

[World Zone No. 1213 Announcement: Kalet Empire’s current Imperial Morale has fallen to only 40%! All players of World Zone No. 1213, please note: when morale drops to 10%, NPCs are highly likely to rebel; when it falls to 5%, the empire will be completely annihilated!]

chapters.title: Chapter 147 -147-Complete Control, the Empire’s Fall
paragraphs: As Daniel listened to the system notifications, his heart remained utterly unmoved.
In the course of his previous lives, World Zone No. 1213 had been one of the strongest zones, repeatedly inciting other World Zones to join forces against World Zone No. 6161.
That had led to countless losses among the players and NPCs of World Zone No. 616.
The conflict and warfare had even continued all the way until the game and reality merged!
And because of that, World Zone No. 616 had been left with a severely weakened foundation. When the people of Earth faced all kinds of high-grade monsters, all they could do was cry out in despair.
But the root of that war had been nothing more than the jealousy of World Zone No. 1213’s players over the explosive rise of World Zone No. 616!
That jealousy was what made them stir up hatred again and again, pushing war into existence!
That was also what made Daniel see one thing clearly: the players of World Zone No. 1213 deserved to die.
And that was exactly why he had not hesitated for a moment to destroy the very foundations of the empire in World Zone No. 1213.
He would personally seize every single player in that World Zone in the palm of his hand, clamping down on their throats and necks alike!
At present, the empire of World Zone No. 1213 still had five main cities left unconquered.
But Daniel had the means of flight, so travel time meant almost nothing to him.
An hour later—
The remaining five main cities had all been destroyed by him, one after another!

[World Zone No. 1213 Announcement: Current Imperial Morale has dropped to 0%! All players of World Zone No. 1213, please note! The NPCs in every city are about to launch an uprising! The empire stands on the brink of collapse!]
As the players of World Zone No. 1213 listened to the regional announcement, they had already gone completely numb.
At this point, they had no feelings left to speak of.
Faustus’s earlier battles against Demonwood and the Unvanquished Reaper Quin had long since crushed the spirit and morale of World Zone No. 1213’s players to the very bottom.
Listening to the system prompt, Faustus quickly flew toward the Imperial City of World Zone No. 1213.
Every World Zone’s Imperial City possessed overwhelmingly powerful defenses.
Last time, he had already bombarded the skies above the Imperial City once, but back then he had not wanted to waste too much time, so he had not launched a full assault.
But this time, in order to prepare properly for the class change mission to come, he would not allow himself to have any lingering worries behind him!
World Zone No. 1213 had to be under his control.
Even if he had to grind it down by force, he would take the Imperial City and personally kill that empire’s emperor!
Above the Imperial City of World Zone No. 1213, a figure tore through the raging wind and arrived like a thunderbolt.
Faustus halted steadily in midair, looking down coldly at the colossal city below him, a city that symbolized the supreme authority of the empire.
At this moment, the Imperial City’s magical defensive formation had already been activated in full.
A layer of pale blue light, like an enormous inverted bowl of glazed crystal, enveloped the entire Imperial City with airtight precision.
Runes flowed across its surface, and faint arcs of lightning moved within it.
Inside the city, everything was deathly silent. The streets were empty, and even the wind carried a bleak, chilling desolation.
Daniel took a deep breath and slowly raised Stellar Wrath, summoning all ninety-nine of his clones at once.
As long as he shattered this turtle shell, this giant city that represented imperial rule would be his for the taking.
Now, the backbone of World Zone No. 1213’s players had already been broken by him, and their greatest pillar of support, the Temple of the Gods, had also been wiped out in one fell swoop.
The entire World Zone No. 1213 no longer had any strength left that could stand in his way.
Thinking of that, Faustus abruptly swung Stellar Wrath down.
[Meteoric Firestorm]!
[Frozen Expanse]!
[Thunderous Myriad Manifestations]!
Boom! Boom! Boom—!
Countless flaming meteors, ice spears, and thunder-serpents came crashing down upon the pale blue barrier like the collapse of heaven and earth.
Dense swarms of damage numbers erupted wildly across the magical defensive formation, and this level of damage would continue for a full half hour!
But what drove countless players into even deeper despair was that Faustus’s skills seemed endless, pouring onto the defensive formation without a single moment of pause.
Truth be told, even for the current Daniel, forcibly smashing through the Imperial City’s magical defensive formation was extremely difficult.
But that did not matter—he had more than enough patience and MP.
Even if he had to wear it down bit by bit, he would grind this turtle shell to pieces.
He would not stop until the Imperial City of World Zone No. 1213 had been completely trampled beneath his feet.
And at the same time—
Faustus had no idea that his frenzied actions had already drawn immense attention.
World Zone No. 616.
Almost every player knew that Faustus was wreaking havoc throughout World Zone No. 1213, and that this World War was about to reach its conclusion.
Everyone wanted to pretend it was just another ordinary day—leveling when they should level, farming gold when they should farm gold.
But on this day, no one could calm down.
Their hearts had already flown across the world line and landed on the soil of World Zone No. 1213.
And not just them.
Players from every World Zone were staring fixedly at everything happening in World Zone No. 1213.
This battle would completely reshape the structure of the human race.

The moment Faustus broke through the Imperial City of World Zone No. 1213, from that day forward he would become a supreme ruler capable of deciding the life and death of hundreds of millions with a single thought—a maker of the rules of the world.
At the same time, the rulers of those empires were trembling inwardly.
After Faustus destroyed World Zone No. 1213, would they be next?
If they switched places with World Zone No. 1213, would they be able to withstand him?
The more they thought about it, the more they had no choice but to admit that Faustus himself was an unsolvable problem.
If they stood against him, their own end would probably be no better than that of World Zone No. 1213.
After thinking it through from every angle, there seemed to be only one path left:
Do not provoke him.
No one knew how much time had passed.
World Zone No. 1213, Imperial City.
Faustus’s offensive had not stopped for even a single moment.
At this point, the magical defensive formation that had once seemed indestructible had become as thin as a sheet of paper, as though a light poke would be enough to shatter it.
A few seconds later—
Boom!!!
With an earth-shaking explosion, the Imperial City’s magical defensive formation shattered!
Faustus’s eyes lit up sharply.

His forbidden spells had long since been primed and ready. The instant the defensive formation broke, that world-destroying power smashed straight into the Imperial City without the slightest obstruction.
In the span of a blink, the entire Imperial City was ravaged beyond recognition by the destructive force of the forbidden spells.
Looking down at the ruins beneath his feet, Faustus decisively stopped casting.
At this moment, the vast Imperial City of World Zone No. 1213 had already turned into a scorched wasteland.
Millions upon millions of living beings had been reduced to ashes by the aftershock of the forbidden spells.
He beat his wings and flew straight into the collapsing imperial palace.
Everyone knew that once you occupied the stele inside a Lord’s Manor, that city was truly yours.
And the one inside the imperial palace was called the Imperial Stele!
Faustus sped through the palace, and along the way he saw countless corpses, among them one dressed in the robes of an emperor.
Perhaps that had once been the most exalted being in this vast empire?
But at this moment, Daniel did not so much as raise an eyelid. He flew straight toward the deepest part of the palace.
Very soon, he found the Imperial Stele, radiating a faint golden light!
Without hesitation, he raised Stellar Wrath.
[Aetherlance]!
[Ding! You have destroyed the "Imperial Stele of World Zone No. 1213"!]
[Prompt: Please choose "Occupy" or "Destroy."]
"Occupy," Faustus said coldly.

[Ding! You have occupied the "Imperial City of World Zone No. 1213"! Obtained special item "Scepter of Kings (Legendary-grade)" (Unique)! Contribution Points +800,000,000,000! Gold Coins +800,000,000,000! World War Points +500,000,000,000!]

In the course of his previous lives, World Zone No.
1213 had been one of the strongest zones, repeatedly inciting other World Zones to join forces against World Zone No.
That had led to countless losses among the players and NPCs of World Zone No.
The conflict and warfare had even continued all the way until the game and reality merged!
And because of that, World Zone No.
616 had been left with a severely weakened foundation.
When the people of Earth faced all kinds of high-grade monsters, all they could do was cry out in despair.
But the root of that war had been nothing more than the jealousy of World Zone No.
1213’s players over the explosive rise of World Zone No.
That jealousy was what made them stir up hatred again and again, pushing war into existence!
That was also what made Daniel see one thing clearly: the players of World Zone No.
1213 deserved to die.
And that was exactly why he had not hesitated for a moment to destroy the very foundations of the empire in World Zone No.
He would personally seize every single player in that World Zone in the palm of his hand, clamping down on their throats and necks alike!
At present, the empire of World Zone No.
1213 still had five main cities left unconquered.
But Daniel had the means of flight, so travel time meant almost nothing to him.
An hour later—
The remaining five main cities had all been destroyed by him, one after another!

1213’s players to the very bottom.

Every World Zone’s Imperial City possessed overwhelmingly powerful defenses.
Last time, he had already bombarded the skies above the Imperial City once, but back then he had not wanted to waste too much time, so he had not launched a full assault.
But this time, in order to prepare properly for the class change mission to come, he would not allow himself to have any lingering worries behind him!
World Zone No.
1213 had to be under his control.
Even if he had to grind it down by force, he would take the Imperial City and personally kill that empire’s emperor!

Faustus halted steadily in midair, looking down coldly at the colossal city below him, a city that symbolized the supreme authority of the empire.

A layer of pale blue light, like an enormous inverted bowl of glazed crystal, enveloped the entire Imperial City with airtight precision.
Runes flowed across its surface, and faint arcs of lightning moved within it.
Inside the city, everything was deathly silent.
The streets were empty, and even the wind carried a bleak, chilling desolation.
Daniel took a deep breath and slowly raised Stellar Wrath, summoning all ninety-nine of his clones at once.
As long as he shattered this turtle shell, this giant city that represented imperial rule would be his for the taking.
Now, the backbone of World Zone No.
1213’s players had already been broken by him, and their greatest pillar of support, the Temple of the Gods, had also been wiped out in one fell swoop.
The entire World Zone No.
1213 no longer had any strength left that could stand in his way.
Thinking of that, Faustus abruptly swung Stellar Wrath down.
[Meteoric Firestorm]!
[Frozen Expanse]!
[Thunderous Myriad Manifestations]!
Boom!
Boom!
Boom—!
Countless flaming meteors, ice spears, and thunder-serpents came crashing down upon the pale blue barrier like the collapse of heaven and earth.
Dense swarms of damage numbers erupted wildly across the magical defensive formation, and this level of damage would continue for a full half hour!
But what drove countless players into even deeper despair was that Faustus’s skills seemed endless, pouring onto the defensive formation without a single moment of pause.
Truth be told, even for the current Daniel, forcibly smashing through the Imperial City’s magical defensive formation was extremely difficult.
But that did not matter—he had more than enough patience and MP.
Even if he had to wear it down bit by bit, he would grind this turtle shell to pieces.
He would not stop until the Imperial City of World Zone No.
1213 had been completely trampled beneath his feet.
And at the same time—
Faustus had no idea that his frenzied actions had already drawn immense attention.
World Zone No.
Almost every player knew that Faustus was wreaking havoc throughout World Zone No.
1213, and that this World War was about to reach its conclusion.
Everyone wanted to pretend it was just another ordinary day—leveling when they should level, farming gold when they should farm gold.
But on this day, no one could calm down.

And not just them.
Players from every World Zone were staring fixedly at everything happening in World Zone No.
This battle would completely reshape the structure of the human race.
The moment Faustus broke through the Imperial City of World Zone No.

Do not provoke him.

chapters.title: Chapter 148 -148-Lord of Worlds, the Polaris Zone
paragraphs: At the same time—

[Global Announcement: Player "Faustus" of World Zone No. 616 has occupied the Imperial City of World Zone No. 1213! Obtained "Scepter of Kings (Supreme-grade)" (Unique)! With royal authority in hand, Faustus has become the sovereign of the empire of World Zone No. 1213!]

[Global Announcement: Congratulations to player "Faustus" for becoming the first player to occupy the Imperial City of another World Zone! Special rewards granted: skill book "Voidstep (Epic-grade)"! skill book "Flash (Epic-grade)"! skill book "Codex of Creation (Epic-grade)"! special title "Lord of Worlds" (Unique)!]
Boom—!
The world announcements rang out three times in succession, like three nuclear bombs detonating in the ears of every player in Stellar.
Faustus!
Faustus again!
He had done it!
By his own strength alone, he had suppressed the entirety of World Zone No. 1213!

He had conquered the Imperial City of the World Zone No. 1213 Empire, becoming the first person in the history of the game to accomplish such a heaven-shaking feat, something never before achieved by anyone!
Especially among the players of World Zone No. 616, there was not a single one who did not erupt in joy upon hearing the announcement.
Lord Faustus had actually wiped out the entirety of World Zone No. 1213!
He had completed a feat beyond the wildest dreams of countless people!
"Faustus, you are my god—!!!"
"By the gods above, Faustus alone is our War God!"
"Faustus is invincible! Faustus! Invincible!"
"From now on, if anyone dares say one bad word about Lord Faustus, I’ll beat the shit out of them!"
"Holy shit, this is invincible—truly, literally invincible!"
"I’m begging you, just give me one chance to join Doom Guild! I’m willing to pay five million dollars for it..."
Countless players of World Zone No. 616 trembled with excitement.
Inside a certain instance—
"Roar! Fuck! Kill these mobs for me! Tear them apart!"
"Priest, stop wasting time healing—put Berserk on me already!"
"Attack! Flatten this entire instance for me!"
"Holy shit, this news is such a morale boost!"

The players who had originally been tormented half to death by the instance felt their blood ignite the instant they heard the announcement, and one by one they hurled themselves at the boss with reckless abandon.
The boss was startled.
It truly could not understand how that group of people, who had been so timid just moments ago, had suddenly gone completely insane.
The priest in the back row gave a bitter smile, shook his head, and swung his staff, casting a Berserk buff onto the front-line warrior.
Inside an equipment shop—
"Karl, this silver-grade light armor looks pretty good... how about we just buy this one?"
A female player was asking her boyfriend for his opinion.
The male player smiled, then pointed at the gleaming gold-grade equipment behind them.
"What’s the point of silver-grade? We’re buying that one!"
The girl rolled her eyes.
"So we’re just not paying back the bank loan we already owe?"
The male player chuckled.
"Of course we’ll pay it back. But today’s a good day..."
"The great lord of our World Zone No. 616 actually crushed World Zone No. 1213! Do you know what that means? That’s another world we’re talking about!"
"It’s simply unbelievable. Your man is in a good mood today! Buying a piece of equipment to celebrate seems only right!"
"That’s wonderful! I love Lord Faustus!"
The female player made the decision on the spot.

[Ding! You have obtained skill book "Voidstep (Epic-grade)"! Obtained skill book "Flash (Epic-grade)"! Obtained skill book "Codex of Creation (Epic-grade)"! Obtained special title "Lord of Worlds" (Unique)!]
Listening to the system notification, Faustus smiled.
In a sense, occupying the entirety of World Zone No. 1213 was already the greatest reward of all.
But he had not expected the system’s rewards to be this outrageously overpowered!
Three Epic-grade skill books, plus one unique special title!
He was already a little impatient to take out these rewards and savor them properly.
But there was still one last thing he had to do.
And the importance of that matter far surpassed everything else.
[Ding! Do you wish to spend 1,000,000,000,000 gold coins to change the name of Zone No. 1213?]
"Confirm!"
Daniel clenched his fist inwardly.
[Prompt: Please assign a new name to the former Zone No. 1213.]
Without the slightest hesitation, Faustus said, "Polaris!"
[Ding! Zone name successfully changed!]
[Global Announcement: Player "Faustus" of World Zone No. 616 has officially renamed Zone No. 1213 as "Polaris Zone"!]
Hearing the system announcement, Faustus’s face was full of smiles.
[Global Announcement: "Polaris Zone" has been established! As a special reward, players of this World Zone will receive double experience for three days! May Polaris endure forever!]
The announcement sounded three times in a row.
Every player in Stellar was utterly shaken by this latest wave of world announcements.
"By the gods above! Three full days of double EXP—I’m going to laugh myself awake even in my dreams!"
"Doesn’t that mean the players of World Zone No. 616 now have two major zones in their hands?"

"World Zone No. 616 is totally winning by lying flat this time, and Lord Faustus is even more unbeatable than ever! The day Stellar’s ten thousand zones are unified, I’ll be the first to rally under his banner!"
"No doubt about it, it’s already set in stone! Faustus is destiny’s favorite child—every good thing in the world just chases after him!"
With the renaming of Zone No. 1213 complete, Faustus finally began sorting through the spoils of this campaign.
There was a bit of everything—skill books, titles, special items, all of it.
He took out the title first.
[Lord of Worlds] (Unique)
Effects:
All Polaris Zone players’ attributes +10% (stackable)
Polaris Zone players’ EXP gain +100% (non-stackable)
Polaris Zone players’ monster drop rate +30% (non-stackable)
Description:
As the title of a zone’s ruler, it grants exceptionally generous buffs to all players of that zone.
Faustus’s eyes lit up after reading it.
The effects of this title only applied to players of Polaris Zone.
There was no need to elaborate on the +10% to all attributes. Everything a player had was built on attribute points—and this was an increase to all attributes.
What counted as a god-tier effect?
This was it!
And the EXP bonus and drop-rate bonus were equally among the most essential demands for players.
For Polaris Zone players, killing one monster would yield as much EXP as killing two monsters in another zone.
And with the added 30% drop-rate increase, in the same amount of time, Polaris Zone players would not only get more loot, but better loot as well.
If players from other World Zones saw this, they would probably go red-eyed with envy.
However, for now, the players of Doom Legion still belonged to World Zone No. 616. If they wanted to enjoy these benefits, they would first have to transfer their zone registration over.
Thinking of that, Faustus took out the [Scepter of Kings] again.
Scepter of Kings (Supreme-grade · Unique)
Restriction: Usable only by the Lord of Worlds
Properties: Cannot be equipped, cannot be lost
Authorities:
Royal Authority: The wielder of this scepter may rewrite the laws of a nation and reshape the order of its territories.
Supremacy: As a supreme-grade supreme relic, this scepter allows its holder to command all subjects who have sworn loyalty to the sovereign, and to allocate every resource belonging to the nation.

Sovereignty: The wielder may issue decrees to all subjects—missions, rewards, and punishments without limit, regardless of difficulty. The wielder possesses ultimate authority to reward or punish any subject.
Description:
This scepter embodies the authority of a nation’s rule. It is the empire’s most important sacred instrument.

chapters.title: Chapter 149 -149-Three Epic-Grade Skill Books
paragraphs: Faustus read through every word, and delight immediately rose in his heart.
Only by holding the [Scepter of Kings] in his own hand could he truly be said to have grasped the entirety of Polaris Zone in the palm of his hand.
This thing gave him absolute control over both the NPCs and the players of the zone!
He put the scepter away, then took out the three skill books.
In the current version, where even SSS-grade was considered the absolute peak of skill rank, he had actually been rewarded with three Epic-grade skill books!
Even Daniel could hardly believe just how heaven-defying these skill books had to be!
Codex of Creation (Epic-grade)
Effects:
Creation Codex: Contains 180,000 blueprints of every conceivable type of manufacture.
Genesis: You may use Immortal Singularity to illuminate the technology tree and determine the direction of the empire’s technological development.
Innovation: You may use Immortal Singularity to automatically derive new manufacturing blueprints.
Description:
The prosperity of a nation does not rely solely on peerless champions, but on the flourishing of all its people.
After reading the skill effects, Faustus sucked in a sharp breath.
His luck was simply too absurdly good!
To actually obtain a skill book capable of determining the course of technological development—this was an unbelievable windfall.
In his previous lives, he had personally witnessed a great technological explosion.
At that time, heavenly disasters had come one after another, and in order to survive, humanity had developed all kinds of new technologies.
There were magical inventions like elemental cannons, and mechanical creations like mana-powered battle mechs—things far more outrageous than the current scientific technology of Earth.
And this skill book could open up the technology tree and even automatically derive blueprints—this was practically cheating!
This was more of a utility-type skill book, half item and half skill book.
Faustus stuffed it back into his pack for the time being, planning to take it out again when he actually needed it.
Voidstep (Epic-grade)
Effects:
Consumes 1% MP per second to free oneself from gravity, allowing movement and stillness at will in the void.
Consumes 5% MP per second to fly at extreme speed, reaching up to 7,000 meters per second!
Flight duration is unlimited.
Proficiency: 0/50,000
Description:
Grace and endurance are the only eternal glory. With this in your possession, you shall become the most dazzling existence in the world.
After reading it, Faustus’s lips curled upward.
This skill felt as though it had been tailor-made just for him.
His MP recovery speed was absurdly high, so he was not remotely afraid of the cost.
As long as he wished, staying in the sky until the end of time would not be a problem.
And then there was the acceleration—7,000 meters per second!
The speed of sound was only about 340 meters per second, and even the fastest missiles on Earth were only roughly as fast as he would be.
In other words, if he went all-out, most missiles would not even be able to catch him!
Without a second word, he slapped the skill book and learned it.
[Ding! You have learned "Voidstep"! Please check your skill panel for details!]
The moment the system notification fell, he immediately activated the skill.
Whoosh—!
Faustus rose straight up off the ground.
He took a few steps in midair and found that it felt exactly the same as walking on solid ground.
Then he simply hovered there in the air and took out the final skill book.
Flash (Epic-grade)
Effect: Instantly move to any location within a 100,000 × 100,000 range centered on yourself.
Cost: 1% MP per use
Proficiency: 0/50,000
Description:
If you can run fast enough, death will never catch up to you.
After reading it, Daniel could not help but marvel at just how outrageous these skills were.
This was basically an upgraded version of every high-grade movement skill in the game.
A casual displacement of a hundred thousand meters—roughly one-thousandth the speed of light. It was simply absurd!
Without hesitation, he learned the skill book.
[Ding! You have learned "Flash"! Please check your skill panel for details!]
Faustus’s strength surged upward once again after learning these two skills.
At the very least, when it came to the art of survival and escape, he was confident that he now had absolutely no equal!
After thoroughly familiarizing himself with the two new skills, Faustus immediately cast [Seraphic Revival]!
Golden light flowed before his eyes.
One after another, he threw in the corpses of the several hundred legendary-grade powerhouses he had killed this time.
Gold coins poured out like a rushing stream, and those who had once crossed blades with him began, one by one, to gather the breath of life once more beneath the holy radiance.
Ten minutes later—
More than two hundred legendary-grade powerhouses knelt neatly before him.
Adding them to those he had revived earlier, Polaris Zone now had over three hundred legendary-grade powerhouses!
Compared to other World Zones, that foundation was no weaker at all.
However, Polaris Zone had been smashed to pieces by his own hand. Ruins were everywhere, and the ordinary NPC citizens were causing disturbances all over the place.
If he did not clean things up quickly, forget about collecting taxes—they would not even be able to live a single stable day!
This newly acquired territory was still far from operating normally.
Only by rebuilding order step by step could it truly become his foundation.
Faustus opened Polaris Zone’s administration panel.
From tax rates to housing construction, from resource allocation to issuing directives, every function was there.
The first thing he selected was: "Rebuild all destroyed cities!"
[Ding! Do you wish to spend 20 trillion gold coins to fully restore all destroyed cities in Polaris Zone?]
"Yes."
A mere twenty trillion—Daniel did not even blink.
[Prompt: Command confirmed. Gold coins deducted! All destroyed cities in Polaris Zone have now been fully restored to their original state.]
But Faustus was still not satisfied.
The reason was simple: he disliked the jagged spires and curved eaves of Polaris Zone’s old architectural style, so he clicked a few more options.
[Ding! Do you wish to spend 1 trillion gold coins to change the appearance of all cities in Polaris Zone? (Design to be based on World Zone No. 616 as the foundational template)]
"Change it."
[Ding! 1 trillion gold coins deducted! The new style is named "Northern Star Dominion Style."]
Faustus nodded in satisfaction.
This kind of grand, open, and imposing style was much more pleasing to the eye.
Then he turned his attention to currency reform.
In his previous lives, by the late stages of Stellar, it had taken 100 gold coins to exchange for 1 mana coin, and he had always found that far too inconvenient.
So now he simply restructured the hierarchy: above gold coins he established platinum coins, and above platinum coins he established dark gold coins!
10,000 gold coins = 1 platinum coin
10,000 platinum coins = 1 dark gold coin
10,000 dark gold coins = 1 mana coin
In other words, 1 mana coin = 1 trillion gold coins.
Once that was done, the gold coins in his inventory were automatically converted according to the new rules.

He had already had more money than he could spend, and now that he also possessed the entirety of Polaris Zone as his territory, the speed at which his wealth would increase had become downright terrifying.
Next came personnel arrangements.
Daniel promoted Carodion to become the master of the Temple of the Gods, putting him in charge of all legendary-grade powerhouses in Polaris Zone.

As for the empire’s ministers, Daniel could not be bothered wasting any thought on them. He simply spent money to hire a batch of top-tier administrative NPCs and arranged all the work in short order.
From now on, these NPCs would handle the day-to-day operation of the empire of Polaris Zone.
As for the two great legions, they remained the same as before: he himself concurrently served as the Legion Commander of both.
After handling all of that, there were now only three most urgent matters left.
The first: open the world gates and allow free travel between World Zone No. 616 and Polaris Zone.
Faustus opened the border management panel and fully opened the permissions of all Polaris Zone portals to World Zone No. 616.
From this day forward, there would be no more barriers between the two great zones. Players of World Zone No. 616 could go to any city in Polaris Zone whenever they wished.
The second: circulation of zone registration.
From the moment he obtained the [Lord of Worlds] title, his own zone registration had automatically been transferred to Polaris Zone.
The Polaris Legion under his command had also all transferred over with him, but the more than one hundred million players of Doom Guild had not yet been transferred.
In the end, he decided that all players of World Zone No. 616 would be allowed to apply for Polaris Zone registration.
"There has to be a threshold for transferring zone registration. Otherwise, if the majority of World Zone No. 616’s players all flood in at once, won’t that throw everything into chaos?"

After all, Polaris Zone currently had three days of double EXP, and on top of that there were the attribute bonuses from the [Lord of Worlds] title, benefits so enormous that they would be irresistible to players.
And the player population was, by nature, the group most easily led around by profit.
If no restrictions were put in place, World Zone No. 616’s players would probably be drained dry into Polaris Zone.
